Name: Laboratoire RENASCOR
Description:
Laboratoire RENASCOR is a French laboratory dedicated to advancing the science of hair regrowth and hair reconstruction after cancer.

Our work focuses particularly on a challenge that is often overlooked: hair reconstruction after cancer treatments.

Hair loss caused by oncology treatments - chemotherapy, radiotherapy or hormone therapy - is one of the most visible and emotionally difficult consequences for patients. Beyond the physical change, it deeply affects self-image and represents a delicate stage in the personal rebuilding process after illness.

Laboratoire RENASCOR develops specific approaches designed to support hair regrowth after cancer and to help patients rebuild their hair with confidence.

This expertise also leads us to explore the broader mechanisms of progressive hair loss and the many factors that influence the vitality of the hair follicle throughout life.

Today, our work is used by professionals involved in supportive oncology care as well as by specialists in hair and scalp health, including socio-aestheticians, socio-hairdressers, trichologists and healthcare professionals.

Laboratoire RENASCOR also participates in conferences, scientific congresses, training centers, hospitals and professional events in France and internationally to share knowledge and raise awareness about hair-related challenges in oncology.

Our belief is simple: hair reconstruction is an essential part of the recovery journey after illness, and understanding the mechanisms of hair regrowth is key to preserving long-term hair health.

Name: NuDiCe - U1213 INSERM UCBL1
Description:
The Nutrition, Diabetes and the Brain project is investigating the role of endogenous glucose production (EGP) in the control of normal and pathological blood glucose levels. This crucial physiological function is performed by only three organs, the liver, kidney and intestine, which are the only organs to express the key enzyme glucose-6-phosphatase (G6Pase).

Our strategy is based on the comparison of two 'mirror' diseases associated with EGP deficiency: a rare disease - glycogen storage disease type 1 (GDS1) associated with G6Pase deficiency - characterised by the absence of EGP and severe hypoglycaemia; and an epidemic disease - diabetes associated with excessive EGP - characterised by chronic hyperglycaemia and side effects like cardiovascular diseases and cancer.

To understand the role of the 3 gluconeogenic organs in these diseases, our approach is based on the study of unique transgenic mouse models with deletion or overexpression of G6Pase specifically in each of the 3 gluconeogenic organs. These models allow us to determine how each organ is involved in EGP or in the development of G6Pase-related pathologies.

This strategy has allowed us to discover the paradoxical beneficial role of intestinal glucose production (IGP) in diabetes and obesity. IGP, through the detection of glucose by the gut nervous system, initiates a gut-brain neural circuit that leads centrally to the induction of satiety and peripherally to an increase in thermogenesis and improved glucose control. One of the main benefits of PGIs is the prevention of lipid deposition in tissues (adipose tissue, liver), which is otherwise responsible for deleterious effects that can lead to liver cancer or kidney failure in obesity or GSD1.

Understanding the organ-specific properties of EGP, in particular the metabolic regulation associated with IGP and its effects at the intra-tissue, central and peripheral levels, should provide important answers for future treatments of metabolic diseases.

Name: NovoCIB
Description:
Fondée en 2005, NovoCIB est double Lauréate de Concours National français I-LAB et Tremplin Entreprises, organisés par le Sénat. Depuis ses débuts, NovoCIB est focalisé sur la recherche sur le métabolisme des nucléotides grâce au développement de méthodes analytiques innovantes et de tests enzymatiques propriétaires.
Profile complet des nucléotides à partir d’un seul échantillon
L’approche enzymatique-analytique de NovoCIB permet la caractérisation complète des nucléotides—y compris les bases, nucléosides, ribo- et désoxyribonucléotides, ARN et ADN—à partir d’un seul échantillon biologique. Cette méthode puissante est applicable pour l’analyse des cultures cellulaires, mais également très efficace pour l’évaluation des ingrédients alimentaires et pour l’alimentation animale, tels que l’extrait de levure, la farine de poisson et les protéines unicellulaires.
Évaluation de la fraîcheur des produits de la mer
Depuis les années 1960, le nucléotide IMP, le nucléoside inosine et la base hypoxanthine—issus du catabolisme post-mortem de l’ATP—sont reconnus comme des indicateurs biochimiques fiables de la fraîcheur du poisson. NovoCIB a développé un test enzymatique colorimétrique permettant de quantifier ces trois marqueurs dans un seul échantillon, au format microplaque 96 puits. Cette méthode rapide et précise permet d’évaluer la fraîcheur des produits de la mer crus, congelés ou cuits. Conçu pour être conforme à la norme XP V45-077, ce kit constitue une solution pratique pour les laboratoires et les industriels de la mer soucieux de conformité, d’efficacité et d’assurance qualité renforcée.
Kits PRECICE 
Le kit PRECICE HPRT Assay Kit au format pratique microplaque 96 puits, permet le suivi en continu d'HPRT,  un enzyme  central dans la voie de métabolisme des purines et biomarqueur reconnu de génotoxicité. Ce kit offre une solution pour étudier le métabolisme des nucléotides, les mécanismes de réparation d'ADN et les réponses cellulaires au stress génotoxiques

Name: NexiThera SystemsTM
Description:
Engineering therapeutic assets through evidence, simulation, provenance, and verifiable scientific reasoning.

NexiThera Systems is building a new generation of scientific engineering systems that transform evidence into therapeutic assets through transparent, verifiable, and reproducible reasoning.

At the heart of the platform is EpistemicOSTM, our scientific reasoning infrastructure, and ForgeTM, our Therapeutic Asset Engineering System. Together, they create a closed-loop environment where biological knowledge is continuously integrated, challenged, simulated, and refined to support every stage of therapeutic innovation from target discovery and mechanism validation to candidate engineering, translational forecasting, and preclinical readiness.

Rather than focusing on a single therapeutic modality, NexiThera engineers biological solutions across multiple domains through specialized scientific modules, including Antigen Quality Engineering, target prioritization, biomarker discovery, and computational therapeutic design. Each engineered candidate follows its own conventional development pathway while benefiting from a common foundation of evidence integration, probabilistic reasoning, simulation, provenance, and governance.

By combining multi-omics, clinical, genomic, proteomic, chemical, and real-world evidence within a continuously evolving Evidence Graph, ForgeTM generates scientifically traceable therapeutic hypotheses, evaluates competing biological explanations, optimizes candidate design, and produces regulatory-aware therapeutic asset dossiers ready for experimental validation.

Our vision is to establish a Scientific Engineering Operating System where intelligence does not replace scientists, it amplifies their ability to transform biological complexity into safer, smarter, and more effective therapeutics through evidence-driven engineering.

MesoBioTech is focusing  on  advanced stem cell devices, which is based on the fabrication of artificial basement membranes, made of monolayer of gelatin nanofibers and functioning proteins (culture patch). Tissue constructs of different types such as cardiac patch and neuronal networks could then be obtained by differentiating human induced pluripotent stem cells. Afterwards, these patches could be reversibly integrated in microfluidic devices to create organ on-a-chip and microphysiological systems, which have great importance for disease modeling, toxicity test, drug screening, as well as research in regenerative medicine. After fluidic treatments, the tissue patches could be removed for downstream analyses. Name: IMMUNOVA
Description:
Fondée en 2009, Immunova est une biotech spécialisée dans le développement de thérapies immunologiques innovantes visant à restaurer la tolérance immunitaire dans les maladies auto‐immunes sévères.

Notre mission est de dépasser les approches d’immunosuppression chronique en développant des stratégies capables de reprogrammer le système immunitaire de manière ciblée et durable.

 Depuis sa création, Immunova s’est concentrée sur l’ingénierie de thérapies immunomodulatrices de nouvelle génération. Notre premier succès clinique repose sur le développement d’une immunocytokine combinant un anticorps anti‐CD3 dérivé du teplizumab et une interleukine‐2 biaisée favorisant l’expansion des lymphocytes T régulateurs, aujourd’hui utilisée dans la prévention de la progression du diabète de type 1.

 Forte de cette expertise, Immunova développe désormais une nouvelle plateforme de reprogrammation immunitaire in vivo, reposant sur l’utilisation de nanoparticules lipidiques délivrant des ARNm thérapeutiques afin de générer directement dans l’organisme des cellules immunitaires programmées.

Notre programme phare actuel vise le traitement du lupus systémique sévère, grâce à une stratégie permettant la génération transitoire de cellules CAR‐T anti‐CD19 in vivo, avec l’ambition d’induire des rémissions immunologiques profondes tout en simplifiant considérablement la fabrication des thérapies cellulaires.

Aujourd’hui, Immunova poursuit une vision claire :
-> transformer la prise en charge des maladies auto‐immunes
-> développer des thérapies capables de restaurer l’équilibre immunitaire plutôt que de simplement supprimer l’inflammation

 Immunova – reprogramming immunity, remove pathology

Name: Gly-CRRET
Description: Our general objective is to understand the roles of sulfated glycosaminoglycans (GAGs), particularly heparan sulfates (HS) and chondroitin sulfates (CS), in the regulation of processes assuring the homeostasis of tissues or their degeneration. Depending on their sulfation patterns, GAGs can differently interact with a family of proteins known as “Heparin Binding Proteins” (HBPs), which includes growth factors, enzymes, receptors and several proteins involved in neurodegeneration. Many processes including wound healing, inflammation and tissue degeneration would be controlled by GAGs-proteins interactions. Knowing the roles of fine GAGs structures in the regulation of these processes is paramount for a better compression of pathologies. We aim to develop new glycobiology-based strategies able to restore tissue homeostasis, especially for pathologies for which new approaches are urgently needed.

Name: ViewPoint Water Biomonitoring
Description:
200,000 molecules are identified in the different families of emerging contaminants including heavy metals, pesticides, drug residues, solvents, etc that directly impact the quality of water bodies, natural environments, and human health.
So how do you preserve the quality of the water and detect micropollutants in the water to treat them?
Micropollutants in water often escape the analyzes permitted by Physico-chemical sensors because they are too numerous and present in very small quantities.
6 years of research in partnership with INRAE and 2 joint patents then made it possible to develop ToxMate, a biomonitoring station that detects micropollutants in water in real-time.

A water pollution alert station :

ToxMate is a water pollution alert station based on the behavioral analysis of 3 bioindicators representative of European natural environments: grammarian, leech, and freshwater snails.
the sensitivity of the 3 aquatic organisms to a wide range of chemicals makes it possible to signal the presence of micropollutants as soon as the species modify their behavior

A decision-making tool :

ToxMate is a connected alert station. Deployed in urban wastewater treatment plant, industrial wastewater treatment plant, and drinking water treatment plant.
It allows :

 - Instant detection of chemical substances in water by identifying abnormal behaviors signifying the presence of micropollutants or cocktail effects.

 - sending an immediate alert, on a computer or smartphone in the event of water pollution, allowing water treatment managers who then decide on the corrective actions to be implemented for the optimization of tertiary treatment or the control of water potable water.

Name: NEUROBIOMAT
Description:
SPINAL CORD INJURY
Spinal cord injury is a serious trauma that affects more than 2M people worldwide.  The spinal cord is made up of nerve bundles that receive voluntary motor commands from the brain to the limbs and it is through this channel that the perception of sensitivities is transmitted to the brain (touch, temperature, position, pain).  Disabilities can occur when an injury to the spinal cord damages the wiring responsible for transmitting these nerve impulses.  The trauma affects the motor and sensory functions of the patient and paralysis sets in without any possibility of full recovery or returning to one's physical state before the accident.  Today, there is currently no treatment to overcome this paralysis and restore nerve sensitivity or the ability to walk again.

INNOVATIVE NEUROTECHNOLOGY
NEUROBIOMAT (NBM) is a start-up resulting from pioneering works of R&D on biomaterials for neural tissue engineering carried out by Doctor Stéphane Woerly which aims to provide an innovative solution for repairing the damaged spinal cord. NBM has developed an implantable device - SPINEREP - intended for the functional repair of post-traumatic lesions of the spinal cord through a tissue engineering approach, by targeting the restoration of damaged nervous networks responsible for the transmission of nerve impulses.  NBM's know-how and intellectual property are based on a patented technology which shapes polymers into three-dimensional scaffolds. SPINEREP is a flexible and porous, biocompatible polymer biomaterial which, once positioned surgically at the level of the lesion, allows the regrowth of nerve fibers and their connections across the lesion cavity by playing the role of a growth-promoting template as well as neural tissue rebuilding.

Les vaccins ADN sont très performants avec 1 seule injection et ne nécessitent pas l’ajout d’adjuvants de synthèse, ce qui les rend particulièrement sains. Ils se conservent très bien à température de 2 – 8°C et à température ambiante, et sont très rentables (les couts de production de de distribution sont réduits). - Location:s R&D and Headquarters in Montpellier, South of France and worldwide network of scientists and experts.
- Alzheimer's disease is a neurodegenerative condition that causes a progressive deterioration of the brain, affecting mental functions over time. This represents the most common form of dementia, impairing memory, thinking and behavior. Risk of developing Alzheimer's disease increases with age, mainly affecting older people aged 65 and over. Thus, 10% of people over 65 are affected by Alzheimer's disease (!). This affects more than 44 million patients worldwide and this figure is expected to increase threefold in the coming years. 
- Alzheimer's disease is a major public health problem, but nevertheless:
* The exact causes of this disease are not well understood,
* No curative or preventive treatment exists to date (at best, new medications slightly slow progression)
- The fundamental axis of development of NBX is therefore to create a breakthrough research platform around the microbiome, to develop and market drugs to treat patients with Alzheimer's disease by addressing the causes of the disease and curing patients.

Availability will follow regulatory clearance.

Biotech Agora a pour vocation de faire découvrir au public spécialiste ou non spécialiste des sociétés dans le domaine des Biotechs et plus généralement dans le domaine des Sciences de la Vie qui offrent des innovations de rupture.

•	Accompagner les sociétés et étoffer leur actionnariat

Name: Affilogic
Description:
Affilogic is a private biotech company specialised in discovering and developing Nanofitins through early-stage collaborations with worldwide industry leaders in the pharmaceutical sector.

These affinity proteins are potent antibody-mimetics, exhibiting a high affinity and specificity for capture, targeting and interacting with biomolecules. Each Nanofitin is 20 times smaller than an antibody (7 kDa) and demonstrates hyper stability. Nanofitins are easily combined with each other, antibodies and other biomolecules by simple, rapid and proven methods to design an ideal targeted molecule.

Affilogic has designed Nanofitins against 60+ targets to date, including a wide range of circulating antigens (peptides, proteins), membrane receptors for inhibition / modulation (GPCR, ion channels) and complex entities (virus-like particles, bacteria, whole cells).
Location: Nantes, Pays de la Loire, France

Name: Lovaltech
Description: For a pandemic-free world

Name: Tafalgie Therapeutics
Description:
Tafalgie Therapeutics est une société spin-off du CNRS et d'AMU engagée dans la recherche biopharmaceutique et engagée dans le développement d'une nouvelle approche scientifique pour des traitements de nouvelle génération basés sur une innovation de rupture : un mécanisme d'action dérivé d'une protéine sécrétée endogène capable de moduler les signaux de la douleur.

Tafalgie Therapeutics souhaite devenir l'acteur de référence dans le domaine de la douleur, en concevant et en proposant de nouveaux principes actifs pharmaceutiques basés sur le développement de polypeptides dérivés de la TAFA4. 

Chez Tafalgie Therapeutics, nous visons à développer des traitements à long terme plus efficaces, mieux tolérés, sans accoutumance, pour soulager la douleur aiguë, qu'elle soit légère, modérée ou sévère, et pour prévenir la douleur chronique, et à délivrer ces traitements aux patients. A moyen terme, nous visons à conclure des accords de partenariat avec de grandes sociétés pharmaceutiques ou des distributeurs internationaux spécialisés capables de mettre sur le marché des produits basés sur la technologie TAFA4.

Name: SALVECO
Description:
Salveco invents non conventional, Bio-based, highly efficient clean & safe chemistry
Salveco redefine high-performance disinfection through unique, 100% Bio-based formulas. We replace toxic chemicals with patented smart chemistry to ensure a safe, sustainable future at competitive prices for our international partners. Competitive patented Bio-based formulas delivering high-performance hygiene for your brand.

We deliver international players with our patented technology for different B2B2B & B2B2C univers.

Our unique formulas offer differentiating environmental and safety claims in disinfection universe at competitive prices for different markets : Homecare, Healthcare, Hospitality and Facilities, Food&Beverages, Animalcare. 
Mitigate risks and accelerate your go-to-market with our deep regulatory expertise, replacing toxics with smart, high-performance sustainable science.

A Unique Patented Technology where high performance and sustainability converge
Pioneer in Bio-based chemistry and a portfolio of global patents, Salveco research teams have engineered a unique generation of disinfectant technologies.
Our proprietary formulations leverage Bio-derived active ingredients to deliver a broad spectrum of activity, ensuring a 99.99% kill rate against highly resistant pathogens*.
Engineered for clinical and industrials environments where high-level hygiene is non-negotiable, our solutions meet the strictest European Standards (e.g.: EN 1276, EN 1650, EN 14476)*, proving lethal across the full microbial spectrum: bacteria, yeasts and enveloped or non-enveloped viruses.
We don’t just follow regulations; we define the new standard for sustainable, full-spectrum efficacy and industrial-grade disinfection.

Skip years of R&D and administrative hurdles : Leverage our extensive portfolio of 220+ Simplified Market Authorizations (SMAs).
We handle the regulatory complexity so you can launch your product line in 4/6 months.

Name: BEAM Alliance
Description:
BEAM (Biotech companies in Europe combating AntiMicrobial Resistance) represents European small and medium-sized biotech companies involved in developing innovative products to tackle antimicrobial resistance, including preventative and curating therapies, and diagnostic tests.
BEAM gives its members a unique voice to propose and support policies and incentives in antimicrobial research and development in Europe.
BEAM recommends bold incentives that warrant action by policymakers to stimulate much needed innovation.

Name: Agaris
Description: We are a leading producer and supplier of growing media (also known as substrates or potting soil), soil improvers and soil covers for ornamental plant cultivation, vegetable and fruit growing and urban green. We give our customers advice on the best product, and each time formulate a product tailored to their specific needs. Agaris Horti has 8 production plants, which means we always produce near to our customers and respond to their needs with alacrity.

Name: Waiv, formerly Owkin Dx
Description:
Waiv exists to catalyze precision medicine with clinical-grade, AI-powered tests that accelerate biomarker discovery and detection, outcome prediction, and treatment-response assessment across oncology.

Built on over seven years of validated medical-AI innovation and one of Europe’s largest multi-institutional data networks, Waiv delivers precise, accurate, and fast analyses that support treatment decisions. Waiv collaborates with global pharmaceutical companies, research institutions, diagnostic organizations and healthcare systems to bring scalable precision medicine to patients worldwide.

Waiv is backed by OTB Ventures and Alpha Intelligence Capital (AIC), with participation from Serena Data Ventures, Karista, SistaFund, and CRB Health Tech, with an initial financing of $35 million dollars to expand its clinical testing solutions and fuel commercial expansion.

Name: C4Diagnostics
Description:
C4Diagnostics is a French-based biotech specialized in the development of in vitro diagnostic (IVD) tests for human infectious diseases 
C4Diagnostics' strategy for the better management of Human infectious diseases, is to develop game changing IVD tests which are significantly faster than standard methods whilst maintaining comparable or better performance. 
Its portfolio currently focuses on the diagnosis of Covid-19 (C4Covid-19), Legionnaires’ Disease (C4Legio LFA), urinary tract infections (C4UTI) and the development of antimicrobial susceptibility tests (C4AST). 

C4Diagnostics also has a business unit dedicated to environmental diagnostics, called C4Environment. It provides services for the detection of SARS-CoV-2 and other pathogens in the environment (wastewater, air, surface) and has contributed to several Covid-19 surveillance and prevention campaigns since the beginning of the pandemic.

With its rapid and highly sensitive IVD tests, C4Diagnostics ambitions to become one of the main actors in the diagnosis of human infectious diseases field, by giving medical labs and healthcare professionals sensible and reliable diagnostic information in a timely manner.

The game changing diagnostic solutions developed by C4Diagnostics are a leverage to fight against antibiotic resistance and curb infectious disease epidemics.

contact@C4Diagnostics.com

Name: Paris Biofoundry
Description:
The Paris Biofoundry is a pioneering research platform that unites the expertise and cutting-edge technology of several prestigious institutions in the Île-de-France region, including Sorbonne Université, Université Paris Cité and Université Paris-Saclay, the Institut Micalis and Institut Curie, the Genopole cluster, and the CNRS, INSERM and INRAE institutions. This collaborative initiative aims to accelerate the field of synthetic biology, enabling the development of advanced biotechnologies and innovative solutions in health, environment, and industry.

The Paris Biofoundry specializes in the engineering of biological systems at large scales. State-of-the-art infrastructure enables designing, building and testing of thousands of genetically engineered chassis in parallel. These resources enable scientists to conduct large-scale experiments with unprecedented precision and efficiency, fostering advancements in areas such as gene editing, fundamental gene characterization, protein production and improvement, and metabolic engineering.

The Biofoundry also plays a critical role in education and training, offering specialized programs for students and researchers. By providing access to its facilities and fostering a collaborative environment, the platform helps to cultivate the next generation of leaders in synthetic biology and related fields. In addition to its scientific contributions, the Paris Biofoundry actively engages with industry partners to translate research findings into practical applications, or to co-develop R&D projects. This collaboration ensures that innovations developed within the Biofoundry have a tangible impact, contributing to the growth of the biotechnology sector in the region and beyond.

Overall, the Paris Biofoundry stands at the forefront of the bioconvergence revolution, driving forward the integration of biological engineering and data science to address some of the most pressing challenges of our time.

Name: BIOMUNEX PHARMACEUTICALS
Description:
BIOMUNEX Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery and development of breakthrough immunotherapies using its Unique BiXAb technology to create next generation bi- and multi-specific antibodies.
Our disruptive biological approaches target a number of cancer types, in particular where there are unmet medical needs. We are committed  to provide oncologists and patients with immunotherapies that are novel, efficacious and prolong life expectancy.

Name: GL BIOCONTROL
Description:
For more than 10 years, GL BIOCONTROL is specialized in environmental risk management and is expert in sanitary engineering along with biological monitoring of water and surfaces. 
Our company offers innovative ATP-metry and qPCR tools for monitoring water, surface and air quality. Our ATP-metry kits, commercialized worldwide, are the most powerful on the market in terms of sensitivity, reliability, easiness to use and rapidity. With a large range of products, our ATP-metry reagents can be used on drinking water as well as on cooling water, process water or domestic hot water for example. 
Discover all our products and related applications on our website: www.gl-biocontrol.com/en
With a strong background in risk management, GL BIOCONTROL also offers its expertise and training to water sector professionals. 
Do not hesitate to contact us for more information.

Name: Kapsera
Description:
Our Mission:
Kapsera pioneers cutting-edge natural formulations that empower sustainable agriculture, enrich human nutrition, and improve animal health through innovative biosolutions and feed additives.

Name: FLUOPTICS Part of Getinge
Description:
Fluoptics is a young and innovative company in the field of fluorescence imaging for both clinical and preclinical applications. In clinics, Fluoptics develops solutions to optically guide cancer surgery. This approach is based on an intra-operative near infra-red fluorescence detector and fluorescent probes which specifically target tumors. This technology, extensively tested on animals, drastically improves cancer surgery in providing surgeons with an acute delineation of cancerous nodules during the surgery. 

Fluoptics develops and markets the Fluobeam, a unique fluorescence imaging system with an open design and an excellent sensitivity in the near infra-red spectrum. The company also proposes near infra-red molecular probes AngioStampTM for tumors and angiogenesis, and SentiDyeTM for vascular networks and lymphatic drainage. The instrument, as well as the probes, helps in understanding disease mechanisms and in developing new therapies.

Name: SPYGEN
Description:
Created in 2011, SPYGEN is a "Mission lead company" that aims to improve the monitoring and conservation of aquatic and terrestrial biodiversity worldwide, through the study of environmental DNA (eDNA). 

SPYGEN has been certified B Corp since 2018, and has been a member of the french "Community of Companies with a Mission" since 2020. 

The company's headquarters are located in Le Bourget du Lac (Savoie - France).

Name: DELBON
Description:
DELBON is a French company specialized in the conception and the manufacture of innovative biotechnology solutions for agriculture. 
The production of plant-based amino acids and the multiplication of microorganisms have been the foundation of our company since 1991. 
We offer effective and high-performance solutions, tailored to specific needs, for all crops and soil types, through a diverse range of biostimulants, nutrient solutions, natural adjuvants, biocontrol, and soil regenerators.

Name: DelleD - LaFleur
Description:
Créé en 2014 par un patient, DelleD développe les Laboratoires LaFleur, les premiers laboratoires pharmaceutiques Français spécialisés dans le cannabis médical & hortimind, une solution de production végétal assistée par l'IA.

LaFleur a pour but de promouvoir la recherche et le développement du cannabis médical en France et à l'international  et de défendre l'évolution du cadre légal relatif à la production, la culture et l'usage du cannabis à usage médical.

Les laboratoires cultivent, transforment, contrôlent et fabriquent des médicaments à base de cannabis médical dans le cadre de la recherche et développement, en France.

Expert du végétal en santé, les laboratoires utilisent la solution hortimind pour l'optimisation de la culture du cannabis médical afin de réduire la consommation d'intrants dans une démarche éco-responsable. L'objectif étant de produire de manière efficiente, il ne s'agit de produire plus à tout prix, mais de produire mieux avec moins.

La solution hortimind est aussi commercialisée pour la R&D et la production de végétaux alimentaires et non alimentaires en environnement contrôlé.

#MadeinFrance #Patients #VegetalEnSanté #Industrie #Ecoresponsable #RSE
Location: Angers, Pays de la Loire, France

Name: WENEOS
Description:
Since 1999, WENEOS has been the center specialized in the evaluation of the sun protection of cosmetic products. We have developed the Helioplate PMMA Molded HD6 and Sablés SB6 substrates which comply with the standards in force (ISO, FDA, etc.) for the in vitro evaluation of sunscreen products. The laboratory offers many tests to evaluate the sun protection of your products and meet your needs: official tests according to the latest methods and standards in force (ISO 24443:2021, FDA 2021), packs combining in vitro and in vivo evaluations (ISO 24444:2019), as well as specific methods (Blue Light, Infrared, Sand Resistance, etc.).
Contact us: commercial@weneos.com

Name: APHA BIOMAT
Description:
Apha Biomat is part of the Ph Tech group, together with Meccellis Biotech (expert in biologics for Soft Tissue repair).
Apha Biomat’s new industrial facility will support Xenopha’s manufacturing operations, alongside with Meccellis.
Xenopha is the result of an intensive R&D program aiming at combining Meccellis’ expertise in biologics with a new biopolymer:P4HB. This hybrid combination allows for the design of natural 3D medical devices. Xenopha’s first indication is dedicated to breast reconstruction where a solution to replace silicon is eagerly awaited by patients and surgeons.

For any further information, please feel free to contact us: 
E-mail: fabien.dolbeau@aphabiomat.com / anthony.peres@aphabiomat.com

Name: CHROMagar Microbiology
Description:
CHROMagar is the inventor and pioneer of chromogenic media technology, revolutionizing microbial detection and identification since 1979. 
Driven by innovation, our mission is always to develop rapid and reliable solutions that meet both current and future challenges in infection diagnosis and microbial control. 
We offer the most extensive range of chromogenic culture media for applications in clinical bacteriology, industrial microbiology, food and beverage quality control,
water testing, and environmental monitoring.

Name: Polaris
Description: POLARIS, expert in innovative nutritional lipids, offers a range of health ingredients and high-valued custom manufacturing activity. POLARIS is specialized in production and formulation of Polyunsaturated Fatty Acids especially Omega-3 from marine and algal origin under the brand Omegavie.

Name: TargEDys
Description:
TargEDys is a French commercial-stage biotech company specialized in the development of precision probiotics, or PreciBiomic solutions. Our mission is to detect, transpose and make available microbiome-based innovations to answer global public health challenges.
How? By translating microbiome fundamental research from prestigious French institutes such as the Inserm and IGFL to applied research in probiotics, understanding the molecular mechanism of action of our strains, and developing industrial processes and IP to propose turnkey science-backed probiotics.
Our vision is to bring the microbiome to the heart of healthcare and harvest its immense potential to improve the quality of life through appetite regulation, nutritional optimization, and mental wellness.

Name: Plan France Médecine Génomique 2025
Description: La médecine génomique est en train de changer profondément la prise en charge des patients. Pour s’assurer que chacun puisse accéder aux nouvelles technologies de manière équitable sur tout le territoire, la France met en place un plan : le plan France médecine génomique 2025. Il vise à faire évoluer à l’horizon de 2025 la façon de diagnostiquer, prévenir, et soigner les patients.

Name: Meccellis Biotech
Description:
Meccellis Biotech is a company expert in Tissue and Cell Engineering with a diversified offer for multiple surgical specialties. After 7 years of marketing, Meccellis Biotech is now present in 25 countries. The passion and professionalism of its teams have made of Meccellis Biotech, a reference company for the manufacturing of biomaterials. 

For any further information you may need regarding our range of biologic implants, please feel free to contact us: contact@meccellis.com - Phone number: +33 (0) 5 17 81 07 63 - THE MECCELLIS BIOTECH TEAM

Name: Food Microbiology Solutions
Description:
Welcome to the Food Microbiology Solutions page ! We are dedicated to bringing you the latest news and insights in the field of food microbiology. Our focus is on providing innovative solutions for quality control laboratories, ensuring food safety and maintaining high standards in the industry. Join us to stay updated on industry trends, best practices, and cutting-edge technologies. Explore our posts for informative articles, expert tips, and exciting visuals from our dedicated team members. Let's collaborate and advance the field of food microbiology together!
