Name: SeaBeLife Biotech
Description: We develop small molecules that inhibit regulated necrosis using an original mechanism of action. Regulated necrosis is one of the recently identified pathophysiological factors in many diseases with severe outcomes. The technical, therapeutic and economic potential is major. Our activity focuses on the development of drugs inhibiting regulated necrosis, from the selection of the molecule to the proof of efficacy in the patient. We focus on acute and orphan diseases because preclinical and clinical development is facilitated, allowing proof of concept (POC) to be provided in humans more quickly. We have selected a lead molecule which is currently under preclinical development to treat acute kidney injury (AKI) induced by anti-cancer treatments (such as cisplatin) and to treat acute liver failure (ALF) induced by paracetamol poisoning. We have already identified molecules in our pipeline for which we obtained in cellulo POC in Neurodegenerative diseases and AMD.

Name: Upcyclink
Description: Upcyclink transforms production line waste, offcuts and side streams into high value ingredients with on-site solutions. Through partnership agreements Upcyclink are both suppliers of upcycled ingredients and buyers of raw material waste that can be transformed and upcycled through in-situ solutions.

Name: VERDOT
Description:
VERDOT, established in 1950 and headquartered in Riom, France, stands at the forefront of downstream bioprocessing technology. VERDOT provides innovative single-use and stainless steel purification solutions for the biopharmaceutical industry, including chromatography columns and skids as well as tangential flow filtration (TFF) systems. Ranging from standard to highly customized designs, VERDOT systems and columns are employed in the purification, separation and concentration of biomolecules such as monoclonal antibodies, vaccines, viral vectors (e.g., AAV and lentivirus), and mRNA-based therapeutics.

VERDOT serves a diverse customer base, including research and development, early-stage biotech, biopharma, and contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs) in all stages of the drug development workflow from exploration through the manufacturing of commercially available biologics. VERDOT’s tailored, high-quality purification technologies empower their customers to accelerate time-to-market of groundbreaking and cost-effective therapies.

For more information about VERDOT, visit www.verdot-biotechnologies.com

Name: GreenTropism
Description: Fin d’activité mai 2024

Name: Step Pharma
Description:
Step Pharma is the world leader in the discovery and development of inhibitors of CTPS1 (cytidine triphosphate synthase 1) for the treatment of cancer and autoimmune diseases. 
Step Pharma’s lead program dencatistat (STP938) is a first in class, potent, selective, oral inhibitor of CTPS1 with demonstrated anti-tumor activity. Dencatistat entered clinical development in 2022 in a PhI/II study for the treatment of relapsed and refractory T-cell and B-cell lymphoma. More recently a solid tumour study was started focused on ovarian cancer using the concept of synthetic lethality and biomarker selection of patients. This can ultimately be viewed as a tumour agnostic approach with ovarian cancer being the PoC indication and future plans to expand into other tumour types such as NSCLC with high prevalence of the biomarker.

Name: METAFORA biosystems
Description:
At Metafora, we develop innovative and impactful AI-powered cytometry & cell metabolism profiling solutions. 

We are passionate about cell biology.

We leverage our unique cell metabolism and AI-powered data analysis platforms to turn disruptive single-cell technologies into impactful solutions that improve human health.

Name: Peekcell
Description: With an urine sample, Peekcell allows women cancers' screening with an innovative technology that analyses biomarkers. The test is painless, non-invasive and permits a precise detection thanks to an artificial intelligence algorithm.

Name: BYOME LABS
Description: Our R&D center, located in the heart of the Cosmetic Valley in Chartres, focuses on analyzing the compatibility of cosmetic products with the skin. Our microbiology laboratory assists our clients in scientific expertise, marketing communication of claims, and helps R&D scientifically substantiate claims. It stands out for its commitment to innovation, combining industrial and technological expertise to advance knowledge and expertise on the microbiome for cosmetics.
Location: Le Coudray, Centre-Val de Loire, France

Name: Skinosive
Description:
Skinosive is a science-driven dermo-cosmetics biotechnology company developing a technology platform in skin photoprotection. Skinosive’s technology enables long-acting skin UV protections and effective sunscreens that prevent chemicals from being absorbed into the skin and the bloodstream. This innovation aims to reduce drastically cancer and skin damages due to the sun exposure. The company is located in Paris and in Marseille. 

Skinosive Headquarter : 12-14 rue Jean Antoine de Baïf 75013 Paris
Skinosive Lab : 60 avenue André Roussin 13016 Marseille

Name: ErVimmune
Description: Targeting shared unconventional tumor antigens in cancer immunotherapy

Name: IABS - International Alliance for Biological Standardization
Description:
The International Alliance for Biological Standardization is an independent, nonprofit scientific organization located in Geneva, Switzerland with about 250 members in over 50 countries. Operational offices are in Lyon, France.
IABS vision: Health Solutions for everyone everywhere. 
IABS missions: 
#1 To bring biologicals stakeholders together
Our strength is to bring together private industry, academia and regulatory agencies to conduct scientific discussions on a global scale.
#2 To facilitate consensus
Our collaborative events, such as conferences and workshops, guide decision-making and accelerate the standardization of biological products.
#3 To share scientific advancements
We contribute to the improvement and innovation of biological products, through our Journal Biologicals and the website .
IABS' role and strength reside in its ability to bring together interested parties for scientific discussions of important unresolved or emerging issues and to assist in developing a consensus with an action plan to achieve regulatory progress. This strategy has led to significant gains in both the human and veterinary fields, and it differentiates lABS conferences from most scientific meetings that focus simply on the exchange of information. Our activities contribute to faster global access to new vaccines for human and animal health. We have worked successfully with, and have supplemented the activities of, WH0, FDA, USDA, NIAID, EMA, and OIE.
For more information, please visit our website at www.iabs.org

Name: HCS Pharma
Description: By court decision dated May 16, 2024, the company SAS HCS Pharma was placed in liquidation and its business assets were transferred to the company SAS NETRI, following the order of the Commercial Court of Lille Metropole dated October 30, 2024.

Name: Alvéole
Description:
Created from work carried out by three research experts, Alvéole’s goal is to make the control of living cells the future of cell biology.
A company specialized in devices for controlling the cellular microenvironment, Alvéole presents its first device PRIMO.

Alvéole was founded in 2010 by three researchers from CNRS* in collaboration with Quattrocento, a “creator of young innovative companies” in the life sciences field that allows academic researchers to transform their inventions into commercial products.

Vincent Studer (a specialist in bio-engineering), Maxime Dahan (a specialist in cell imaging), and Jean-Christophe Galas (a specialist in nanostructures) have collaborated since 2008 to develop tools for research in cell biology. In 2010, Quattrocento founded Alvéole, with their collaboration.

*Vincent Studer, the Neurosciences Interdisciplinary Institute (CNRS, University of Bordeaux).
Maxime Dahan, the Curie Physics and Chemistry Unit, (CNRS, Curie Institute, Pierre and Marie Curie University).
Jean-Christophe Galas, the Jean Perrin Laboratory, (CNRS, Pierre and Marie Curie University).

Name: InSpek
Description:
Biomanufacturing is scaling. Analytics are not.
InSpek brings real-time molecular visibility into bioprocesses across biomanufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and industrial biotech.

The problem: Most processes still rely on intermittent sampling, offline analysis, and delayed feedback. This creates blind spots: deviations detected too late, scale-up failures, batch losses costing millions.

What we do: Our integrated sensing systems provide continuous, in-line molecular monitoring directly inside bioreactors. Teams get high-frequency data on metabolites, process conditions, and molecular dynamics.

The impact:
- Detect deviations hours earlier
- 20-80% yield improvements
- Reduce batch risk and development time
- Scale from bench to production with confidence

Who we serve:
- Bioprocessing & biomanufacturing
- Pharmaceutical manufacturing
- Process development & scale-up
- Industrial biotech & precision fermentation

The future: We are building the sensing infrastructure behind data-driven biomanufacturing with a roadmap toward multi-parameter sensing, integrated interpretation, and intelligent process optimization.

Name: Inotrem
Description:
Inotrem is a French biopharmaceutical company founded in 2013, with offices in Paris and a technology center in Nancy (France).

Our mission is to improve public health by developing a new class of therapeutic solutions targeting the immunological pathway TREM-1 with a personalized medicine approach to manage life-threatening inflammatory syndromes with high unmet medical need. TREM-1 is a key amplifier of inflammatory responses implicated in various diseases such as septic shock, vaso-occlusive crisis in sickle cell disease, or hemorrhagic shock.

Our lead drug candidate nangibotide has shown promising results in Phase II trials for septic shock and severe COVID-19. Nangibotide is developed along with a proprietary Companion Diagnostic platform in partnership with Roche Diagnostics, to identify patients who would benefit most from our therapy. Nangibotide restores a balanced inflammatory response and improves outcomes particularly in patients with high levels of the soluble TREM-1 biomarker, a marker of TREM-1 activation. The regulatory path to registration in septic shock for nangibotide has been secured with major health authorities, and it has been granted EMA’s PRIority Medicine (PRIME) scheme, and Fast Track status by the FDA in that indication.

Name: Wildtype One
Description:
** For researchers whose cells changed, but still don’t know why **

 Wildtype One helps life-science researchers make better bench decisions when their data gets weird.

Not every non-significant result means there is no biology.

• Sometimes the statistics need fixing.
• Sometimes the experiment is fragile.
• Sometimes the readout is too narrow.
• Sometimes the tool is answering the wrong question.

We write about the messy decisions researchers face around ugly data, reproducibility, cell culture, Western blot, flow cytometry, qPCR, imaging, readout choice, and experimental interpretation.

The goal is simple:

Help scientists decide whether the problem is statistics, biology, measurement, or the wrong readout—before they waste months repeating the wrong experiment.

 Join 1,000+ researchers reading the free Wildtype Weekly newsletter:
wildtypeone.substack.com/about

Name: i-SEP
Description:
Fondée en 2015 à Nantes, i-SEP est une medtech spécialisée dans l'autotransfusion peropératoire et la gestion du sang des patients. Chez i-SEP, nous avons développé, breveté et commercialisons désormais une technologie innovante de récupération et de séparation des composants sanguins.

En collaboration avec nos cliniciens, nous développons des solutions uniques de gestion du sang des patients pour améliorer les avantages pour les patients et les parties prenantes.

Nous travaillons en étroite collaboration avec des cliniciens spécialisés dans le but d’améliorer les avantages pour les patients, de simplifier le flux de travail des médecins et de contribuer à réduire les coûts des soins de santé.

Notre innovation apporte une valeur ajoutée significative par rapport aux solutions actuellement disponibles, notamment en termes de qualité du sang.

i-SEP a été co-fondée par trois associés :
Dr Francis Gadrat, médecin anesthésiste, Bertrand Chastenet, ancien chef d’entreprise et consultant dans l'industrie pharmaceutique, conseiller du commerce extérieur de la France, et Sylvain Picot, fondateur de Biom’Up. i-SEP est accompagnée par Atlanpole et membre du pôle de compétitivité Atlanpole Biothérapies.
------
Founded in 2015 in Nantes (Upper Britany, France), i-SEP is a medtech specialized in intraoperative autotransfusion and Patient Blood Management. At i-SEP, we have developed, patented and now markets an innovative technology for the recovery and separation of blood components.

Together with our clinicians, we develop unique Patient Blood Management solutions for improved patient & stakeholder benefits.

We work closely with specialized clinicians with the aim of improving patient benefits, simplifying physicians’ workflow and helping reduce healthcare cost.

Our innovation brings significant added value compared to currently available solutions, particularly in terms of blood quality.
Location: Nantes, Pays de la Loire, France

Name: MyLab
Description:
Né de l'union de LILLAB (Châteaugiron-35) et URCIL (Carhaix-29), deux entreprises reconnues pour leur savoir-faire et leur fiabilité, LABORATOIRE MYLAB se positionne aujourd'hui parmi les principaux laboratoires d'analyses de la filière laitière à l'échelle européenne.

Situé au cœur du bassin laitier de l'ouest, doté d'expertises et de technologies de pointe, LABORATOIRE MYLAB est à même de développer sa qualité de service et d'innovation au service des producteurs, coopératives laitières et industriels privés en toute indépendance.

Si l'activité d'analyses du lait et des produits laitiers reste sa principale mission, ses domaines d'expertises s'étendent également aux analyses d'eaux et de santé animale.

Name: BrainEver
Description:
BrainEver is a biopharmaceutical company developing a pipeline of novel therapies for patients with age-related neurodegenerative diseases, such as Charcot disease, Parkinson’s, and glaucoma, the second leading cause of blindness.

Our mission is to develop recombinant human Homeoproteins (HPs) to halt disease progression by stopping neuronal loss and durably restoring the physiology and metabolism of the remaining neurons.

BrainEver was co-founded by Bernard Gilly (iBionext) and Alain Prochiantz (Collège de France). Our innovative therapeutic approach stems from the pioneering work of Alain Prochiantz and his team on brain development and physiology.

Our lead project, BREN02, focuses on developing recombinant human Engrailed-1 (hEN1) for the treatment of patients with Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS).

Building on the highly promising results of our preclinical studies, we are preparing to launch clinical trials by 2025. 

Follow us!

Name: ACOBIOM
Description:
Acobiom is specialized in the identification of new Biomarkers and in the development of innovative Diagnostics in Translational Research and Precision Medicine.

The company provides also customized services in genomics, transcriptomics, bioinformatics and biostatistics (data science), thanks to its technology platform and its scientific expertise.

For more information about Acobiom, please contact the company by email: busdev@acobiom.com, or visit its website: www.acobiom.com.

Name: BioHive
Description:
Based in the heart of Genopole, BioHive is at the forefront of innovation in biotechnology, specializing in the research and development of skin organoid models derived from induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs).

We provide advanced solutions to the pharmaceutical and cosmetic industries to better understand the molecular interactions with human skin. Our models reduce reliance on animal testing while enhancing the precision of toxicity and efficacy analyses.

Our mission: To deliver predictive and physiologically relevant in vitro models, driving innovation in dermatological and therapeutic care.

Name: CarbonWorks
Description: CarbonWorks is developing an innovative and versatile photobioreactor to unlock the industrial exploitation of microalgae. Our technology enables the cost-effective production of various microalgae biomasses.

Name: Overseed
Description:
Overseed is the first French biotech company to obtain its license from the ANSM to start its R&D process on cannabis production for pharmaceutical purposes. 

We are a Biotech which combines leading expertise in genetics, agronomy, organic chemistry and pharma with the ambition to have an expert knowledge on the production of therapeutic cannabis. We will produce GACP and GMP certified dried flowers, full spectrum extracts and purified pharmaceutical grade active ingredients for laboratories.

Overseed's research and experimentation will answer patients and the health industry expectations to guarantee production sovereignty, proximity of collaborations and certified quality of cultivated products, in direct connection with medical and scientific studies.

Patient-driven, the culture of Overseed is based on people, product quality and value creation.

Name: Adebiotech
Description:
Le Think Tank indépendant des Biotechnologies et du ONE HEALTH en France, Adebiotech regroupe des experts industriels et académiques ainsi que des représentants des pouvoirs publics nationaux et régionaux.

Fort du plus grand réseau transdisciplinaire français des sciences du vivant, Adebiotech valorise les biotechnologies et leurs applications en France, en Europe et à l’International.

Les interventions d’Adebiotech peuvent s’effectuer de manière transversale dans tous les champs d’application des biotechnologies, santé humaine et animale, environnement, énergie, agro-alimentaire, procédés et filières industriels en encourageant le développement durable par l’usage raisonné des techniques du vivant.

Name: Laboratoire Microsept
Description:
Le laboratoire MICROSEPT vous accompagne pour assurer la qualité de vos produits. Basée au Lion d’Angers (Maine et Loire), notre équipe met son savoir-faire à votre disposition pour la réalisation d’analyses microbiologiques sous accréditation COFRAC (portée disponible sur www.cofrac.fr) et peut également vous apporter des solutions, conseil et formation sur l’hygiène et la qualité.

MICROSEPT, LABORATOIRE EXPERT ! depuis le 13 novembre 2017 auprès d’AFNOR Certification pour la réalisation d’études de validation de méthodes d’analyses microbiologiques dans les produits d’alimentation humaine et animale et les échantillons d'environnement de production selon la norme ISO 16140-2 : 2016.

Fabricant reconnu de méthodes d’analyse ou start-up développant une nouvelle technique de détection ou de dénombrement, notre équipe vous renseigne et vous oriente dans votre projet de certification pour obtenir la marque NF Validation, gage de performance de votre méthode.
Location: Le Lion-d’Angers, Pays de la Loire, France

Name: BIOMANITY
Description:
The one and only universal Super Absorbent /// 100% biodegradable, biosourced, circular and microplastic-free /// BIOMANITY is a Young Innovative Company based in France, which is developing a revolutionary innovation:

- A product that absorbs 500 times its weight in water.
- Replaces petrochemical super absorbents in over 1000 uses such as cosmetics, hygiene or the environment.
- Reduces water consumption in agriculture by 50%.
- Doubles crop yields without fertilizers or inputs.

More infos : contact@biomanity.com

Name: Biopredic International
Description:
Biopredic International is committed to support Life Science Research by developing and distributing biological tools. We assist both academia and industries in drug development, drug discovery, cosmetic and chemical fields. 

Biopredic International delivers assays, tissues, cells and reagents including:
> High quality hepatocytes (human and animal, fresh or cryopreserved) and other liver-derived products  (microsomes, S9 fractions and cytosols)
> Skin products (fresh or frozen), including human skin discs and skin sheets (full thickness, dermatomed, stratum corneum), skin cells (keratinocytes, fibroblasts), subcellular fractions...
> Blood products, including whole blood, sera, plasma, PBMCs, lymphocytes, monocytes, dendritic cells, CD34...
> And other products such as biofluids (bile, gastric & intestinal fluids), non-standard human and animal tissues
 
Applications include:
- toxicology
- genotoxicity
- metabolism
- passage
- bioanalysis
- and tranporter analysis.
 
Biopredic International is also the exclusive worldwide licensor of HepaRG, the human hepatic stem cell line patented by the French National Instituteof Health and Medical Research.

Google+: https://plus.google.com/+BiopredicInternationalSaintGrégoire/posts
Twitter: https://twitter.com/Biopredic_Intl

To apply for a position at Biopredic International please send your CV and cover letter to recrutement[at]biopredic.com

Name: Imavita
Description:
Imavita is an innovating technology company dedicated to the exploration of pre-clinical models of human pathologies by the use of innovating imaging techniques and image analysis.
Imavita intends to propose to pharmaceutical industries, biotechnology companies and other private & public laboratories, innovating solutions in efficacy / toxicity evaluation of active ingredients in laboratory species by the use of non invasive imaging techniques and appropriate imaging analysis for quantitative evaluation of specific imaging biomarkers.

Imavita actually proposes the following tools:
- Pre-clinical testing in laboratory species (induction of pathologies / treatment & sampling phases)
- Imaging techniques in vivo non invasive or ex vivo using SPECT/CT, Dual Energy CT, MRI, ultrasonography and more
- Images exploitation and analysis for quantitative imaging

Imavita focus its activities in the following domains:
- Cardiovascular diseases
- Oncology
- Osteo-articular pathologies
- Neurology
- Dermatology
- Drug disposition / PK

Name: Emulseo
Description:
Emulseo is a startup company dedicated to the design and production of high-quality formulations for microfluidic applications. 
Our service is based upon long-term know-how and expertise in the field of microfluidics for pharmaceutical, biotech and chemical industry. 
Check out our website to discover our choice of fluorinated surfactants, fluorinated oils, surface treatments and many more products to come!
Whatever your application, we have a dedicated team of scientists focused on working closely with you to provide products and custom-made solutions of the highest quality and guide you through your projects.

Name: Biowest
Description:
Every experiment depends on the quality of its inputs. Inconsistent animal-derived sera or unreliable cell culture media can jeopardise months of research  and no scientist should have to deal with that. 
 
At Biowest, our mission is simple: help researchers and manufacturers work in complete confidence backed by consistent and reproducible quality cell culture products. 

Whether our customers are developing life-saving vaccines, advancing stem cell research or running critical in vitro diagnostics, we are here to support them with fully traceable products, across a range of over 200 references of sera, cell culture media and reagents. 

Founded in 1987, Biowest joined the SeraScandia group in 2004 and became the first vertically integrated serum company, thus controlling the entire value chain, from raw material collection worldwide to the final shipment of every bottle, through a network of more than 100 trusted distribution partners around the world. This commitment to quality is reflected in our ISO 9001 and ISO 13485 certifications. 

The result? A fully traceable range with no blind spots. 

For nearly 40 years, this unique model has allowed us to establish ourselves as one of the European leaders in serum collection and processing, offering the widest fully traceable range available on the market.  

 As a human-sized company, we've grown while keeping what matters most: a trusted environment for our teams and our customers alike. Our expert teams are here to advise you, find tailored solutions to your specific needs and support you at every stage of your project. 

 We make sure your cell cultures keep up.  

Discover our solutions.
Location: Nuaillé, Pays De La Loire, France

Name: BIOPASS
Description:
Le consortium BIORCELL 3D regroupe des chercheurs en Biologie et Pharmaco chimie de l’équipe de Recherche de l’Université Clermont Auvergne (63) et des spécialistes de l'industrie des Biotechnologies issus des sociétés BIOPASS et BIOMARQUEURS (63). Ensemble, nous développons et commercialisons des outils de biotechnologie innovants appliqués à la Cancérologie et à la Santé Humaine. 

BIOPASS développe et commercialise des milieux de culture complets et synthétiques (milieux sans sérum) permettant d’optimiser la culture d’un large panel de type cellulaires (sains ou tumoraux) en 2D et en 3D. Notre gamme permet également la conservation de prélèvements biologiques sans congélation et sur plusieurs jours (GAMME DE MILIEUX OPTIPASS )


Retrouvez notre gamme de produits sur le catalogue Dominique Dutscher : https://www.dutscher.com

Name: Urosphere
Description: UROSPHERE is a leading Contract Research Organization specializing in preclinical urogenital, gastro-intestinal and oncological pharmacology studies. We provide the pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical industries with a unique experimental research platform combining both in vivo models and in vitro assays on human and animal tissues.

Name: Sangamo Therapeutics France
Description:
Sangamo Therapeutics France is the French subsidiary of Sangamo Therapeutics Inc. 

Sangamo Therapeutics, Inc. is focused on translating ground-breaking science into genomic medicines with the potential to transform patients' lives using gene therapy, ex vivo gene-edited cell therapy, in vivo genome editing, and gene regulation. For more information about Sangamo, visit www.sangamo.com.

Sangamo Therapeutics France was formerly TxCell and was acquired by Sangamo Q4 2018.

Name: Laboratoire COSDERMA
Description:
Depuis plus de 15 ans, COSDERMA est spécialisé dans l’évaluation de l’Efficacité des produits cosmétiques, cosméto-textiles, compléments alimentaires, produits dermo-cosmétiques ou dispositifs médicaux.

 Nous nous distinguons par notre expertise avec des équipements exclusifs, une équipe de haut niveau scientifique et des protocoles spécifiques répondant à vos besoins.

 Nos études sont réalisées dans un environnement clinique approprié conforme à la réglementation en vigueur. L’expertise de COSDERMA et l’attention que nous portons à la qualité de la conduite de vos études sont reconnues par les professionnels de ce secteur.

Par l’implantation marquée de nos laboratoires en France,   COSDERMA Bordeaux, et à l’international en Chine à Wuhan, COSDERMA CHINA certifié CMA, un large panel de volontaires caucasiens et asiatiques est mis à votre disposition pour évaluer vos produits cosmétiques. 

For over 15 years, COSDERMA has specialised in assessing the efficacy of cosmetic products, cosmetotextiles, food supplements, dermo-cosmetic products or medical devices. 

We stand out  through our expertise with exclusive equipment, a high-level scientific team and specific protocols to meet your requirements.

Our studies are carried out in an adapted clinical environment in accordance with the regulations in place. COSDERMA’s expertise and the particular attention we pay to the conduct of your studies are recognized by professionals in the field.

By establishing our laboratories in France, COSDERMA Bordeaux, and internationally in  Wuhan, COSDERMA China, certified with China Metrology Certification (CMA), large panels of Caucasian and Asian subjects  are made available to you to assess your cosmetic products.

Name: Manitty
Description: At Manitty, our mission is clear: we decode the body's language to make it universally understandable, anytime, anywhere and for anyone. Our cutting-edge technology, driven by Artificial Intelligence and miniature sensors, collects and correlates vital physiological and brain data. This empowers us to provide smart and predictive diagnostic solutions. Our innovations find applications in various fields, including surgerical monitoring devices, medical diagnostics, pre-/post-operative monitoring, and animal research. solutions We're changing the way the world sees the human and animal body, making advanced healthcare accessible worldwide. Beyond our core mission, we excel in biotelemetry and biologger design, offering flexibility for scientific inquiries. With two decades of experience in neuroscience and ecophysiology, we deliver laboratory-validated solutions tailored to your research needs. When you choose Manitty, you choose innovation, personalized support, and a dedicated team by your side. Join us in this transformative journey for a healthier, interconnected world.

Name: Logos Biosystems
Description: Logos Biosystems is the life science solutions of Aligned Genetics, Inc., dedicated to the development and commercialization of innovative technologies to support the life science research community. Since its founding in 2008, Logos Biosystems has been developing a series of automated systems and imaging instruments for laboratories engaging in research with a cellular and molecular emphasis.

Name: 3i - Intelligent Imaging Innovations
Description: 3i designs and manufactures technologies for living cell, live cell, and intravital fluorescence microscopy including digital holography, spinning disk confocal, multi-photon and lightsheet. SlideBook software manages everything from instrument control to image capture, processing and data analysis. Our experienced team of scientists and engineers continue a 20+ year tradition of creating advanced research instrument systems that can be expanded with an array of technologies to address both established and emergent scientific methods.

Name: MEDLAB - ICARE Groupe
Description:
Medlab Laboratory is a private company specialist in biological analytical laboratory services, microbiological, chemical, pharmaceutical, and toxicological analysis for various industrial segments of healthcare ( pharma, cosmetics, medical devices, veterinary, hospitals...), with the purpose of R & D, Quality Control, Registration and / or Export.

Medlab has official certification from ANVISA, INMETRO, REBLAS, in compliance with ISO 9001, ISO 17025, BPL, BPF, USP 38...

From April 2015, Medlab is part of ICARE GROUP, french company european leader in the same segment.

www.groupeicare.com

Services offered by MEDLAB enable its customers to be assured that the device or the manufactured product is fully in compliance with regulatory requirements and standards.

Name: Xegen
Description:
Xegen is a bioinformatics company specialized in Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) data analysis.
We provide support for our customers or partners in their NGS data processing issues, through specific, automated, high added value bioinformatics analyzes.
Xegen is developing Polypheme a bioinformatics suite dedicated to complex genes analysis (polymorphisms detection or allelic types).
Polypheme analysis includes in particular HLA Typing, classic (HLA-A, -B, -C, DRB1, DQB1) and not classic genes (HLA-E, -F, -G, -H). Polypheme is also used to discover new alleles.

Name: SPIRAW
Description: F4F is a foodtech & wellness venture, democratizing microalgea as a sustainable food alternative that can help us meet the future challenges : food security & food self-sufficiency.

Name: CovalX
Description:
CovalX has been established as the leader in characterizing protein interactions by mass spectrometry.  Providing Innovative Technologies and Exclusive Services, CovalX has been doing business with world-renowned Universities, therapeutic companies, and most major pharmaceutical companies worldwide for many years.

CovalX AG developed a unique protocol for measuring intact protein complexes using MALDI mass spectrometry.  CovalX both sells the tools and/or services for High-Mass MALDI protein-protein interaction analysis.  

The main applications involve:
•	Epitope mapping (both conformational or linear)
•	Characterizing aggregates from biotherapeutic drugs
•	Analyzing antibody-antigen interactions
•	rapid characterization of any protein complexes (stoichiometry, inhibition, etc)

CovalX also has flexibility and provides services for characterizing any large macro molecules such as PEGylated proteins or polymers.

CovalX has recently restructured by moving some of its hardware support facilities and US sales and marketing into the US and establishing an official subsidiary in the Boston area.

Name: Naturamole
Description:
Naturamole develops, sells and manufactures, in the French Alps, natural, sustainable & low carbon flavouring, fragrance & functional ingredients for flavors, fragrances, food and cosmetics applications.
For two decades,Naturamole has been innovating via green chemistry, ground breaking enzymatic biocatalysis & precision fermentation technology, the Green’Z technology, to unleash natural, sustainable & low carbon scents & flavors. We are One Planet is the DNA of our innovation.

Name: Perha Pharmaceuticals
Description:
Perha Pharmaceuticals is a biotech company identifying, optimizing and characterizing innovative, low molecular weight kinase inhibitors and developing them up to proof-of-concept in man. Perha Pharma focuses its research on two main diseases: cognitive disorders associated with Down syndrome (DS) and Alzheimer’s disease (AD), and hearing loss (HL) induced by ototoxic products. The first proof-of-concept in man should be achieved in both pathologies through niche indications:  cognitive deficits in DS and hearing loss induced by cis-platin or aminoglycoside antibiotics.
Perha Pharma was co-founded in April 2019 by Dr Laurent MEIJER, Chairman & CSO, former distinguished Director of Research at the CNRS, and Dr Philippe de LAVENNE, CEO, former Vice-President at Actelion Pharmaceuticals. For 40 years, Dr. Meijer dedicated his research to the study of protein kinases and their inhibitors, mostly at the CNRS.

Perha Pharma focuses its research & development on two main programs:

- Correction of cognitive deficits associated with Down syndrome: Trisomy 21 and Alzheimer's disease share a common therapeutic target involved in cognitive disorders, the DYRK1A protein kinase. The pharmacological inhibitors of this kinase optimized by Perha Pharma are derived from Leucettamine B, extracted from the Leucetta microraphis marine sponge. These molecules correct cognitive impairments observed in three mouse models of DS and three rodent models of AD. Leucettinib 21, our preclinical drug candidate, has been selected among over 500 synthesized Leucettinibs following a stringent multi-parameter go / no go decision tree. Perha Pharma is now preparing for regulatory preclinical studies.
-Prevention of hearing loss induced by ototoxic drugs or noise: Perha Pharma-optimized molecules prevent hair cell apoptosis of the inner ear in cell models exposed to cisplatin. Perha Pharma is working at a proof-of-concept using rodents exposed to cisplatin or acoustic trauma.

Name: 4BioDx
Description:
4BioDx and 4MID are brands of SPQI.

All our innovative products are commercialized under the 4BioDx  brand either directly or via our distributor/agent network.

SPQI (Services and Products of Quality and Innovative) develops, produces and commercializes research use only reagents (monoclonal antibodies, ELISA kits).  

Unique supplier of the 4MID testing kits to quantify the proAKAP4 sperm marker in spermatozoa (fresh, chilled or frozen semen/isolated from epipidymis).

The proAKAP4 marker is the only sperm parameter that indicate long lasting motility and long term function of sperm.

Our company commercialized a unique brand of range of products, called the 4MID  kits, to assess sperm quality and male fertility in livestock animals (bulls, horse, pigs, ram etc.), pets or endangereed species.
Visit the dedicated website at www.4biodx-breeding.com

Also antibodies for neurosciences research : exclusive phosphoantibodies against tau and APP issued from Pr Buée's lab (www.4biodx.com)

La société SPQI (Services et Produits de Qualité et Innovants) développe, fabrique et commercialise des produits innovants (anticorps monoclonaux, kits ELISA) destinés à la recherche dans les maladies neurodégénératives, les cancers et l'infertilité masculine humaine et animale. 

Basée à Lille (France), SPQI SAS commercialise sous sa marque 4BioDx , ses produits destinés à la recherche  soit directement, soit via son réseau de distributeurs.  Liste complète sur demande.

SPQI S.A.S est le fabricant exclusif d'une gamme de produits (les 4MID kits) destinés à l'évaluation de la qualité du sperme et à la reproduction animale des animaux de rente et des animaux de compagnie. Plus d'informations sur www.4biodx-breeding.com  

Nous travaillons au développement d'autres produits innovants grâce à nos collaborations avec des instituts de recherche français et internationaux.

N'hésitez pas contacter nos services pour tout nouveau produit ou projet de recherche en fertilité masculine.

Name: Da Volterra
Description:
Da Volterra is a clinical stage biotechnology company whose vision is to be a trusted and acknowledged leader in the microbiota field.

Our mission is to discover, develop and bring to market safe and novel therapeutic options, preserving patients’ microbiota to prevent and cure life-threatening diseases.

We strive to serve patients by transforming the promise of science into innovative treatments which have the power to improve health and save lives.

Committed to innovation, Da Volterra develops products intended to protect the intestinal microbiota or harness its potential to help prevent and cure human diseases. Over the years since inception, we have gathered a unique in-house expertise on the intestinal microbiota and its links to the different body functions, antibacterial drugs and other drugs disrupting the microbiota as well as drug delivery technologies.

Name: STH BIOTECH
Description: STH BIOTECH develops unique and reliable plant-biotech process to unlock the production of rare APIs and innovative botanical ingredients.

Name: IBISBA
Description:
IBISBA envisions a world where Europe’s industrial biotechnology drives the global circular bioeconomy transition.

IBISBA is a pan-European research infrastructure dedicated to industrial biotechnology. We provide a single access point to researchers from academia and industry across the globe to integrated services for end-to-end bioprocess development. 

By federating European expertise and state-of-the-art research and development facilities, we promote standardisation and best data practices as core elements of service reproducibility and interoperability. In doing so, IBISBA accelerates the production and translation of cutting-edge knowledge into innovation for biomanufacturing.

Name: En Carta Diagnostics
Description:
Diagnostics for Better care, Everywhere.

En Carta Diagnostics is a synthetic-biology biotech company leveraging patented technologies to decentralise highly reliable molecular diagnostic solutions.

Name: Plastic At Sea
Description: Plastic@Sea propose aux entreprises d'évaluer l'impact écologique des plastiques utilisé dans la fabrication de produits. Et de trouver des solutions respectueuses de l'environnement dans le cadre d'une économie circulaire.

Name: Allogenica
Description:
At Allogenica, we are transforming cell therapies for a healthier tomorrow. 
Our mission is to disrupt the treatment landscape for cancer, rare diseases, and autoimmune disorders.
We're developing a breakthrough cell therapy platform with the potential to: 
• Replace transplants: Providing less invasive, accessible alternatives for thousands of patients who currently have limited treatment options. 
• Expand access for all: With predictable safety and efficacy, we aim to make cell therapies available to a a broader patient population. 
• Dramatically reduce costs: By streamlining production, we aim to significantly lower the cost of cell therapies, making transformative treatments more accessible globally.

Leading Cell Therapy Revolution 
Founded in 2022, Allogenica has rapidly emerged as a pioneer in the field. Our innovative approach includes: 
• Proprietary Pre-T Cell Therapies: Enhancing compatibility with patients' immune systems, reducing the risk of rejection. 
• Scalable, Broad Applications: Our platform has the potential to treat a diverse range of diseases, ensuring scalability and reaching more patients in need. 
• Cost-Effective, Rapid Solutions: Delivering affordable and faster-to-market therapies, to change lives on a global scale, potentially impacting millions. 

Allogenica is a preclinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Lyon, France. 
Join us in transforming the future of healthcare!

#CellTherapy #Biotech #HealthcareInnovation #CancerTreatment #RareDiseases #AutoimmuneDisorders #Lyon

Name: Rarecells
Description:
Rarecells develops and commercializes the ISET technology to isolate Circulating Cancer Cells for early cancer diagnosis and medical research.

Rarecells Diagnostics was created in 2010 by Patrizia Paterlini Brechot, Professor of Cell Biology and Oncology, in order to make the scientific and technological advances developed by her team available to research teams and patients. Rarecells Diagnostics’ core product is the patented ISET (Isolation by SizE of Tumor cells) Technology.

Rarecells Diagnostics has the exclusive license of patents belonging to the French Public Institutions University Paris Descartes, Assistance Publique Hôpitaux de Paris and INSERM protecting the Rarecells Device and its consumables, as well as the analyses performed on cells isolated using the Rarecells System.

Rarecells Diagnostics is a science-driven company. We are scientists working for scientists and patients. We care about bringing benefits to the patients.The team delivers customer satisfaction by manufacturing high quality products and providing high-level scientific assistance.

Rarecells and ISET are registered trademarks of Rarecells SAS.

Name: BioAZ
Description:
La biotech promotrice du bien-être animal et de l'élevage durable.

You can learn more about our company and our project in 3-minute videos: 
- Alternative to pig castration: https://youtu.be/Hx8ABG-YDGQ  
- Alternative to dog castration: https://youtu.be/kZWaImBBS1w  


BioAZ is a French start-up company created in 2022, developing breakthrough innovations for animal welfare and more sustainable breeding.

Name: Rosetta Omics
Description:
Worldwide, there are more than 20 million new cases of cancer each year.

First-line therapies are not always the most effective and there is a strong need to move towards personalized medicine by offering the patients the best treatment as quickly as possible. This will help in increasing the chance or cure. Therefore, there is a need to improve the prediction of the response to treatments to be able to save patient’s lives and reduce the cost of expensive inefficient treatments. Our goal is to unlock the road to precision medicine by using multiomics, spatial data and AI.

Name: Meiogenix
Description:
Meiogenix advances crop improvement through proprietary breeding technologies based on precise, targeted recombination. 

By unlocking the natural diversity of crops, we enable breeders to deliver elite varieties that help farmers meet the challenges of productivity, sustainability and disease resilience.

Name: GlioCure
Description:
GlioCure, a spin-off company of Angers and McGill Montreal universities, aims to treat glioblastoma that causes 200,000 deaths worldwide each year.
To overcome this challenge, GlioCure is hyper-specialized and develops glioblastoma-specific drugs.
GlioCure is currently focusing on the development of GC01, an anti-glioblastoma peptide discovered by Joël Eyer, Director of Research from INSERM, and covered by two patent families for which GlioCure owns worldwide exclusive rights.

GlioCure's team has the experience and the know-how to ensure the successful completion of GC01’s development plan:
Louis-Marie is a biotech entrepreneur with 15 years of experience in the field of innovative therapies and rare diseases;
Claire, specialist of the neuronal cytoskeleton, has sound knowledge of preclinical experimental techniques;
Its Scientific & Medical Advisory Board is composed of leading international experts in research and treatment of glioblastoma.
Location: Angers, Pays de la Loire, France

Name: Syklea
Description:
Fighting climate change, one microalgae at a time.  Syklea captures CO2 with our Urban'Alg tree, turning nature’s power into real impact. 

For larger-scale solutions, ALIUM purifies air and reduces CO2 emissions, showing how innovation and sustainability can go hand in hand. 

Join us on our mission to make the planet greener!

Name: MycFoods
Description:
MYCFOODS : réinventer l’alimentation avec le mycélium 
Grâce à son savoir-faire unique en criblage et à sa technologie de fermentation solide, MYCFOODS cultive le mycélium sur une base végétale, pour créer Mynion, une nouvelle génération d’aliments naturels, gourmands et ultra-polyvalents.
 Sans extrusion, sans ultra-transformation, sans arômes artificiels ni conservateurs, nos aliments révèlent naturellement le meilleur du végétal, avec une texture généreuse, une vraie richesse nutritionnelle et une liberté culinaire inédite, de l’entrée au dessert 
 Un nouvel aliment au service du goût, de la santé et de la planète.

 MYCFOODS: Reinventing food with mycelium
With its unique screening expertise and solid-state fermentation technology, MYCFOODS cultivates mycelium on a plant-based substrate to create Mynion, a new generation of natural, delicious and highly versatile foods.
 No extrusion, no ultra-processing, no artificial flavors or preservatives, our foods naturally bring out the best of plant-based ingredients, with a generous texture, strong nutritional value and remarkable culinary versatility, from starters to desserts 
 A new kind of food, serving taste, health and the planet.

Name: Alga Biologics
Description:
At Alga Biologics, we harness the natural power of marine microalgae to create innovative, eco-friendly diagnostic tools and biotherapies.
We aim to make life-saving tools and treatments more affordable and accessible while promoting sustainability. Shaping  the future of sustainable bioproduction while promoting positive health outcomes.

Name: AtmosR
Description: AtmosR is a biotech company developing innovative treatments for patients suffering from rare and severe disorders of the central nervous system

Name: Imaxio
Description:
IMAXIO est une société biotechnologie spécialisée en vaccinologie et dans la prévention de la leptospirose humaine.
Souvent appelée « maladie du rat » ou « maladie des porchers »,  cette zoonose est un problème de santé publique émergent en Europe et particulièrement en France. 
Son incidence a doublé en France métropolitaine depuis 2014 pour atteindre plus de 600 cas par an. 54% des leptospiroses chez les actifs seraient d’origine professionnelle. 
IMAXIO s’engage au côté des professionnels et des autorités de santé pour prévenir et sensibiliser aux risques liés à la maladie dans un cadre professionnel, notamment à travers son site dédié : 
www.leptospirose-prevention.fr

Name: YpHen SAS
Description:
YpHen est une deeptech dont l’ambition est de créer les solutions écologiques de remédiation des sols. 
Convaincus que les biotechnologies et les capacités industrielles de pointe permettront la restauration durable de notre environnement, nous concevons les produits de dépollution et de valorisation des métiers de l’industrie, de l’agriculture et de l’environnement.

Name: IBMP (Institut de Biologie Moléculaire des Plantes)
Description:
L’IBMP, Institut de biologie moléculaire des plantes du CNRS, constitue un pôle incontournable en matière de recherche et d’enseignement en biologie végétale.

Cette unité du CNRS rattachée à CNRS Biologie bénéficie du soutien de l’Université de Strasbourg. Elle réunit près de deux cent personnes incluant chercheurs, enseignants-chercheurs, ingénieurs, techniciens, doctorants et post-doctorants.

L’IBMP développe une recherche scientifique d’excellence visant, à travers l’étude de processus fondamentaux de la vie des plantes, à répondre aux défis sociétaux majeurs de la biologie végétale en nutrition, santé et environnement.

Forte de ses diverses expertises (biologie moléculaire, biochimie, génétique, bioinformatique, métabolomique, microscopie), l’unité s’attache à déchiffrer les processus de régulation de l’expression des gènes, étudier le développement et la croissance des plantes, comprendre comment ces dernières s’adaptent à leur environnement, découvrir comment virus ou bactéries interagissent avec le monde végétal ou encore identifier des voies de biosynthèse de molécules bioactives à intérêt alimentaire ou thérapeutique.

Les plateformes de pointe en imagerie, métabolomique, expression génique, bioinformatique, production de protéines, production végétale, développées par l’unité donnent à toute la communauté scientifique académique et privée, accès à des technologies de dernière génération.

Name: MagIA diagnostics
Description: MagIA is developing a multi-analyis "Point-of-Care" that can be used outside of any clinical environment. With a first focus on infectious diseases MagIA is providing a syndromic testing approach at the Point of Care outside of traditional clinical environment. With the motto “a better screening for a better care", MagIA focuses first on the rapid detection of infectious diseases, starting with an HIV-Viral Hepatitis combo, to link to care Key « high-risk » populations. MagIA's innovation is a one-step no-wash immunoassay method which brings unique characteristics: (1) laboratory quality on a portable device, usable indoor, outdoor, (2) 8 analyses in parallel with 1 single fingerpick, for a syndromic diagnostic approach (3) secured analysis and traceable results.

Name: ENDODIAG
Description:
Founded in 2011, Endodiag is specialized in the development of products and services aimed at improving the diagnosis of endometriosis, a complex and poorly known disease, affecting yet 10% of women of reproductive age (over 180 million patients worldwide!). Located in Evry, France, within Genopole, the French largest Biocluster, the company leverages the experience of its scientific cofounders who have been working in this field for over 20 years and a network of major hospital centres both in France and abroad.

Although endometriosis is a major cause of subfertility (40% of affected patients are infertile) and chronic pain, it takes an average 8 to 10 years between the onset of the disease and its diagnosis, currently only achieved through surgery.

With its EndoGram prognosis program, Endodiag contributes to improving current diagnostic practice by providing additional biological information for a personalized medical and therapeutic management for each patient. In parallel, the company develops a new non-invasive diagnostic test making endometriosis detection much easier and faster. Finally, Endodiag offers drug testing services to pharmaceutical companies enabling them to make early in-vitro evaluation of drug efficacy of cell lines and patient-derived cell cultures.

In 2013, Endodiag actively contributed to the launch of oz2020, the first Endometriosis Observatory in France (www.oz2020.com). This observatory will help gather precise epidemiologic data on the disease and patients’ quality of life in order to advance and support scientific research, but also to raise endometriosis awareness.

Learn more about Endodiag at www.endodiag.com

Name: xRapid Group
Description:
Environmental Services - Biotechnologie

Founded in 2015 by Jean Viry-Babel and Prof. David Mendels, xRapid Group was created with the hope of applying the evolving technologies of artificial intelligence (AI) and computer vision to previously unexplored fields with the hopes of improving the lives of people the world over. The first application of Prof. Mendels knowledge was to tackle the issue of diagnosing malaria in remote areas where the demand for skilled analysts exceeded the supply of resources, both human and monetary. It was during the research and development of this application that Dr. Charlyn Belluzzo came on to supervise the medical aspects of the testing. After acquiring approval through the World Health Organization we have been able to help citizens in Benin, Indonesia, Malawi, Papua, and Uganda by offering this testing at little to no cost through xRapid Foundation. We are continuing to work with governments around the world to develop AI-driven medical tests that can help those that would otherwise be overlooked or forgotten.

In the latter part of 2016, William Young came into contact with xRapid Group and proposed a way to fund our philanthropic research through commercial application of our technology in the area of environmental testing. This lead to the founding of xRapid Environment and the development of xR Fiber and the xR Testing Platform. This also began our work, in earnest, in the specialty of AI known as deep learning. With this technology we have been able to effectively automate the analysis of air fiber samples taken for testing of asbestos fibers in indoor environments and outdoor work sites. We have now also begun development of a similar analysis for mold spores in air and plan to continue in several other environmental areas. Ultimately, our resolve to improve people’s lives, by applying emerging technologies to areas others have yet to, has not wavered and we hope to touch as many lives as possible in the years to come.

Name: MANTA - MAriNe maTeriAls
Description:
MANTA is a research Chair of Excellence implemented by the project Energy and Environment Solutions (E2S) from the Université de Pau et des Pays de l’Adour (UPPA). 
MANTA aims at developing novel marine-inspired and sustainable (bio)materials to face current societal problematics related to human health and marine environment degradation.
MANTA's research flow is based on three main topics: exploration of marine biomolecules and biopolymers, valorization of fisheries by-products, and marine biomimetics.
Indeed, the Ocean constitutes a great source of inspiration and unexploited natural compounds with promising physicochemical, structural and biological properties. In this context, MANTA focusses on blue biotechnologies and eco-friendly methodologies for the extraction of biomolecules and biopolymers from marine bioressources and by-products to be then transformed as multifunctional porous structures, films, hydrogels and composite materials for cosmetic, biomedical and packaging applications.

Name: VIEWaves
Description:
We need financial support and - together with you - help save lives!

To help surgeons, we have developed innovative, stable and robust fluorescent molecules. They will be grafted onto antibodies that will specifically recognize tumor cells. These new molecules will emit intense light in the near-infrared range that will precisely identify the contours of the tumor. This light will guide surgeons in removing cancerous tumors.

This is a key point, because we know that deaths are most often related to secondary tumor sites (called metastases), spread throughout the body.
As a result, patients' life expectancy will be exceptionally improved. The promise for patients is so great that we are in great demand to accelerate our development program. 

Fighting cancer: an exciting adventure, full of meaning and hope!

-----
Nous avons besoin de soutiens financiers et -avec vous- participer à sauver des vies !

Pour aider les chirurgiens, nous avons développé des molécules fluorescentes innovantes, stables, robustes. Elles seront greffées sur des anticorps qui reconnaitront spécifiquement les cellules tumorales. Ces nouvelles molécules émettront une lumière intense, dans le proche infrarouge, qui identifiera précisément les contours de la tumeur. Cette lumière guidera le geste des chirurgiens, pour faciliter l’ablation des tumeurs cancéreuses.

C’est un point clé, car nous savons que les décès sont le plus souvent liés aux sites tumoraux secondaires (appelés métastases), disséminés dans l’organisme. Ainsi, l’espérance de vie des patients sera exceptionnellement améliorée. La promesse pour les patients est d’un tel bénéfice, que nous sommes très sollicités pour accélérer notre programme de développement. 

Lutter contre le cancer et d’aider à sauver des vies : une aventure passionnante, pleine de sens et pleine d’espérance !

Name: EVA - European Virus Archive
Description:

Today, EVA delivers reliable viral resources worldwide, enabling scientific excellence, international collaboration, and rapid response to health emergencies.

Ensemble, nous développons et commercialisons des outils de biotechnologie innovants appliqués à la Cancérologie et à la Santé Humaine, tels que :

- Des milieux de culture complets et synthétiques (milieux sans sérum) permettant d’optimiser la culture d’un large panel de types cellulaires (sains et tumoraux) en 2D et en 3D. Notre gamme permet également la conservation de prélèvements biologiques sans congélation et sur plusieurs jours (GAMME DE MILIEUX OPTIPASS)

- Des Tumeurs artificielles (culture 3D) pour le criblage de nouveaux médicaments contre le cancer. Ces modèles précliniques sont issus de lignées cellulaires tumorales très utilisées par les chercheurs (cancers du sein, ovaire, poumon, prostate, etc...), qui reproduisent fidèlement des micro tumeurs de type avasculaire. Elles sont disponibles pour la réalisation de criblages à haut débit de molécules actives et de manière biomimétique, sous forme de kits de tumeurs artificielles prêtes à l’emploi livrées en plaques 96 puits (KITS OPTI 3D).

- Des biotraceurs fluorescents brevetés LightSpot (n° PCT/EP2020/077694) pour l’évaluation de la résistance cellulaire par détection, quantification et localisation de la protéine de Multidrug Resistance « P-gp ». La quantification de son niveau d’expression présente un fort intérêt afin d’évaluer la résistance cellulaire vis-à-vis des différentes molécules et agents exogènes très divers (polluants, principes actifs, agents infectieux...) (RÉACTIFS LIGHTSPOT).

- Des prestations de service de développement à façon de nouveaux modèles 3D, screening de molécules ou tests d’efficacité à partir des tumeurs artificielles (PRESTATIONS DE CRIBLAGE)

Name: Neurophoenix
Description:
Neurophoenix is a preclinical-stage biotechnology company arising from academic research carried out at Institut Pasteur.

It holds two complementary patented technologies. VHH_NPX is a single-domain antibody engineered to cross two barriers that stop most therapeutics: the blood–brain barrier, and then the plasma membrane of the neuron itself — releasing its cargo directly into the cytosol rather than leaving it trapped in the endosomal compartment. NVshort is a short neuroprotective and neuroregenerative peptide, derived from a rabies virus glycoprotein motif, which selectively inactivates the PTEN–MAST2 interaction and reactivates the survival pathway of the adult neuron.

Their combination, the fusion protein NPX461, has protected retinal ganglion cells and produced axonal regeneration in vivo in optic nerve injury.

Both technologies are covered by international patent applications co-owned with Institut Pasteur.

Name: BioMathematica
Description:
At Biomathematica, we believe mathematics has the power to revolutionize biology. We have developed a Systems Biology approach to characterize, predict, engineer, control and optimize simple and complex microbial communities. We use this technology for:
-The development of probiotics / prebiotics / synbiotics and live biotherapeutics targeting the human microbiome. 
-The engineering of bacterial strains or consortia targeting the animal, environmental and artificial microbiome(s).
-The design of new metabolic pathways involving several bacterial or unicellular strains.

Description:

 Alzheimer’s is multifactorial — its treatment must be as well.

Name: SPIMA Therapeutics
Description:

SPIMA Therapeutics is part of the nexus of Landmark Bioventures.

Join us in shaping the future of medicine, where discovery meets dedication.

Name: Wired Beauty
Description:
WIRED BEAUTY, French beauty tech startup, B2B partner of world-leading laboratories and skincare brands, inaugurates and markets new clinical solutions and new models of consumer knowledge and research in skincare. From the laboratory to real life.

Name: CyRISBio
Description:
CyRISBio est spécialisée dans les solutions d’automatisation pour les laboratoires R&D en sciences du vivant.

Name: BIONEA LAB
Description:
BIONEA LAB is a preclinical CRO located in Sophia Antipolis Bioparc, in the south of France. Created in November 2018, BIONEA LAB offers tailor-made preclinical services for pharma & biotech companies and research institutes, in an environment that meets high quality and regulatory standards.

Name: CAPSTONE_H2020
Description:
CAPSTONE (Controlling Antigen Processing in Autoimmune diseases and Cancer) PhD project is a multi-disciplinary platform of experts in structural biology, immunology, biochemistry, proteomics, and therapeutics that jointly aim to increase the impact of research into ERAP aminopeptidases in various aspects of human and animal disease.

The main goal of the CAPSTONE project is to train the next generation of researchers for interdisciplinary and intersectorial careers in basic and applied medicinal chemistry, immunomodulation and pharmacology research with full understanding of the requirements of academia, pharmaceutical companies and societal challenges.

Name: BioPreserv
Description: BIOPRESERV is a company specialized in biology and analytical chemistry located in the GraseeBiotech buildings at 45 boulevard Marcel Pagnol, 06130 GRASSE, France.

Name: BILHI Genetics
Description:
We are a team of GENOMIC EXPLORERS dedicated to cure fibrosis. We work hand in hand with populations under strong natural selection pressure (e.g. Amerindians from Brazil, Allurs, Bantous from Uganda, Hans from Wuhan...) to identify GENETIC VARIANTS of susceptibility or resistance to fibrotic diseases. 

To explore the mechanisms of fibrosis in new depth, we rely on a unique genomic strategy based on medical genetic expertise in fibrosis, local networks of fields experts and state-of-the-art AI. In cooperation with local institutions & KOLs, our experts have analyzed tens of thousands of samples (plasma, blood, saliva, DNA and RNA, medical exams, exogenic factors) and led pioneering genetic research in the fields of infectious, parasitic & metabolic diseases.* Our goal is to build a unique dataset representative of humanity's diversity to bring disease prevention and cure to all communities.

* We always collect samples and data hand in hand with local authorities and populations. We follow up on our patients and bring healthcare to the populations who need it the most by maintaining local teams and by coordinating with NGOs and local authorities.

Name: CAPGREEN
Description:
Acteur majeur de l’écologie microbienne, CapGreen possède une expertise dans le traitement écologique des milieux solides ou liquides.

Nous industrialisons des cocktails enzymatiques naturellement efficaces pour le traitement des sites et sols pollués, plateforme de compostage.
Résultat de plusieurs années de R&D, les solutions techniques prêtes à l’emploi CapGreen contribuent à la réduction des couts d’exploitations des sites naturels et industriels.

Name: Aureus Pharma
Description:

Over the course of 10 years and with a significant investment, the Company has developed a unique Knowledge Production Platform which analyzes, indexes and organizes critical chemical and bioactivity information into databases.

    * AurSCOPE ADME
    * AurQUEST, DDI Predict, AurPROFILER

Aureus's customers include large as well as mid-size pharmaceutical and biotech groups in Europe and North America.

The company is headquartered in Paris (France) and employs approximately 25 people, most of which are highly trained scientists in biology, pharmacology and medicinal chemistry.

Name: BIOPROTEC - Banque de tissus
Description:
Fondée en 1989, Bioprotec a permis de fédérer les activités de recueil de veines saphènes lors du stripping des varices ou au cours des prélèvements multi-organes et tissus, d’assurer la production d’allogreffons veineux et leur distribution aux établissements.

Name: UNVEIL
Description:
A spin-off from the Institut d'Optique Graduate School, Université Paris-Saclay, UNVEIL is a deeptech start-up that facilitates the development and production of biologics (drugs derived from living organisms, such as messenger RNA vaccines, as opposed to chemical ones). These biologics (gene therapy, RNA vaccines, etc.) are transported to the target site in the human body by nanometric vectors (viruses or lipid nanoparticles). 
R&D and production of these biomedicines is hampered by the lack of effective technology to measure vector loading. 
UNVEIL has developped an optical, label-free instrument capable of quickly and easily measuring nanovector loading in solution, as well as their size and concentration.
Want to know more: visit our website !

Name: Curadigm
Description:
Curadigm is a nanotechnology company committed to improving treatment outcomes for millions of patients by redefining the therapeutic balance between bioavailability, toxicity, and efficacy. Curadigm is a Nanobiotix spin-off, incorporated in 2019, and based on a proprietary platform that aims to reshape and elevate the efficacy of intravenously administered therapeutics. 

Curadigm’s technology is focused on engineered biocompatible nanoparticles that transiently occupy the pathways responsible for therapeutic clearance and hepatic toxicity. This leads to enhanced systemic bioavailability, and improved accumulation in the target tissues. This augments the beneficial aspects of therapeutics while mitigating toxicities to increase patient quality of life, improve outcomes, and decrease costs.
 
Curadigm’s technology is widely applicable and can be adapted to work with multiple therapeutic classes, including nanomedicines, nucleic acid therapeutics, small molecules, and gene editing technologies across multiple therapeutic areas. The broad utility of the company’s technology combined with its transformational nature signal significant market potential. Development will include multiple partnerships to rapidly advance programs into the clinic, drive early company revenue, and diversify risk.

Description:
MiceTracking is a digital platform designed to modernize and simplify preclinical research operations.

Research organizations generate vast amounts of data throughout in vivo studies. Yet many teams still rely on fragmented processes, spreadsheets, and manual tracking methods that limit efficiency, traceability, and data quality.

MiceTracking provides a centralized solution to manage animal tracking, study workflows, experimental data, and operational processes in a single environment.

Name: PLL Therapeutics
Description:
Founded in 2019, PLL Therapeutics, a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, is spearheading a unique therapeutic approach for treating the root cause of autoimmune and neurodegenerative diseases, based on its groundbreaking polypeptide delivery platform. The company focuses on restoring gut integrity through the delivery of targeted Small-Chain Fatty Acids (SCFAs) to gut epithelial cells and the Blood-Brain Barrier (BBB), helping restore the normal function of cells lining the gut, as well as the BBB. Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), a fatal motor neuron disease, is the company’s first indication.

In parallel, PLL Therapeutics is validating a panel of specific biomarkers for clinical use that will enable the first-ever early-stage diagnosis of ALS. This development includes companion diagnostics for ALS and other neurodegenerative disorders.  

PLL Therapeutics’ platform technology aims to redefine the standard of care in how patients living with ALS are treated and monitored in clinical follow-up, as well as prevent diseases linked to dysbiosis of the gut microbiota.

PLL Therapeutics is led by a highly experienced and entrepreneurial management team with decades of expertise in infectious diseases, rare diseases, and CNS (Central Nervous System). The company has successfully completed a phase I trial in patients with ALS and a phase II trial will take place in Australia and New Zealand in 2026.

The company is located near Bordeaux, France.

Name: NEPHRIX Biosolutions
Description:

Name: UNLOCK project
Description:
15 partners from 7 EU countries work together to transform waste from the poultry industry into bio-based products for agricultural applications. 

The UNLOCK project, funded by the Bio-based Industries Joint Undertaking (BBI JU), aims at designing economically and environmentally sustainable innovative value chains to create a feather based bio-economy. 

In the course for the four-years project, the feathers will be valorised through four different processes, from mechanical treatment to steam explosion, microbial fermentaion or chemical hydrolysis, depending on the type of end products desired. 

The bio-based products generated will be tailored to the needs of the agriculture sector, with the creation of seed trays, nonwoven geotextiles, mulch films and hydroponic foams. Futhermore, the keratin contained in those innovative materials will bring additional environmental benefits at the end of the product’s life: keratin-based materials are targeted to be zero waste and allow for controlled biodegradability, while also enriching soils with organic nitrogen. 

The UNLOCK project is lead by the CIDETEC Foundation. It receives funding from the @EU_H2020 Research & Innovation Programme granted by 
@BBI2020 under grant agreement no 101023306. It officially started on 1st May 2021 and will run until April 2025.

Description:
The company

Neurochlore is developing an innovative therapeutic strategy to ameliorate developmental brain pathologies. Located Luminy (Marseille), the company has formed close links with internationally recognized scientific experts in some fields of developmental Neurobiology and neurological disorders. Furthermore, extensive collaborations with drug developers and clinical experts in neuro-pediatrics and psychiatry enable Neurochlore to develop and test novel applications for its therapeutic agent. Indeed, Neurochlore has an international patent in the use of a diuretic in the treatment of Autism Spectrum Disorders (ASD) and another syndrome associated with autism.

Clinical Research

Neurochlore is currently developing a treatment which will be able to ameliorate ASD in children and adolescents. The company has already conducted a successful monocentric study (Lemonnier et al., Translational Psychiatry, 2012) and a multicentric phase II clinical trial in order to confirm the efficacy and tolerance of this new treatment (Lemonnier et al., article in press). This study will be soon followed by a double-blind randomized phase III study that, if successful, will allow to submit a registration application to the European health authorities.

Fundamental Research

Fundamental research at Neurochlore is organized around a wide range of animal models of ASD and syndromes with associated autism. Research topics are focused on the study of developmental sequence modifications of GABAergic/glutamatergic currents in pathologies, focusing in the periods in utero and during birth. To determine the features of malformed brain currents/networks, a large range of techniques is used including electrophysiological recordings of in vitro slices, in vivo recordings, morphological analysis... The fundamental research is financed by external sources notably the Bettencourt Schueller Foundation.

Name: GENARO
Description:
GENARO développe un procédé bio-informatique breveté de double sécurisation - biologique et numérique - des données issues du séquençage à haut débit.

NATAN, un algorithme spécifiquement développé en interne, encode à façon de l’information utile (ex : clé unique, référence d’indexation, instructions de chiffrement, instructions informatiques, etc.). de caractères alphanumériques en caractères nucléotidiques. Il génère ainsi une séquence d’ADN unique, ARIADNA, qui est ensuite synthétisée.

Chaque ARIADNA est absolument unique et ne correspond à aucune séquence du vivant. Elle transporte l’information encodée tout au long des processus de séquençage à haut débit, sans perte ni corruption. Elle peut être ajoutée à l’échantillon biologique dès l’entrée au laboratoire, au tout début de la phase pré-analytique, voire dès le prélèvement. Elle n’introduit aucun biais dans l’analyse.

Après séquençage, NATAN discrimine, identifie puis authentifie automatiquement ARIADNA. Il décode alors les informations qu’elle a transportées. Le cas échéant, si des instructions informatiques ont été encodées, elles peuvent être exécutées automatiquement.

En attribuant à chaque échantillon biologique une identité unique indépendante de son profil génétique, le procédé de GENARO permet d’automatiser et d’optimiser les Contrôles Qualité d’identitovigilance, de traçabilité et de contaminations dans les process de séquençage à haut débit tels que définis par les normes les plus strictes.

Plus généralement, il vient résoudre la dichotomie en apparence insoluble entre, d’un côté, l’indispensable besoin d’accès à la donnée génomique (recherche, criminalistique, etc.) et, de l’autre, la nécessité d’anonymisation, de protection et de sécurisation de ces données particulièrement sensibles telle que l’impose actuellement la législation.

Description:
TOLLYS is developing best in class specific TLR3 agonists in the field of immuno-oncology. TOLLYS was founded in 2015 by senior scientists from the leading European Cancer Research Center of Lyon in France and the Centre Léon Bérard.

They discovered the ability of TLR3 agonists to induce a direct and immunogenic tumor cell death in addition to their immunostimulant properties (activator of antigen presenting cells) and to their ability to induce a switch of the tumoral micro-environment. They postulated that the combination of these 3 actions will lead to an intense activation and recruitment of patient tumor specific cytotoxic T lymphocytes (CTL) in the tumor bed, resulting in anti-tumor effects and in-situ auto vaccination against recurrences.

Former heterogenous dsRNA with TLR3 agonist properties, have demonstrated clinical efficacy in the past in TLR3+ breast cancer patients with a good tolerance but never reached the market due to a lack of product homogeneity. TOLLYS discovered and patented in 2018 a new family of TLR3 agonists, among which TL-532 is the lead candidate, a dsRNA perfectly defined in sequence and length.

TL-532 showed efficacy in preclinical models to induce anti-tumor response and prevention of recurrences with a good tolerability and a synergistic effect with immune checkpoint inhibitors. TOLLYS plans to enter clinical trials with TL-532 in 2021 in Non Muscle Invasive Bladder cancer (NMIBC) unresponsive to BCG treatment, a high medical need indication with a potential for accelerated market approval. TL-532 has a broad indication potential since TLR3 is expressed in a variety of cancers.

Alterskin est conçue pour une économie circulaire : la matière est recyclable à l’infini grâce à notre procédé interne de recyclage par chimie verte, permettant de récupérer les composants de la biorésine et de les réutiliser sans perte de performance technique.

Ubiquity Désinfection est spécialisée dans la désinfection des surfaces par voie aérienne (DSVA) au peroxyde d’hydrogène (H2O2) et à l’acide hypochloreux (HOCl).

Notre mission : détruire l’invisible avec précision, grâce à une approche scientifique, encadrée et maîtrisée.

 Les loueurs de matériel médical, ambulanciers et pharmacies dans la maîtrise du risque infectieux,

Ubiquity Désinfection – La maîtrise de l’invisible.

Name: BIOCÉANE
Description:

Les méthodes classiques mais aussi génétiques (QPCR) nous permettent de détecter / dénombrer tous les germes potentiellement altérants de vos bières (bactéries lactiques, diastaticus, brettanomyces...). Nous proposons également des analyses spécifiques de vos softs et bières sans alcool (risque de développement de germes pathogènes). 
Nous produisons des levures liquides en starter ou concentrées pour un ensemencement direct, nos productions de levure sont certifiées Bio.
Notre activité œnologique consiste à sélectionner sur votre vignoble puis produire des levures indigènes, vous pourrez alors vinifier vos vins avec vos propres levures spécifiquement sélectionnées pour leurs aptitudes œnologiques.

- Choix du point de fusion de la matrice d’enrobage entre 45 et 700C
- Coloration et aromatisation de la tunique d’enrobage
- Choix du mode de libération (température, enzymatique, mécanique)

Nous vous proposons un accompagnement dans le développement de vos produits microencapsulés, de la phase de conception à la phase d’industrialisation.

Pour tous vos projets de microencapsulation, faites confiance à Capsularis et à son réseau d’experts.
