Name: Exosome Analytics
Description:
Cancer takes hundreds of thousands of lives each year. Most cancer deaths result from the metastatic spread of drug-resistant cells, thus biomarkers capable of predicting tumor progression and therapeutic response are needed.
Liquid biopsy is a promising approach to characterize the tumor phenotype. EVs (exosomes) are potential sources of tumor biomarkers because they carry the same histological membrane markers as a tumor. However, a major challenge encountered when analyzing histological markers on EVs is the fact that the signal from histological markers is often beyond the detection limit of commonly used techniques.
Exosome Analytics develops high-sensitivity technologies and products for EVs profiling. Based on these technologies, we are developing diagnostic platforms for early cancer screening, tumor profiling and early detection of tumor relapse.

Name: AcroBioPLAST - Interreg POCTEFA Project
Description: A pesar de los recientes esfuerzos en el reciclaje de plástico, una gran cantidad de plástico aún no se recupera y continúa convirtiéndose en residuo. Como resultado, los esfuerzos para desarrollar materiales biodegradables y reciclables han aumentado en los últimos años. Bioplásticos como el ácido poliláctico y la policaprolactona han surgido como posibles sustitutos de los plásticos derivados de combustibles fósiles, ya que son materiales biodegradables. Sin embargo, sus aplicaciones biomédicas están limitadas debido a un tiempo de degradación muy lento (3 o 4 años) y propiedades mecánicas débiles. Estos bioplásticos están compuestos por largas cadenas poliméricas que dificultan la difusión de agua y enzimas necesarias para su biodegradación. El objetivo de AcroBioPLAST es superar estas limitaciones mediante la preparación de nuevos copoliésteres e inclusión de aditivos basados en azúcares nanoestructurados. La presencia de una fase polisacárida dentro de la matriz plástica aumentará la tasa de degradación, mejorará las propiedades mecánicas y proporcionará capacidad antimicrobiana simultáneamente. AcroBioPLAST es un proyecto multidisciplinario que combina investigación científica (química, física y microbiología) y aplicación industrial, abarcando desde la producción de bioplásticos en escala piloto, a la creación de productos sanitarios fabricados de acuerdo con la regulación MDR 2017/745. Al final del proyecto se planea desarrollar un prototipo con el cual se pueda iniciar la validación preclínica (TRL 4). De esta manera, el sector de bioplásticos, altamente representado en el área POCTEFA, podrá desarrollar materiales innovadores con propiedades avanzadas. El sector médico también se beneficiará al utilizar estos bioplásticos para reemplazar los biomateriales empleados actualmente. La cooperación transfronteriza permitirá abordar el problema a una escala regional relevante y beneficiarse de una sinergia de habilidades y conocimientos.

Description:
ZebraMed is a Paris-based TechBio company automating the ethical generation of living organisms’ data via a proprietary robotics platform, zebrafish embryo models, and human data to generate digital Systemic Human Profiles to enable predictive AI-driven drug discovery. 

The pharmaceutical industry pours billions into AI, yet 90% of therapeutic candidates fail because current models are built on flat, single-target in vitro data. Cells simply cannot capture human systemic complexity.  

ZebraMed aims to discover new therapies for untreatable systemic profiles, taking into account human complexity and variability. ZebraMed is the only solution extracting data closest to humans, and we are the first to train a transparent AI architecture that predicts targets and explains the biology and decision-making process.  By addressing the lack of insight into human systemic response with highly translatable, large-scale data, 

ZebraMed discovers new therapeutic assets and empowers pharmaceutical partners to reduce preclinical timelines by 50% and increase success and rescue rates in pharmaceutical pipelines. 

Visit zebramed.bio.

Description:

Temisis most advanced compound, TEM-2085, a potential first-in-class and orally bioavailable small molecule, has demonstrated highly promising preclinical efficacy and safety profile in animal model of psoriasis, in comparison to apremilast (Otezla TM) and deucravacitinib (Sotyktu TM), both Standard of Care (SOC) for patients with mild to moderate plaque psoriasis. In addition, TEM-2085 exhibited strong and better protective effect than upadacitinib (Rinvoq TM) against colitis in rodent, a form of Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD), which indicates this compound has therapeutic potential for other autoimmune/inflammatory diseases. TEM-2085 and its analogues act through a novel and breakthrough mechanism of action (MoA) downmodulating the release of key proinflammatory cytokines.

Founded in December 2017, Temisis is based in Nancy and is a subsidiary of Plant Advanced Technologies ("PAT"), a plant-based biotechnology company specialized in the discovery and eco-friendly production of hard-to-source plant active extracts for the cosmetic, nutraceutical, agro-chemical and biotechnology markets.”

Description:
GammaOmics focuses on cutting-edge single-cell technologies, offering unparalleled insights into complex immuno-metabolic profiles. Our SCENITHTM technology provides single-cell resolution, allowing researchers to study rare cells and compare metabolic profiles with ease. Benefits and importance of single cell analysis.

GammaOmics is a biotechnology company specializing in functional metabolic profiling, with a strong focus on human immunometabolism. We hold exclusive global rights to offer SCENITHTM products and services—an advanced technology enabling single-cell metabolic profiling ex vivo.

Our mission is to democratize access to functional immunometabolism studies, driving the development of personalized medicine solutions to improve next-generation therapies, including cell-based therapies (quality control and patient monitoring), antibody treatments, and targeted therapies.

We are particularly focused on multi-omics and pre-/ clinical sample analysis, clinical trials, and tracking responses to treatment. Name: Owl Lifesciences
Description:
Owl Lifesciences develops a  first-in-class platform combining reconstructed, vascularized, and perfused 3D human brain tissues with a large-scale biological artificial intelligence model (Foundational Model) to de-risk the preclinical R&D for the central nervous system (CNS).

We are a team with the commitment to preserve our precious human brain in the Age of AI.

The technology relies on living, patient-specific human brain models integrating neurons, glial and immune cells, together with a functional vascular network reproducing the blood–brain barrier (BBB). More mature and physiologically integrated than conventional organoids or existing organ-on-chip systems, these models enable the simultaneous assessment of efficacy, toxicity, inflammation, and BBB transport within a single human-relevant system.

Good morning and welcome, we are pleased to introduce you to our structure.

AZELEAD has developed ZebraScreen and ZebraTox, an innovative methodology for rapid and accurate assessment of the efficacy and toxicity of a drug
In the past few years, we have seen a lot of attrition in the development of new drugs, with a failure rate of nearly 84% attributed to the low benefit of efficacy / toxicity.

Three therapeutic areas are mainly affected by this decrease:

 oncology (failure rate of 29.5%),
 neurology (failure rate of 14%),
 and infectious diseases (failure rate of 9.5%).

Pharmaceutical companies attribute this attrition to transposability between in vitro and in vivo studies, highlighting the need for new predictive models.

AZELEAD responds to this need by providing innovative solutions in these key therapeutic areas.

The models are developed using zebrafish, a totally transparent fish to visualize in real time the effectiveness of a drug and its side effects on the body.

We are at your disposal to study together your needs and best meet your expectations!

Name: PEPTINOV
Description:
Peptinov is a biotechonology company based in Cochin Hospital (Paris, France) and founded by Prof. Jean-François Zagury to develop innovative peptide-based immunotherapies to treat chronic inflammatory diseases. 

Peptinov’s strategy is to induce the production of antibodies targeting self-proteins directly by the organism of the patient, through immunizations against carefully selected, highly immunogenic peptide sequences. 

Peptinov’s high potential R&D platform uses the tools of bioinformatics and molecular modelling to design these peptide sequences. This platform is potentially applicable to any crystallized protein and can quickly generate peptide candidates.   

Peptinov’s value proposition is built on its unique capability to develop anti-self proteins products in the current pharmaceutical markets.

Peptinov's most advanced product targets IL-6, a central pro-inflammatory cytokine involved in the pathogenesis of several diseases. Peptinov's anti-IL-6 immunotherapy is now in phase 1 clinical development.

Name: Laboratoire Greenpharma S.A.S.
Description:
Who we are :

Greenpharma  is a CRO SME of 12 people, specialised in natural compound studies for cosmetic, food and pharmaceutical industries. 
Built around an innovative technological platform, Greenpharma succeeded to gather expertise in wide and complementary fields such as chemoinformatic, pharmacognosy, medicinal & analytical chemistry, pilot scale extraction and formulation. This has led to a unique know-how in natural compound & extract selection, extract purification, metabolite measurement, homology modelling, virtual screening (e.g. SelnergyTM), lead optimisation, ADMET prediction and database building. Greenpharma approach has led to several patents on bioactive (natural or synthetic) molecules and extracts. 

What we do:

Greenpharma provides natural or synthetic compounds for high throughput screening. It utilises in silico tools to select the most relevant molecules (we have access to a database of 20 millions commercial compounds). 

We provide the industries of pharmacy, cosmetics and agro-food with innovative bio-active molecules through R&D projects.
Our services include: 

• Phytochemistry: development of methods for extraction, purification (until pilot scale) and characterisation of metabolites in complex matrices, activity-guided fractionations;

• Molecular modelling: ligand and structure-based virtual screening, QSAR, in silico activity identification (eg drug repositioning, identification of activities for natural compounds...) with our proprietary tool Selnergy;

• Knowledge management: database design and building.

• Medicinal chemistry: synthesis on demand, lead optimisation, natural compound mimics (eg. Pyrazolotriazine...), library design...

• Pilot extraction: development of pre-industrial method to produce cosmetic/food ingredients

• Formulation: development of formulation for cosmetic and dermocosmetic products

Créé fin 2021 par Inès Taurou, INCérès, jeune Start-up innovante, souhaite contribuer à la démonstration technique qu’il est possible de produire des aliments de qualité, en quantité tout en utilisant des méthodes naturelles sans danger pour l’homme et son environnement.

En septembre 2023, le lancement de son projet de biocontrôle est réel, grâce à l’obtention de deux formulations à base d’huiles essentielles d’intérêt contre les pucerons (arboriculture, maraîchage et betterave) et la mouche asiatique des fruits rouges, drosophila suzukii, avec le dépôt de deux brevets. Pour le développement de ses projets, l’entreprise est soutenue par BPI France, Région Sud Investissement, et d’autres partenariats financiers sont en cours de construction.

En parallèle de son activité de recherche, INCérès a évolué pendant deux ans en tant qu’experte auprès des acteurs de l’agrofourniture (distributeurs, fournisseurs, start-up...), en les accompagnant à construire les meilleures méthodes dans leur contexte pour déployer auprès des agriculteurs leurs Biosolutions. INCérès a créé une formation opérationnelle sur la mise en marché des biostimulants à destination de ces acteurs. 

En 2022 et 2023, INCérès est fière d’avoir accompagné pour le déploiement de leurs biosolutions :

-	des acteurs de l’agrofourniture reconnus comme Bayer Crop science, FMC France, delbon et Racine Sap.

Name: BotaniX
Description:
BotaniX is a French botanical biotech platform and a certified B Corp. We grow medicinal plants and produce active substances to the same standard as pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Indoors and soil-free, in a fully controlled environment, every harvest delivers the same composition. That consistency, built over seven years, is what lets us meet that standard. We cultivate under GACP and produce under GMP.

Name: Enodia Therapeutics
Description:
Enodia Therapeutics is a French biotech company building a proprietary small-molecule platform that selectively modulates the SEC61 translocon, a central control point of the protein secretion pathway.
By intervening at the point of synthesis, Enodia redirects disease-driving secreted and transmembrane proteins toward early degradation, before they mature or exert pathological effects, while preserving normal cellular function.
Leveraging a deep, well-characterized chemical space of SEC61 inhibitors, together with proteomics and machine-learning–guided drug design, Enodia enables highly selective, upstream intervention across multiple indications, starting with inflammatory and autoimmune diseases.

Name: ViewPoint Biosurveillance de l'Eau
Description:
10 ans de recherche en partenariat avec INRAE et 2 brevets communs ont  permis de développer ToxMate, station de détection des micropolluants dans l’eau. Unique outil de biosurveillance en temps réel, basé sur l’analyse du comportement de 3 invertébrés aquatiques, la station ToxMate s’impose aujourd’hui comme leader sur le marché de la détection en temps réel et sur site.

Plus de 200 000 molécules sont recensées dans les différentes familles de micropolluants dont les métaux lourds, pesticides, PFAS, résidus médicamenteux, solvants, effets cocktail etc ... impactant directement la qualité des masses d’eau, les milieux naturels et la santé humaine. 

Les  micropolluants dans les eaux échappent souvent aux analyses permises par les capteurs physico-chimiques car  trop nombreux et présents en quantités très faibles.

ToxMate est une station d’alerte de la pollution de l’eau  basée sur l’analyse comportementale de 3 bioindicateurs représentatives des milieux naturels européeens: le  gammare , la sangsue et l’ escargot d’eau douce.
La sensibilité des 3 organismes aquatiques à un très large spectre de substances chimiques permet de signaler la présence de micropolluants dès lors que les espèces modifient leurs comportements

Un outil d’aide à la décision : 

ToxMate est une station d’alerte connectée. Déployable en station d’épuration urbaine, station d’épuration industrielle et usine de potabilisation ou comme station d’alerte sur eau brute, les gestionnaires de traitement reçoivent une alerte en 2 à 10 minutes en cas de présence de micropolluants.

Description:

This has made it possible to develop a MAT with both high sensitivity and robustness, ensuring reliability in the field.

Monocyte Activation Test (MAT)
The Monocyte Activation Test (MAT) is a pyrogen test. MAT uses human blood cells to test for a fever reaction, mimicking the human immune reaction.The MAT serves as the replacement for the Rabbit Pyrogen Test and can be used to test parenteral drugs for endotoxin and non-endotoxin contaminations. Our technology uses cryopreserved pooled PBMC. This has made it possible to develop a MAT with both high sensitivity and robustness, ensuring reliability in the field. The MAT kit includes all the required consumables to perform the Monocyte Activation Test, making it convenient to perform. In addition to the kit we provide consulting services and technical support in setting up the MAT in your organisation.

diverses matrices, produits laitiers ou non, pour le compte de différents
clients : organisations agricoles, industriels, producteurs de lait, producteurs fermiers, administrations...

Le LANO, section agronomique du laboratoire LILANO, répond avec efficacité et rapidité aux attentes des éleveurs et des agriculteurs sur de nombreuses prestations analytiques telles que les fourrages, aliments, terres, reliquats d'azote... 
Le LANO est agréé par le Ministère de l‘Agriculture.

Nos prestations analytiques sont reconnues par différents organismes
officiels et nos compétences couvrent l’ensemble des productions de la
filière laitière, mais également de toutes productions agro-alimentaires.

Name: BioNet
Description: BioNet is a pioneering biotechnology group that specialises in the development of next-generation vaccines. Leveraging its expertise in translational research and its GMP production facilities, BioNet is today the leading global manufacturer of recombinant pertussis vaccines. For 25 years, BioNet has fostered multiple partnerships to accelerate access to technology and to increase and expand global vaccine capability.

Name: Persea
Description:
The tumor microenvironment (TME) is a barrier that prevents conventional drugs from reaching the core of solid tumor.

Persea is a biotech company developing a next-generation treatment that revolutionizes the fight against solid tumors by bypassing the tumor microenvironment barrier.

Our drug candidate combines three therapeutic effects: targeting the tumor microenvironment, tumor destruction via a neighborhood (bystander) effect, and prevention of recurrence through activation of the immune response.

Complete in vivo proof-of-concept results are available.

Persea is one of the innovative projects selected and supported by the Paris Saclay Cancer Cluster, whose mission is to accelerate the development of innovation in oncology.

Name: Argolight
Description:
Argolight designs, manufactures, and sells functionalized fluorescence glass materials for microscopy, dosimetry, data storage, and photonics applications. Our expertise lies in turning unique requirements into bespoke, high‐performance solutions.
Argolight  fuses chemistry, photonics, and software to create on‐demand solutions.
We partner with pharma, diagnostics, and biotech firms to deliver reliable, high‐quality tools.

In microscopy, we provide custom fluorescence standards and monitoring solutions that fit your system. Ever since the company started in 2012, its monitoring slides have been widely recognized for their innovative technology. 
These tools serve both as troubleshooting aids and rigorous quality‐control benchmarks.

Name: GEG-Tech
Description: GEG Tech is a French Deeptech company specializing in genetic engineering, developing innovative technologies for advanced therapies, including gene therapies, vaccines, cancer immunotherapies and dermatology. GEG Tech designs DNA vectors and has invented a new generation of biological mRNA vectors that are far more efficient than chemical nanoparticles and safer than viral vectors. With 12 years of experience in genetic engineering, the company operates as a studio-lab, serving clients primarily in the United States and Europe. GEG Tech’s scientific team originates from the CNRS, and its laboratory is based on the Saclay Plateau near Paris, France

Name: Novescia
Description:
Acteur Majeur de la Biologie Médicale, Novescia se donne pour vocation d’accompagner l’ensemble de ses collaborateurs dans une dynamique professionnelle  de gestion de leur activité en leur donnant les moyens et capacités de réaliser pleinement leur métier et de satisfaire la patientèle.
Nous recherchons dans le cadre de notre développement  des Biologistes médicaux désirant rejoindre un réseau national en pleine croissance, offrant de nombreuses opportunités de développement de carrière (développement d’une expertise médicale et/ou prise de responsabilité managériale plus étendue).
Ces opportunités sont à pourvoir : Ile de France/ Nord /Rhône Alpes/Midi-Pyrénées/la Réunion

Name: Allecra Therapeutics
Description: Allecra Therapeutics, founded in 2013, is a private, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel therapies to combat antibiotic resistance by overcoming emergent resistance mechanisms. Lead product candidate, cefepime/enmetazobactam, has shown superiority over standard of care in patients with complicated urinary tract infections (cUTIs) in a randomized, controlled, double-blind, global Phase 3 trial, and the Company is preparing submissions for marketing approval in the U.S. and EU based on these results. The Company has significant patent protection covering proprietary enmetazobactam in major territories. Allecra’s investors are: Forbion, Andera Partners, Delos Capital, Xeraya Capital, EMBL Ventures, and BioMedPartners. Allecra’s wholly owned French subsidiary is a beneficiary of financial support from Bpifrance and the Région Alsace.

Name: Genexpath
Description:
La société Genexpath, basée à Rouen, développe et produit des kits de diagnostic des cancers.
Basés sur des technologies innovantes et brevetées, ces produits permettent d’établir des diagnostics fiables et rapides, sans achat de matériel supplémentaire.
Genexpath est née de la volonté de mettre à disposition du plus grand nombre les travaux de recherche ayant montré leur efficacité dans la caractérisation de plusieurs cancers dont les sarcomes et les lymphomes. La prise en charge du patient en est ainsi améliorée.

Name: GENXMAP
Description: GenXMap is a French R&D biotechnology company combining in-house wet-lab, bioinformatics and AI expertise with the flexibility of a specialized CRO. From sample to biological insight, GenXMap delivers tailored multi-omics solutions — genomics, transcriptomics and computational biology — for immuno-oncology, cell & gene therapy, dermatology & cosmetics, drug discovery & biotechnology, infectious diseases & microbiome, and precision medicine. Founded in 2020, GenXMap operates part of its laboratories within IHU Méditerranée Infection (Marseille), strengthening its ties to the regional and European scientific ecosystem. Our expert collaborators work as a collaborative extension of your own lab — from experimental design to data interpretation — with validation built in at every step. 100+ projects on unique samples, 500+ terabytes of data analyzed, 95% delivered on time, 30+ academic and industry partnerships.

Name: Ventum Biotech
Description:
Ventum is a biotechnology R&D company specializing in biodefense, developing innovative solutions for air and surface contamination control. We engineer advanced solutions designed to safeguard critical environments from invisible threats — including particulate, biological, chemical, and radioactive contamination.

Founded on more than three decades of technical expertise and real-world field experience, Ventum was founded to redefine the future of environmental safety and overall biodefense. Our mission is to engineer sustainable, high-performance technologies capable of meeting the world’s most demanding contamination challenges.

Operating at the intersection of biotechnology, engineering, and environmental science, we design, engineer, and manufacture intelligent contamination control systems for life sciences, healthcare, biopharmaceutical manufacturing, cleanrooms, and high-security industrial environments where precision, sterility, and reliability are essential.

Name: GOLIVER THERAPEUTICS
Description:
GOLIVER THERAPEUTICS is a spin-off from the INSERM and University of Nantes (CRTI UMR1064-ITUN-Nantes Hospital), focused on developing cell-based Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products (ATMP) to respond to an urgent unmet medical need in transplantation.

GOLIVER THERAPEUTICS aims to become a Worldwide leader inregenerative medicine in providing the first cell-based therapy product for life-threatening liver failures.
Location: Nantes, Pays de la Loire, France

Name: AIS BIOTECH
PKDERM
Description:
Welcome to PKDERM - Your Trusted Partner for In Vitro Safety and Efficacy Solutions.

PKDERM is a leading provider of innovative and effective solutions for in vitro efficacy and safety testing of new products. Our team of experts has years of experience in the industry, and we are committed to delivering the highest level of quality and support to our clients.

At PKDERM, we specialize in in vitro safety and efficacy testing, using a range of biological models such as 2D and 3D human skin equivalent models, excised human skin, 2D and 3D human hepatocytes , and 2D and 3D lung models (PCLS). 

Our testing services cover a range of areas, including dermal absorption, skin irritation, eye irritation, cytotoxicity, phototoxicity, lung fibrosis, metabolism, drug transporters, and drug-drug interactions. 

We also offer in vitro efficacy testing including inflammatory, wound healing, fibrosis, pigmentation, ageing, oxidation, and many more.

At PKDERM, we are passionate about excellence and dedicated to customer satisfaction. 

Contact us today to learn more about our solutions and how we can help you achieve your goals.

Company: PKDERM SAS
contact@pkderm.com
https://www.pkderm.com

Name: Immusmol
Description:
Over the past decade, Immusmol specialized in the development of antibodies against low molecular weight compounds (<900 Daltons), eventually building a portfolio of unique primary antibodies and ELISA kits for research use.

50 + unique primary antibodies
We develop monoclonal & polyclonal antibodies and staining procedures for the visualization of small molecules in cells & tissues.

80+ ELISAs cross-validated by LC-MS
Our team develops highly sensitive ELISA kits to measure amino acids and their metabolites in biological samples.

600+ clients served worldwide
We deliver our products worldwide through Fedex and developed a network of trusted distributors in America, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Oceania.

Name: ZYTOMICS
Description: ZYTOMICS, as a leading manufacturer and provider of a continuously evolving and comprehensive portfolio of clinical cancer diagnostic products, strives to equip pathologists in public institutions and private labs with products, solutions, and expertise they need to reach a precise and trustworthy cancer diagnosis.

Name: X'PROCHEM
Description:
X’PROCHEM is a biotech company who invented an advanced and proprietary ligation technology. We help our bio-pharma partners design and create therapeutic, vaccine and diagnostic proteins.

Unlike recombinant fermentation we can produce proteins containing up to 400 amino acids, without isoforms, endotoxins, or biological contaminants.

We co develop solutions with our partners to understand the real needs within the context. By working closely, we can adapt to changing needs and circumstances.

Name: Nucleate France UniCA
Description:
Nucleate is a nonprofit organization dedicated to empowering the next generation of biotech leaders. We believe that the grand challenges of our time will be solved by the academics who transform experiments into enterprises. Nucleate removes barriers so they can concentrate on building transformational technologies.

Nucleate est une organisation à but non lucratif dédiée à former et accompagner la prochaine génération de leaders en biotechnologie. Nous croyons que les grands défis de notre époque seront résolus par les universitaires qui transforment les expériences en entreprises. 
Nucleate écartent les obstacles afin qu'ils puissent se concentrer essentiellement sur la création de technologies transformationnelles.

Name: Seekyo Therapeutics
Description:
The heterogeneity of cancer cells constitutes a strong limitation for the treatment of solid cancers like pancreas and Breast TNBC.

Shifting to a new paradigm, Seekyo, a pre-clinical biotech Co. overpowers this challenge by targeting specific functional proteins selectively produced within the Tumor Micro-Environment (TME).

Seekyo’s lead compound SKY01 induces a selective tumor self-destruction:
•	Efficacy and safety validated in small and large animals (e.g. Dogs).
•	Unprecedented antitumor efficacy vs. Standards of Care 
•	Efficient in several tumors (Pancreas, Triple Negative Breast Cancer, lung, colorectal...) 
•	Low Cost of Goods

Name: Kloe France
Description:
KLOE is a leader in photolithography systems, providing cutting-edge instrumentation for nearly 25 years. 
It is the only manufacturer offering a full range of photolithography equipment worldwide, covering mask-based lithography, direct laser writing, and even 3D printing via stereolithography:

• UV-KUB Series: Includes the UV-KUB-2 and UV-KUB-3 mask aligners, the latter awarded "Mask Aligner Manufacturer of the Year 2025." These tabletop systems use an advanced LED matrix with unparalleled collimation (divergence <1.5°), ensuring high resolution and the ability to expose thick layers with vertical sidewalls.

• Dilase Series: A range of maskless laser writers available in tabletop and standalone versions. KLOE’s advanced optics enable single-pass writing in thick layers while maintaining vertical sidewalls and high aspect ratios (up to 1:50). Its vectorial writing mode eliminates pattern roughness and can be combined with scanning for optimized speed.

• Dilase 3D: Designed for high-resolution 3D microfabrication (<5 μm) while offering a large build volume, this system fills a gap in the market. KLOE’s advanced optical processing ensures smooth and low-roughness sidewalls, making it ideal for demanding applications in microfluidics and photonics.

KLOE has installed over 600 systems worldwide serving industries and research institutes working in microelectronics, photonics, mechanics, microfluidics, and surface structuring, among others.

Name: Research Labs @ SupBiotech
Description: Sup'Biotech School for Bioengineering hosts 4 academic  laboratories in the fields of stem cell research, food & environement, bio-informatics, bioproduction and social science

Name: Extracellular Vesicles in Clinical Applications - EVCA
Description:
EVCA stands for Extracellular Vesicles in Clinical Applications and is an acronym of the project titled "Centre for Excellence in Diagnostic and Advanced Therapeutics based on Extracellular Vesicles". The overall aim of EVCA is to strengthen NMS to become an internationally-recognized Centre of EVs in clinical applications, research and innovation. By partnering with two internationally-leading institutions, Institut Curie, France, and CIC bioGUNE, Spain, EVCA will leverage the existing multidisciplinary knowledge and experience, research and training best practices, widen collaborative networks, and step up the excellence of the researchers and research management at NOVA Medical School. 

Follow us on X @EVCA_Twinning and BlueSky @evca-twinning.bsky.social

Name: GMT Science
Description:
GMT Science is an innovative medtech company harnessing standardized, high-resolution stool metagenomics and AI-driven data science to develop in vitro diagnostics (IVD), brought to clinicians via medical laboratories. 

It brings together a multidisciplinary team of microbiome experts, clinicians, AI specialists, data scientists and medical software engineers to develop in vitro diagnostics leveraging the gut microbiome.

GMT Science has developed BiomScope, a proprietary CE-marked IVD software to accurately measure microbial species, genes and functions, outperforming reference metagenomics pipelines.

Its first product, IOScope, is an in vitro diagnostics predicting the response to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI). By predicting the response to ICI, IOScope allows personalizing treatments, maximizes their benefits and optimizes medical spendings.

The company leverages its collaborations with leading hospitals across Europe and North America and its unique database of over 20,000 curated clinical samples to discover and validate indicationspecific microbiome biomarkers.

Name: Eurofins Cerep
Description:
Depuis sa création en 1989, Eurofins Cerep dispose d’une forte expertise dans l’industrie pharmaceutique en tant que prestataire de service de tests pharmacologiques in vitro et producteur de réactifs pour la recherche en biologie (EDPF). 

Eurofins Cerep est spécialisé dans le développement de tests in vitro pour accélérer la découverte de médicaments. Les résultats de nos tests apportent des informations précieuses à nos clients concernant leurs molécules en développement et ce, dès les phases précoces de leur R&D.

Eurofins DiscoverX Products France (EDPF) est spécialisé dans la production de réactifs stratégiques comme les protéines purifiées utilisées pour les tests enzymatiques (kinases et autres enzymes).

Le site d’Eurofins Cerep et EDPF, certifié Great Place To Work, défend des valeurs de Bienveillance, Droit à l’erreur, Dynamisme, Agilité, Résilience, Subsidiarité, Confiance et Cohésion.

Pour consulter les postes à pourvoir : https://careers.eurofins.com/fr

Name: in-EV
Description:
in-EV is a company fully dedicated to providing researchers with innovative, cutting-edge tools and services for research on extracellular vesicles (EVs, of which exosomes).

in-EV was created in December 2024 as a subsidiary of Ciloa SAS, a pioneer in exosome R&D with over 14 years of experience in bioengineering exosomes to develop a new generation of vaccines and therapeutic vectors.

in-EV catalogue includes:

-	Extra pure EVs, either standard or customised, fully characterised using standardised quality controls. Customised EVs are bioengineered using Ciloa technology, allowing to i) target proteins at the EV surface or ii) load proteins into the EV lumen without overexpression or modification of natural EV proteins.

-	Kits to isolate and purify EVs from different sources, with different levels of purity.

-	Kits to characterise EVs for the presence of EV markers, for purity and integrity, for the absence of contaminants and for the localisation of cargoes.

-	Services to contribute to EV research projects: regular services (EV production, EV purification and EV characterisation) and unique EV bioengineering services.

Name: StarkAge Therapeutics
Description:
StarkAge Therapeutics is a biotechnology company based in Lille, France, pioneering first-in-class senolytic antibody–drug conjugates (ADCs) to address age-related diseases, with an initial focus on oncology.
The company’s lead program, STX-1, is a first-in-class ADC targeting DPP4, a highly selective marker of cellular senescence and a relevant tumor-associated antigen. STX-1 is currently progressing toward IND-enabling studies.

Name: LC INGREDIENTS
Description:
LC Ingredients distributes innovative and high-tech healthy ingredients, organic vitamins and minerals dedicated to dietary (and pet food) supplements and cosmetic applications.
We also develop tailor made white label products formulated from the same ingredients that we distribute in bulk. 
Fell free to contact us for new projects, we'll be happy to become your partner!

Name: Metesa France
Description:
METESA FRANCE is an 90 people medical services company, who provide technical services on behalf of major medical manufacturers. We own 2 workshops facilities for reonditioning and repair, and a network of 60 FSE who provides maintenance and repair services all over France and Benelux in medical devices including imagery, hospital devices, and In Vitro Diagnostic equipment performed in Med Lab, Hospital, clinics.
We have started in 2020 an Application department in Medical Biology with now 10 Application Engineers, and we also hold a specialized Installation Team for complex installation of Medical and IDV systems/

METESA FRANCE Key figures:
- 35 years experiences
- More than 40 healthcare major manufacturers served everyday
- About 16000 field interventions per year
- 60 Field engineers highly trained in medical service operating all over France and Benelux
- 7000 workshop intervention on our 2 technical facilities
 
 
METESA FRANCE est une société de 90 collaborateurs, partenaire des constructeurs médicaux et DIV pour l’externalisation de leur service client. Nous réalisons le service technique, à savoir ; l’installation, les maintenances préventives et curatives sur des équipements médicaux : Diagnostic In Vitro (Biologie Médicale), Imagerie médicale, Dispositifs médicaux hospitaliers...

Nous disposons d’un réseau de 60 Techniciens terrains (FSE) en France et Belgique, ainsi que de deux ateliers à Paris Nord et à Lens où nous faisons du reconditionnement et de la réparation atelier.
Depuis 2020, nous avons un département de 10 Ingénieurs d’Applications en Biologie Médicale, et réalisons aussi de l’Application en Imagerie. 
Nos chiffres clés :
- 35 ans d’expérience
- 40 clients parmi les plus grands constructeurs médicaux
- 60 techniciens terrains (FSE)
- 16000 interventions terrain par an
- 7000 interventions ateliers par an

Name: AlgoTx
Description:
AlgoTx is a clinical stage biotechnology company developing targeted, first in class therapeutics for peripheral neuropathic pain. 

Non-opioid, locally acting ATX01 is designed to treat the pain of Chemotherapy-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy, a common and painful side-effect of cancer treatments. It targets the signaling pathways involved in the regulation of pain by selectively inhibiting specific nociceptive sodium channel receptors. FDA granted ATX01 Fast-Track designation.

The ACT study is an international Phase II randomized, placebo-controlled trial involving over 270 patients ; The results will be available in early 2025 and the company is making plans to expedite a Phase 3 trial.

The company has seasoned leadership, with experience of bringing global products successfully to market, and is backed by an international board. AlgoTx raised a Series B round of EUR 20 million in 2023 and has raised EUR 35 million to date. AlgoTx has a consortium of investors including Relyens Innovation Santé / Turenne Capital, who led the Series B fund raise, along with UI Investissement, and angel investors. Historical investors include Bpifrance through its Innobio 2 fund and Omnes Capital. 

In 2023, the company won France Biotech’s prestigious ESG HealthTech Trophy in recognition of its early commitment to ESG initiatives.

For more information, see the company’s website

Name: GenEvolutioN
Description:
GenEvolutioN, a NEW expert company, is dedicated to In vitro and Genetic Toxicology services where new Human and animal Cells models (Stem cells, iPS) will be proposed.
The originality of GenEvolutioN is to enhance the interactions between PreClinical and Clinical areas, according to clients challenges.
GenEvolutioN platform will combine Innovative Techniques with Scientific Insights.
The strength of GenEvolutioN company is based on flexible and strong-skilled people with large expertise in R&D services.
In vitro & Innovative Services: anticipate tomorrow’s challenges !
OUR TECHNIQUE
GenEvolutioN connects various techniques according to industrial and clinical requirements, fitting to client strategy.
GenEvolutioN is the result of many years of Research and aims to improve health of patients exposed to toxic agents, as well as to develop further personalized medical treatments and innovative approaches.

Name: Solyve
Description:
Solyve is a French producer and formulator of enzymes and biosolutions, based in Normandy since 1989.

Our team of experts develops enzymatic solutions to help food companies meet challenges such as process optimization and improving the quality of food and beverages. Our mission and belief are to provide our partners—manufacturers, formulators, and distributors—with effective, sustainable, and non-GMO enzymatic alternatives.

Name: ILIFE CONSULTING
Description:
With over 25 years of experience and more than 30 supervised clinical trials, our team is specialised in early clinical development, transforming clinical data into value-creating assets for your company.
We support leading biotechs such as ImCheck Therapeutics, Hephaistos Pharma, and Brenus Pharma, as well as prestigious clinical sites, like Gustave Roussy. Our expertise in FIH and PoC studies enables us to generate critical data that enhance your assets’ value and support your fundraising efforts. 
ILife is now part of Comac Medical Group, bringing clients enhanced clinical development and regulatory expertise within a pan-European full-service CRO.

What sets us apart:
•	A senior team combining scientific expertise with strategic vision
•	Deep understanding of the value-creation challenges faced by biotechs
•	An entrepreneurial approach tailored for emerging biotechs
•	Personalized support with a dedicated point of contact
•	Expertise in optimizing clinical data

We create tailored plans to meet each partner's unique needs, covering study design, budget planning, and financing strategies. Our strength also lies in a team of experts and an extensive network of carefully selected partners offering complementary services, including CMC regulatory, non-clinical regulatory, eDC, biometrics, vigilance, and quality assurance.

 What we offer: From strategic consulting to comprehensive CRO services - including study design, budget startup, oversight, and closeout - we deliver personalized solutions to support your growth, maximize the value of your innovations, and ensure faster access to patients.


 Looking for a partner who understands the complexity of drug development? Discover how ILife Consulting, now part of Comac Medical Group, can elevate your clinical development. Let's drive innovation together!

Name: Rhenovia Pharma
Description:
RHENOVIA Pharma is a French biotech company founded in 2007 by an international team comprising executives of the big pharmaceutical industry and world experts in the fields of neurosciences and modeling of the nervous system. 
In less than 5 years, Rhenovia became a biosimulation world leader in CNS. Its worldwide unique modeling technology makes it possible to reproduce on computers the cellular and molecular mechanisms of the brain and the neuronal transmission. Rhenovia uses its technology to create computational models that simulate the condition of healthy persons or affected by pathologies of the nervous system (Alzheimer, Parkinson, epilepsy, schizophrenia, depression). These simulators make it possible to predict the effectiveness and toxicity of molecules and combinations of molecules. 
The relevance of Rhenovia’s breakthrough biosimulation technology was shown not only by comparing its results with experimental data obtained from independent laboratories, but also through the discovery of new drug candidates (Huntington’s disease) and the identification of toxicity or side-effects of molecules under development.
Rhenovia’s studies for the pharma and biotech industry consist of service offers or research and development partnerships to decrease new drugs development timelines while reducing risks and associated costs. Rhenovia’s technology also finds applications in the agro-food industry and is also applicable to neurotoxicity for civil and military applications.

Name: Centre MEARY AP-HP
Description: Installé au sein d’un bâtiment dédié à la recherche à l’hôpital Saint-Louis AP-HP, le Centre MEARY de Thérapie Cellulaire et Génique de l’AP-HP a pour vocation la production et la distribution de médicaments de thérapie innovante (MTI) expérimentaux pour des maladies graves, chroniques ou rares, telles que les leucémies, l’insuffisance cardiaque, les brûlures oculaires. Ces médicaments qui représentent un formidable espoir pour les malades sont des alternatives aux traitements dits conventionnels.

Name: Barenbrug France
Description:
Barenbrug France fait partie du Royal Barenbrug Group, une société semencière active à l'échelle mondiale et dont le siège se trouve aux Pays-Bas. Le groupe Barenbrug est une entreprise familiale indépendante. Après plus de 100 ans d'expérience, notre réputation internationale repose toujours sur nos valeurs fondamentales que sont l'innovation, la qualité, le marketing et le partenariat.

La recherche et le développement dans toutes les zones climatiques majeures à travers le monde, ainsi que l'innovation continue ont abouti à une gamme unique de produits de spécialité de haute qualité. La société développe des partenariats à long terme avec ses clients et ses producteurs de semences et participe à des accords de recherche avec les grandes universités et instituts. Un savoir-faire unique est à la base de notre large gamme de produits. Notre marque est synonyme de qualité supérieure!

En France, Barenbrug est établie depuis plus de 40 ans et dispose de deux stations de recherche à Mas-Grenier dans le Gers (82)  et à Connantre dans la Marne (51). C'est également depuis son usine de Connantre que la société produit, prépare et conditionne la majorité des semences vendues en France. Le siège social de Barenbrug France est situé dans des locaux flambants neufs à Montévrain (77).

Name: ImPact Biotech
Description:
ImPact Biotech is focused on the development and launch of Padeliporfin VTP (Vascular Targeted Photodynamic) therapy for the treatment of solid tumors. The company is headquartered in Israel, with presence in Luxembourg, France and USA, as well as its own GMP-certified (Good Manufacturing Practice) facility and research center in Israel.
ImPact Biotech holds exclusive rights from the Weizmann Institute of Science (WIS, Israel) and Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center (MSKCC, New York), to develop and commercialize drugs and related technologies used in VTP.

Name: IROC
Description: TechBio

Name: Vilber - Smart Imaging
Description:
VILBER is a leading life science company that develops and manufacture imaging and analyzing systems for fluorescence, chemiluminescence and bioluminescence applications.

Since its foundation in 1954, Vilber thinks and breathes innovation every day. It is the Company’s driver of growth but also its passion. Innovation must continuously respond to a key challenge: designing imaging systems that are ever of the future more intuitive, autonomous, connected and respectful of the environment.

The R&D Department plays a central role in the innovation process at Vilber as does the Design Center, which is responsible for the state-of-the-art product design and ergonomics. The R&D combines engineers, scientists and technicians with a passion for development and a commitment to delivering technology with simplicity.

VILBER has pioneered the post electrophoresis market and introduced breakthrough products such as stand-alone gel-documentation, Bio-1D imaging software, Super-Bright UV technology, dedicated chemiluminescence imaging system and 3D approach to 1D gel analysis.

Through a network of owned subsidiary offices and local distributors located in over 100 countries around the world, VILBER offers a broad range of imaging products for the life science research.

Quality is at the heart of our work. Vilber strives to exceed customer expectations by continually improving the quality of our products. Our premium products and services meet the highest standards.

As one of the industry’s technology leaders, we have set industry standards time and again over past decades – with future-oriented ideas that contribute to making repetitive laboratory workflows simple, precise, safe and efficient.

Name: ILONOV
Description:
The European Diabetes Study Center has gathered a team of renowned scientific and medical experts, pioneers in their field of expertise, to fund a biotech company, ILONOV, focused on developing a novel class of therapeutics using the therapeutic potential of our muscle-derived biologic.
We aim at satisfying unmet medical needs in Type 1 Diabetes therapy by bringing to the market a first-in-class treatment for curing and preventing T1D and using our discovery to open up a new field of therapeutics.

Name: Laboratoires NOVACOS
Description:
Laboratoire de R&D, fabrication et conditionnement de cosmétiques.

A propos des laboratoires Novacos : 

L'innovation et le savoir-faire sont au cœur des engagements de nos laboratoires. Nous fabriquons selon la norme BPF ISO 22716 et notre entreprise est engagées ECOCERT pour réaliser tout type de cosmétique naturel et bio ou selon la norme ISO 16128.

Les capacités de fabrication des laboratoires Novacos :

- 200 tonnes d'émulsions à chaud
- 360 000 litres de liquides fabriqués à froid
- 5 millions de tubes par an
- 1,6 million de flacons, pots et roll-ons par an

Les expertises des laboratoires Novacos : 

- Emulsions, sérums, produits solaires, produits moussants, gels, huiles, lotions...
- Conditionnements possibles : flacons, pots, tubes, roll-ons, avec ou sans étui.

Pour plus d'informations, rendez-vous sur www.novacos.fr !

Name: LXRepair 2013-2023
Description:
In a context where the rate of cancer treatment failure is still unacceptably high, our mission is to provide decision aids to oncologists. 

We believe that profiling is key to predicting treatment toxicity to patients and effectiveness on tumors.

Over a decade of research by the French Atomic Energy Commission (CEA) on the impact of radiations on DNA has resulted in a deep understanding of the essential DNA repair mechanisms. 

More recently, a set of innovative biomarkers was developed that provides a complete functional signature of these mechanisms, the premise to powerful tools for personalized treatment of cancer.

http://www.lxrepair.com

Name: ENTOINNOV
Description:
: Entoinnov est une société spécialisée dans la vente de vers de farine. Elle a vu le jour en 2021 grâce à Faycal Ounnas CEO de Entoinnov. 
 
Notre société de biotechnologie propose des ingrédients à base d'insectes, bénéfiques pour la santé et l'environnement.
Notre bioprocédé innovant à base d'insectes convertit les sous-produits agricoles en ingrédients superalimentaires pour l'alimentation humaine et animale.

 : Entoinnov is a company specialising in the sale of mealworms. It was founded in 2021 by Faycal Ounnas, CEO of Entoinnov. 

Our biotechnology company offers insect-based ingredients, with health and environment benefits.
Our innovative insect bioprocess converts agricultural byproducts into superfood ingredients for human and animal nutrition.

Name: Orev - Marine Biotechnology
Description:
Orev développe des biosolutions marines innovantes pour accompagner la transition agricole vers des modèles plus durables et résilients.

Dans un contexte agricole sous tension, nous formulons des solutions issues des biotechnologies marines, concentrant des principes actifs naturels capables de stimuler la croissance, activer les défenses naturelles des plantes et renforcer leur résistance aux stress abiotiques.

Name: EYEVENSYS
Description:
Eyevensys is a clinical stage, private, biotechnology company developing its innovative EyeCET platform to enable the sustained intraocular production of therapeutic proteins to treat a broad range of ophthalmic disease.

EyeCET stands for the eye ciliary muscle electro-transfection technology, which uses electroporation to deliver plasmids coding for therapeutic proteins in the eye. EyeCET is safe and non-viral, and it enables the ciliary muscle cells to sustainably produce therapeutic proteins locally. 

Eyevensys believes its EyeCET technology can improve short and long-term therapeutic outcomes, greatly enhancing patient compliance and significantly improve the tolerability of treatment. 

Eyevensys’ lead product EYS606 is a potential new treatment for patients with non-infectious Uveitis (NIU), the 4th cause of blindness in the world. 

EYS606 uses Eyevensys’ proprietary electro-transfection injection system (ETIS) to deliver a plasmid encoding for the production of an anti-TNF alpha-alpha cytokine that has been shown to play a pivotal role in mediating intraocular inflammation in NIU. EYS606 which been granted an Orphan designation by the EMA for the treatment of NIU, has received in February 2017 the regulatory clearances from the UK MHRA and the French ANSM Health Agencies to begin a Phase I/II clinical trials. 

Subsequently, a multicentre clinical study has just been initiated in France and the UK.

Description:
Sweetech is a pioneering deeptech startup fueled by a passion for biotechnology and the untapped power of sugars. While these remarkable molecules offer endless potential across nutraceutical, cosmetic, and pharmaceutical markets, their true value has long remained out of reach—until now.
Our patented, eco-friendly fermentation & biocatalytic platform is a game-changer. It enables us to industrially produce a vast array of innovative oligosaccharides, opening doors to transformative health solutions and unlocking new market opportunities.

Name: EnnoDC
Description:
EnnoDC is a clinical-stage biotech that designs and develops DC engagers.
By simultaneously allowing antigen-priming and controlled activation of dendritic cells in-vivo, these next generation immunotherapies induce a precise, broad and durable immune response in patients with the toughest cancer or viral infection.
Our proprietary DC engagers’ studio has fueled a dynamic pipeline of 5 antibody candidates. After a first clinical validation in HIV and COVID-19, the company is now advancing two programs in HPV16+ oropharyngeal and prostate cancer.

Founded in 2020, the company is located in PariSanté Campus (Paris, France) and Kendall Square (Cambridge, Massachusetts, USA).

The company's versatile platform, validated in infectious disease trials, is now advancing two programs in immuno-oncology:

• EDC.HPVE6E7 targets the Human Papilloma Virus HPV16 E6/E7 antigens in patients with HPV-16 induced oropharyngeal cancer, the most common form of this disease accounting for more than 60% of head-and-neck cancer cases.

This DC engager candidate is currently evaluated in a Phase I/II multicentric double-blind placebo-controlled dose escalation trial (NCT06007092). The study is conducted by Gustave Roussy, Europe’s first cancer center. In December 2024, EnnoDC has presented encouraging preliminary data at ESMO IO.

• EDC.PCA targets prostate cancer antigens. Prostate cancer is the second most frequent cancer in men, has the best survival rates (97% at 5 years) but the challenge of recurrence is still a major concern (up to 40% of patients). EDC.PCA is currently in preclinical development stage.

Les principales applications touchent la purification cellulaires et moléculaires et les immunoanalyses dans le diagnostic in vitro.
 
Nous proposons également des supports magnétiques, des instruments (thermoshaker, pipette électronique à écartement variable) et des automates (d'extraction et de pipetage).
 
Nous étudions toute problématique R&D dans la plus stricte confidentialité, et intervenons sous la forme de contrats pour la réalisation d'études de faisabilité, la fabrication d'échantillons ou la production de lots.

Name: ECE 2026 - XIII European Congress of Entomology
Description:
The XIII European Congress of Entomology will take place in Tours, France, at the heart of the Loire Valley, from June 29 to July 3, 2026.
ECE 2026 follows the tradition of previous ECE meetings – from the 1978 inaugural congress in Reading to the 2023 vibrant gathering in Heraklion– by bringing together the international entomological community to share knowledge, foster collaboration, and inspire future research.

As the world faces profound ecological and sociological challenges, insects have never been more vital – or more fascinating and are becoming key allies in addressing a wide range of societal issues. They provide essential ecosystem services – such as pollination, pest regulation, nutrient cycling, and soil enhancement and contribute to sustainable food production, organic waste recycling, and the development of bio-based innovations. At the same time, they remind us of the delicate balance between benefits and risks: while some insects act as pests, vectors of disease, or invasive species, others offer powerful, nature-based solutions to foster ecosystem resilience, improve human, animal or plant health, and support the transition toward a more sustainable future.

ECE 2026 is the ideal forum for exploring cutting edge insect science through a rich program of plenary and keynote lectures, symposia, and poster sessions to stimulate interdisciplinary dialogue from fundamental science to innovation, from the molecular scale to global policy, and from biodiversity conservation to sustainable development.

Where better than Tours to have these discussions? Nestled in Loire Valley UNESCO world heritage region, Tours is perfect to explore the French art de vivre. Expect brilliant discussions by day, and equally brilliant gastronomy by night in our historic city, surrounded by stunning Loire Valley castles.

We are committed to making ECE 2026 a memorable and high-quality experience, full of engaging science, new connections.

Bienvenue à Tours!

Description:
Voxcan is a CRO specialized in non-invasive high-resolution imaging for non-clinical drug development, based in Lyon, France.Voxcan’s core businesses have been in oncology, viral and bacterial infectious diseases, osteo-articular inflammatory diseases and medical devices for 16 years, performing efficacy, biodistribution, mechanistic and proof of concept studies based on in vitro and in vivo models combined with high-resolution imaging in a wide range of small animal species.

Our core expertise in non-clinical 3D CT (computed tomography) imaging, 3D high resolution imaging (μCT i.e. X-ray micro-computed tomography) and non-invasive bioluminescence and fluorescence imaging, ensures longitudinal monitoring of compound efficacy and biodistribution combined with mechanistic analyses based on technologies such as flow cytometry, Luminex and qPCR. By providing high-technology readouts, our ultimate goal is to help Pharma, Biotech and Medical Device companies accelerate the time-to-market of their candidate therapies.

Description:
The world’s population is estimated to reach more than nine billion by 2050. Global food production will have to increase by 70 per cent to feed everyone. Meanwhile one third of all food produced is wasted.

At nextProtein we’re driven by a personal desire to address land and resource scarcity and feed a rising population sustainably. nextProtein can produce the equivalent amount of protein from 100sqm as 100ha of soya field.

Founded by couple Syrine Chaalala and Mohamed Gastli, we produce insect-based protein for animal feedstocks with a negligible carbon footprint, at a lower cost and with the equivalent nutritional value of traditional protein production. We do this by taking otherwise unconsumed food on which to raise the insects, returning protein to the food cycle.

nextProtein has years of experience in breeding Black Soldier Fly, which was selected specially for its beneficial, high-yield quality. Fly larvae are raised, harvested and then processed into valuable components of animal feed: an insect based protein for aquaculture, livestock and pets, an extracted fat and a natural fertilizer for use in agriculture.

Our process is EU-approved for aquaculture and pet food and is suitable for feedstocks for the poultry and pork industries.

Our team is composed of highly qualified specialists, most holding PhDs in fields directly related to biotherapy and bioproduction. This advanced scientific expertise, combined with hands-on industry experience, enables us to deliver rigorous, impactful support to organizations across Europe and internationally.

We strengthen the biotherapy sector, support companies’ growth and competitiveness, and advance bioproduction capabilities to accelerate the development, manufacturing, and commercialization of therapeutic biomolecules.

For more information, please contact us at: contact@mabdesign.fr

Name: Micropep Technologies
Description: Micropep is an innovative plant biotechnology company developing the next generation of biological crop protection solutions based on the incredible potential of micropeptides; short natural peptide molecules that target and regulate plant genes and proteins.

Name: HELLO NATURE
Description:
HELLO NATURE!
Quality, passion and  innovation have always been our leading values. Operating today in more than 70 countries worldwide, with 4 production sites and many commercial offices, HELLO NATURE offers a wide range of organic fertilizers, biostimulants of vegetal origin, beneficial microbials certified all over the world.
Every dawning day HELLO NATURE is at farmers side, with hands in the earth, heart in the fruit, head in science. Every day, since fifty years, we search for innovative solutions to grow our ideal of a sustainable future, in respect of Nature and human health alike.

Name: GenSight Biologics
Description: GenSight Biologics  is a clinical-stage biotechnology company discovering and developing novel therapies for neurodegenerative retinal diseases and diseases of the central nervous system. GenSight Biologics’ pipeline leverages two core technology platforms, the Mitochondrial Targeting Sequence (MTS) and optogenetics for retinitis pigmentosa, to help preserve or restore vision in patients suffering from severe degenerative retinal diseases. GenSight Biologics’ lead product candidate, GS010, is in Phase III trials in Leber’s Hereditary Optic Neuropathy (LHON), a rare mitochondrial disease that leads to irreversible low vision and legal blindness in teens and young adults. Using its gene therapy-based approach, GenSight Biologics’ product candidates are designed to be administered in a single treatment to each eye by intravitreal injection to offer patients a sustainable functional visual recovery.

Name: Amolyt Pharma
Description:
Amolyt Pharma is building on its team’s established expertise to deliver life-changing treatments to patients suffering from rare endocrine and related diseases. 

Amolyt Pharma’s portfolio includes eneboparatide (AZP-3601), a long-acting PTH1 receptor agonist as a potential treatment for hypoparathyroidism, and AZP-3813, a peptide growth hormone receptor antagonist for the potential treatment of acromegaly. 

Amolyt Pharma aims to further expand and develop its portfolio by leveraging its global network in the field of endocrinology and with support from a strong syndicate of international investors.

Name: EPISKIN
Description: EPISKIN SA, world pioneerin tissue engineering, is partnering with cosmetical, pharmaceutical, chemical industries to develop relevant and reliable safety and efficacy tests for decision making during research and development phases. Some screening tests are referenced and validated as alternatives to animal use, others are in the process of validation. Developed since 1992, their unique cell culture process allows to mass produce in vitro reconstructed human tissues with well characterized histology, functionality and ultrastructure features. The production unit is geared to serve every week our clients with thousands of human tissues.

Name: Inventiva Pharma
Description:
At Inventiva, we are united in developing differentiated treatments for MASH and making a meaningful difference in the lives of those affected.

Recognizing that MASH is not just a liver disease but also a cardiometabolic condition, we have purposefully designed a potential oral therapy — currently in clinical development — intended to restore metabolic balance at the source and directly target inflammation and fibrosis.

Our goal is to bring relief to patients across the MASH patient population, addressing a critical unmet need in a progressive and life-threatening disease.

Our product candidate, lanifibranor, has been granted FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation and is now being evaluated in a global Phase 3 clinical trial.

Name: Ziwig Biotech
Description:
Ziwig Biotech is a biotechnology company pioneering the analysis of salivary RNA and the application of artificial intelligence to biomolecular biology.
At the crossroads of medicine, data science, and digital technology, Ziwig develops non-invasive tests and therapeutic biomarkers designed to transform the diagnosis and management of chronic diseases—particularly those affecting women.

Its flagship innovation, Endotest, is the first non-invasive and highly reliable saliva-based test for the diagnosis of endometriosis. This breakthrough innovation, multiple award-winner (Galien Prize, Tech For Future Award), exemplifies Ziwig’s ability to revolutionize women’s health through the convergence of biotechnology, artificial intelligence, and precision medicine.

Ziwig operates at the heart of a rapidly evolving global health ecosystem, where universal access to diagnosis and prevention is a major challenge for equity and sustainability.
Through its scientific and societal commitment, Ziwig contributes to building a more human, accessible, and universal precision medicine—serving patients, healthcare professionals, and the health systems of the future.

 www.ziwig.com

Name: Sensorion
Description:
Sensorion is a pioneering clinical-stage biotechnology company which specializes in the development of novel therapies to restore, treat and prevent within the field of hearing loss disorders 

Its clinical-stage portfolio includes one Phase 2 product: SENS-401 (Arazasetron) progressing in a planned Phase 2 proof of concept clinical study of SENS-401 in Cisplatin-Induced Ototoxicity (CIO) and, with partner Cochlear Limited, a study of SENS-401 in patients scheduled for cochlear implantation.
 
Sensorion has entered into a broad strategic collaboration with the Institut Pasteur focused on the genetics of hearing. It has two gene therapy programs aimed at correcting hereditary monogenic forms of deafness including OTOF-GT, targeting deafness caused by a mutation of the gene encoding for otoferlin, and hearing loss related to mutation in GJB2 gene to potentially address important hearing loss segments in adults and children (GJB2-GT).

Name: Genomines
Description:
We are Genomines. We genetically enhance metal hyperaccumulator plants to produce bio-sourced metals and limit the environmental impact of mining groups.
We are hiring! Apply on Lever now: https://jobs.eu.lever.co/genomines

Name: QIMA Life Sciences
Description:
QIMA Life Sciences (formerly Bioalternatives, Synelvia, Newtone Technologies and Monasterium Laboratory) is a Contract Research Organization (CRO) specializing in cellular and molecular pharmacology.
We offer assays ranging from in silico screening to non-invasive clinical sample bioanalysis,  as well as in vitro and ex vivo assays.
QIMA Life Sciences contributes to the development of in vitro methods, by offering solutions dedicated to preclinical research and to the development of drug candidates and to cosmetic active ingredients and formulations.
QIMA Life Sciences can assist the health industry with its new strategic choices and helps the marketing and R&D departments to innovate in the field of project conceptualization and to substantiate and support their product claims.

Contact us at: ls@qima.com

Name: Keen Eye by Tribun Health
Description:
Keen Eye is the AI platform company that elevates computational pathology to guide better drug development and diagnostics. 
*** Keen Eye has recently been acquired by Tribun Health*** 
Tribun Health powers the digital transformation of cancer diagnosis by designing innovative AI-based solutions to enable the management, analysis and sharing of pathology images for diagnostic labs, pharmaceutical and CRO companies.
Please also check the Tribun Health website: https://www.tribun.health/

Name: Pili
Description:
Pili, carbon conscious color company 

Pili is the leader in bio-based colorants and pigments. Its unique fermentation and sustainable chemistry processes, enable the production of high-performance, and low-carbon colors.
Its technology aims at decarbonizing the color industry by drastically reducing the use of chemicals and fossil resources, particularly oil. Its products are designed for the textile, inks, paints & coatings and plastics sectors.
Founded in 2015, Pili operates from 3 different sites: Toulouse White Biotechnology (TWB), Paris and the Roches-Roussillon industrial platform in Isère. With around 40 employees to date, the company has invested over €35 million since its launch to industrialize its innovative processes.

Name: InvivoGen
Description:
At InvivoGen, we strive to provide life scientists worldwide with innovative, high quality and reliable reagents. As specialists in cell culture engineering and innate immunity, we are passionate about designing, developing, and bringing to market new tools and services for cutting-edge research. At our three regional headquarters — in Toulouse (France), San Diego (USA) and Hong Kong (China) — and through our dedicated multilingual customer support staff, we can provide researchers around the globe with the reagents and product information that they need to make the scientific breakthroughs of tomorrow.

InvivoGen is a privately held company founded by university researchers in 1977 in Toulouse, France. Since then, we have gradually expanded with the opening of InvivoGen San Diego, in 1997, and InvivoGen Hong Kong, in 2014. 

Our unparalleled skills in microbial fermentation enable us to produce a wide range of bioactive molecules, including ultra-pure antibiotics, novel mycoplasma treatments and the largest available collection of pattern recognition receptor agonists, from various micro-organisms.

Over 25% of InvivoGen’s employees hold a PhD in biology or chemistry. Through specialized R&D teams, they work together seamlessly to design, produce and validate novel plasmids, cell lines, vaccine adjuvants and synthetic ligands for research in areas as diverse as gene therapy, molecular immunology and vaccination. Moreover, based on our first-hand knowledge of innate immune receptor signaling pathways, we have devised an ever-expanding collection of reporter cell lines, including cytokine reporter cells and knockout (KO) cell lines for high-priority innate immune targets.

Scientists depend on InvivoGen for quality, consistency and reliability. Whatever research challenges you are facing, count on InvivoGen to provide you with the tools and solutions that you need.

Name: Okomera
Description: We integrate standard assays on chip (eg. CRISPR, T-cell, cytotoxicity) to accelerate drug discovery from target to validation, and advance preclinical predictivity

Name: Inserm Transfert
Description:
Inserm Transfert is the Inserm subsidiary dedicated to value creation and technology transfert in lifescience and human health. 

Inserm Transfert, the private subsidiary of the French National Institute of the Health and Medical Research (Inserm), is responsible for value creation of Inserm innovations in human health and promotes long-term technology transfers in line with international best practices. Inserm Transfert SA was founded in 2000, and manages, under a Public Service Management Contract (Délégation de Service Public), the entire promotion and transfer of knowledge emerging from the Inserm research laboratories to the industrial world, from invention disclosure to industrial partnerships and startups incorporation. 
Inserm Transfert also offers services relating to setting up and managing national, European and international projects, as well as supporting the technology transfer of clinical research and health data/databases. 
In 2009, Inserm Transfert and Inserm established an investment fund to finance proofs of concept. In 2005, Inserm Transfert Initiative, a dedicated seed money fund for life sciences, was created. Since 2017 a pathway for pre-entrepreneurship supports researchers/inventors that aspire to become involved in entrepreneurship.

Name: altona Diagnostics
Description:
WHO WE ARE 
altona Diagnostics is a medical diagnostic company that develops and manufactures in vitro diagnostic tests for the PCR based detection of pathogens such as viruses, bacteria or parasites. Headquartered in Hamburg-Altona, Germany, altona Diagnostics is privately owned and employs more than 350 people worldwide. The company has been in the molecular diagnostics business for over 25 years and is ISO 13485 certified. altona Diagnostics sells its registered products to private and clinical laboratories globally through subsidiaries and more than 40 distribution partners.

WHAT WE DO
Molecular diagnostic tests from altona Diagnostics are based on real-time PCR technology and are packaged as ready-to-use kits. The company’s product catalog contains over 50 CE marked kits that are compatible with open real-time PCR platforms. In addition, altona Diagnostics offers an automated workflow solution that is complete with instrumentation, nucleic acid extraction chemistry and a dedicated software. 

HOW WE THINK
As a privately held company we have realistic expectations that include mid to long term objectives. We are profitable but not driven by money. This means no crazy forecasts, financial gymnastics or useless reports. Our business model is simple and straightforward: good people making good products and offering good service. Come join us if you share the same philosophy!

Please find the current data privacy statement here: https://altona-diagnostics.com/en/privacy.html

Name: ENYO Pharma
Description:
ENYO Pharma is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing innovative therapeutics based on fibrolytic and anti-inflammatory properties for diseases with impaired kidney function.
The company is conducting Phase 2 trials with its lead compound Vonafexor in Chronic Kidney Diseases (CKD) and rare kidney disease such as Alport syndrome.

Name: Dominique Dutscher
Description:
Founded in 1982 by M. Dominique Dutscher, our company, based in Alsace,has from the ouset specialized in the distribution of consumables and laboratory equipment for research, biotechnologies and health.
Dominique Dutscher SAS has rapidly developed into expanding its catalog, multiplying its services, expanding distribution agreements with new manufacturers that have given it their confidence, by broadcasting new products on the market, paying particuliar attention to the quality of its service to its customers and to the respect of its commitments.

Name: Cure51
Description:
Cure 51 is a TechBio aiming at creating the first ever worldwide database of Cancer Survivors.

The company was co-created with leading oncology centres and has already identified more than 1500 survivors in 42 countries across all continents.

The company has developed its own data collection and discovery platform as well as a dedicated Central Lab to proceed to a multiomic sequencing of the survivors’ samples.

Through this approach, Cure51 will identify robust therapeutic targets, validated by its scientific community, in order to develop novel drugs to cure Cancer.

The focus for Cure51 is initially to start with 3 types of particularly agressive cancers and will naturally expand to other indications and therapeutic areas to capitalize on its exclusive and unprecedented set of data and discovery pipelines.

Name: genOway
Description:
Since 1999, genOway aims at bridging the gap between preclinical findings and clinical success with advanced, genetically engineered preclinical models and solutions. From customized mice and rats to ready-to-use cell lines, our solutions provide increased predictability and accelerate therapeutic breakthroughs.

We work with 17 of the world’s Top pharma companies—as well as leading biotech firms, CROs, and academic institutions. 

At the heart of genOway is a team of 150+ skilled professionals, from 17 nationalities, all committed to advancing preclinical research. 

What We Offer
• A catalogue of validated, ready-to-use mice and cell lines—developed in partnership with biopharma leaders
• Custom-made models tailored to specific research goals
• Proof-of-concept experiments aligned with model design and project needs

What Makes Us Unique
• Scientific Excellence: Our models have contributed to peer-reviewed publications and IND approvals. 
• Easy access to the models: High-health-status models sourced from certified breeders in the US and Europe
• Strong Collaborations: Models co-validated with pharma and biotech partners
• Full Freedom to Operate: Secure use of technologies with guaranteed FTO in the specific field

Our Commitment to Sustainability
Through the genOway Low-Carbon Project, launched in 2021, we’ve committed to reducing our greenhouse gas emissions by 6% annually over a period of 5 years, by rethinking lab operations, logistics, and energy use. We’re proud to report that this initiative has already delivered measurable results, putting us on track to meet our reduction targets.

Name: Nūmi
Description:
At Nūmi, we're on a mission to redefine infant health through groundbreaking research and innovations.
We’re working to recreate the magic of in vivo breast milk in vitro, offering parents a natural choice when breastfeeding isn’t an option.

Name: CliniSciences Group
Description:
CliniSciences commercialises reagents (antibodies, recombinants, ELISA kits, RNAi, cDNA clones, probes, PCR/qPCR reagents...) to diagnostic and research labs. As very dynamic company, we do our best to be close to our customers' needs in terms of high quality reagents that we propose and in terms of service that we provide (search for a particular antibody, technical support, delivery time, etc.)

Our principal assets for better serving you : adaptability, flexibility, reactivity and naturally the competence of the technical specialists at your service.

Name: METEX NØØVISTAGO
Description:
METEX NØØVISTAGO, formerly Ajinomoto Animal Nutrition Europe, leads the way in amino acids for animal nutrition since 1976. From local and natural raw materials we produce essential amino acids for better animal nutrition and a more sustainable world. With 40 years of knowledge and experience, we provide the whole livestock value chain with innovative solutions to each customer for sustainable animal farming.

Attentive to our customers’ needs, we propose a full range of solutions:

• NØØV-CSTM (Customized Solutions),
• And amino acids produced by fermentation processes in our facilities in Amiens, at the heart of Europe.

Since July 2024, the company has become a subsidiary of Avril and now operates under the name : EUROLYSINE
www.linkedin.com/company/eurolysine-avril

Name: Pig Improvement Company (PIC) - Europe
Description:
Welcome to the Pig Improvement Company’s (PIC) – Europe LinkedIn account. 

Here at PIC, our goal is to help our customers be the most successful pork producers in the world. You may know us for our tagline of “Never stop improving.” That’s been our story for nearly 60 years, because success in pigs starts with high quality pig genetics. 

From replacement gilts to replacement boars and boar semen, pig producers trust us for proven, productive and ROI-driven pig genetics. At PIC, we select for commercially-relevant traits that create the foundation for profitable production. 

In addition to our industry-leading pig genetics, you may know us for our experienced team of experts. We are leaders in pig genetic improvement and are trusted globally with operations in over 40 countries.
