Count on us to bring you the latest innovations to drive genetic improvement, a global bio-secure supply system to deliver world-renowned genetics, and on-farm experts to help you realize the full value of PIC genetics. 

PIC is the pig division of Genus plc, a genetics leader with the mission to pioneer animal genetic improvement to help nourish the world. Genus strives to provide beef, dairy and pork producers with superior breeding stock to enable the production of affordable and nutritious animal protein for consumers.

Name: Elveflow Microfluidics | an Elvesys brand
Description:
World leader in premium microfluidic instrumentation. Proven track record delivering systems for the best institutions worlwide.

Elvesys captures the spark of smart ideas to give life to innovative concepts that will iIlluminate the world. We stand for innovation, quality, performance, fun and a sense of competitive challenge. 

Elvesys was built on a strong entrepreneurial spirit and founded on the belief that microfluidics will change the world. This is why in the recent years, Elvesys has spawned a number of innovative companies from microfluidics innovations:

-Elveflow: Elveflow focuses on the development of high performance and Plug & Play flow control systems fitted to microfluidic research. In just a few  years, Elveflow became the world leader in high performance microfluidic flow control. - Visit http://www.elveflow.com/

-Black Hole Lab: this company has been created to enable any research lab to easily fabricate their microfluidic devices without the need of a clean room. Black Hole Lab provides turnkey soft lithography stations and microfabrication expertise. - Visit http://www.blackholelab-soft-lithography.com/

-Cherry Biotech: based on a cutting-edge microfluidic technology, Cherry Biotech offers the world's fastest temperature controller for live cell imaging, with dedicated plaforms for C. elegans, S. pombe, Drosophiplia embryos and Mamalian cells studies. - Visit http://www.cherrybiotech.com/

Find your fit.
By planting the seeds of a Microfluidic Valley, Elvesys provides a variety of rewarding opportunities across a wide range of companies, business units and career paths for students, recent graduates and experienced professionals. As an innovative company, we are seeking hungry, talented and creative folks to join us.

Name: EDELRIS
Description:
EDELRIS is a pioneering company dedicated to the design and chemical synthesis of innovative natural product-like screening Libraries, medicinal chemistry Hit-to-Lead / Lead Optimization projects, Custom Synthesis, and Affinity screening-Mass Spectrometry (AS-MS). 

Aiming at the acceleration of the lead discovery and optimization process in pharma and biotech research organizations, EDELRIS uses its recognized chemistry and screening expertise in drug discovery to provide novelty to its clients and partners.
Our unique and first-in-class NP-like, easily tractable screening libraries (Fragments, Covalent binders, conventional HTS & DEL) now contain +2M in-house synthesized compounds, with built-in hit-to-lead optimization capabilities. Our clients can review these libraries on an exclusive or non-exclusive basis.
EDELRIS has a wide range of services and provides state-of-the-art target qualification (protein and RNA), screening, and hit identification capacities by applying our in-house AS-MS (Affinity Selection – Mass Spectrometry) technologies. 
We have a comprehensive chemical analysis department to support our broad portfolio of ongoing organic and medicinal chemistry projects, as well as screening campaigns.
The EDELRIS team is capable of delivering innovative solutions to synthetic and medicinal chemistry challenges faced by our clients.
When partnering with EDELRIS, we focus our efforts on creating value for your projects.
In 2024, Edelris was integrated into the global Janvier Group Biosciences, expanding its capabilities and reach in the drug discovery field

Name: Osivax
Description: Osivax is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing a portfolio of differentiated influenza vaccines generating superior T-cell responses in addition to strong and sustained B-cell responses, thanks to its novel, self-assembling nanoparticle platform technology, oligoDOMTM. The company’s lead candidate, OVX836, is a broad-spectrum influenza A vaccine candidate currently in Phase 2b clinical trials with over 4,000 volunteers tested and encouraging efficacy proof of concept data. By combining OVX836 with standard flu vaccines, Osivax is advancing toward a best-in-class seasonal flu vaccine to prevent all strains of influenza. Osivax collaborates with leading global health agencies and top-tier pharmaceutical companies, reinforcing its mission to prevent all types of seasonal and pandemic influenza. The company will expand into other infectious disease indications through combinations and collaborations worldwide.

Name: Atlanpole Biotherapies
Description:
Atlanpole Biotherapies is a French biocluster that gives you access to extended skills, from biodiagnostic to biomedicine. 

For pharmaceutical and biotech companies or research laboratories looking for high level partners committed to healthcare and biotechnologies, Atlanpole Biotherapies is a biocluster that draws together a network of industrial and academic competences which offers comprehensive and competitive solutions along the entire biotherapeutic value chain, from discovery to patient,within 4 areas of excellence: 
• immunobiotherapies 
• radiopharmaceuticals 
• biomaterials 
• cell & gene therapies

More information : http://www.atlanpolebiotherapies.com
Location: Nantes, Pays de la Loire, France

Name: Clean Cells
Description:
Clean Cells is a GMP-licensed Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization providing R&D, production and quality control testing services to the biopharmaceutical industry.
Our two-part site located in Western France holds an innovative process development platform, BSL2 and BSL3 GMP manufacturing laboratories and analytical areas to develop bespoke assays and perform GMP testing.
Clean Cells is part of the Clean Biologics group and benefits from the additional experience of sister company Naobios, a CDMO with considerable experience in the development and manufacture of virus-based products.
Location: Boufféré, Pays de la Loire, France

Name: CTIBIOTECH
Description:
CTIBiotech, models for your research.

CTIBiotech uses advanced tissue engineering techniques (3D bioprinting, bioreactors) to develop models and bioassays needed to test the efficiency and effect of ingredients. Our models have varying levels of complexity suited our clients needs in the pharmaceutical industry and dermato-cosmetics sectors. 
We also work in partnership to co-develop new models that fit a specific requirement. 
The CTIBiotech Biobank is accredited by French authorities and we can offer human tissues, primary cells, cell lines and tumours. We currently store around 30 000 samples, from 0-94 years and from different ethnical backgrounds. 
Our customers come from all over the world, with particular emphasis for Europe and Asia.

Name: Cilcare
Description:
CILCARE is a biotech dedicated to harnessing auditory sciences to reshape the future of care via early diagnosis and targeted treatment. We believe hearing acts as a valuable indicator of our health and must be monitored and preserved accordingly. As awareness of the link between hearing and chronic health conditions grows, auditory sciences are paving the way for the early detection of chronic neurocognitive, inflammatory, and age-related diseases. 

CILCARE External Innovation supports its partners in the health and life-sciences sector in the development of new therapies to prevent and treat auditory-related diseases including inherited hearing loss, synaptopathy, ototoxicity, sensorineural hearing loss and tinnitus. 

CILCARE Therapeutics has forged a portfolio of proprietary drug candidates and co-developed programs, while pioneering an unprecedented clinical approach to developing compounds targeting cochlear synaptopathy. 

CILCARE Auditory Analytics aims to position hearing as a key asset of preventive medicine and global healthcare monitoring. 
We aim to utilize patients' auditory measurements to define digital auditory signatures that will serve to characterize different forms of hearing impairments or other pathologies with precision.

Name: M2I Life Sciences
Description:
M2I Vision :
Build in France a world-class industrial partner for custom synthesis and formulation of niche products in Healthcare (mainly generics), veterinary art, biological crop protection and organic electronics

(Re)design synthetic routes and industrial processes for « hard to make »  molecules (core capability)

Propose to our clients a one stop shop from specification to regulatory clearance (DMF, MA) by teaming up with R&D and marketing teams

The company operates a R&D center rance and a cGMP manufacturing plant.

M2I holds a portfolio of proprietary DMFs and has already successfully applied its nonconventional retrosynthetic approach of active ingredients, using continuus processing, to solve important quality and stability issues on proprietary APIs.

M2I also develops pheromones based solutions for crop protection and veterinary art.

M2I works in close partnership with its clients to develop and supply high quality molecules in a cost efficient way.

Name: Eurofins BioPharma Product Testing Europe
Description:
From Starting Materials through to Finished Product Testing, Eurofins BioPharma Product Testing’s network of over 50 facilities in more than 20 countries delivers the world’s most comprehensive scope of harmonised GMP testing services and seamless regulatory acceptance.

As we have grown to become the world’s largest network of GMP product testing labs, we continue to uphold our founding promise of personal service and impeccable quality.

When the world awaits your product, choose the lab that provides complete capabilities and rigorous quality systems you can trust.

Where we are present: Belgium, Czech republic, Denmark, France, Finland, Germany, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Slovakia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, The Netherlands and UK.

Name: APICES CRO
Description:
APICES is a full-service European Contract Research Organization specializing in clinical trials and real-world evidence research. With offices in Spain and France (formerly Kappa Santé), coverage across all major EU-5 markets and beyond, we combine scientific excellence with operational agility to accelerate high-quality clinical development.

Founded in 2009 by experienced professionals from the pharmaceutical and CRO industries, APICES provides comprehensive services across Phases 0–IV and post-authorization studies. Our 100+ experts deliver integrated solutions in regulatory affairs, project management, clinical operations, data management, biostatistics, medical writing, safety, and pharmacoepidemiology.

We have successfully conducted more than 450 clinical projects, partnering with 5,000+ investigators and enrolling over 100,000 patients. Our teams are recognized for strong expertise in oncology and hematology, as well as in cardiometabolic diseases, immunology, respiratory diseases, vaccines, rare diseases, and public health.

APICES combines the scientific rigor and reliability of large organizations with the responsiveness, flexibility, and personalized approach of a mid-sized CRO. We design efficient studies, anticipate challenges, and ensure regulatory compliance and data integrity at every step.

By integrating advanced analytics, digital tools, and real-world data, we help our partners in Pharma, Biotech, and Medtech demonstrate clinical and real-world value, improving patient outcomes and driving smarter healthcare decisions.

Name: One Biosciences
Description: One Biosciences leverages the power of single-cell analysis to unlock a new wave of targets and precision medicines for a broad range of difficult-to-treat conditions. One Biosciences is an integrated discovery engine combining a multi-disciplinary team with in-house computational capabilities. One Biosciences is backed by Institut Curie and Home Biosciences.

Name: iGEM Innovation
Description: iGEM Innovation serves emerging bioinnovators and industry leaders across the full innovation chain – from the earliest stages of ideation through to measurable impact in the bioeconomy.

Name: ANTABIO
Description:
Antabio is a privately held, clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company dedicated to developing novel and highly differentiated antibacterial treatments targeting drug-resistant infections caused by WHO and CDC critical priority pathogens. 

Guided by scientific excellence and a clear mission, Antabio’s mission is to deliver life-saving therapies that combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) and help preserve the effectiveness of antibiotics for future generations. Antabio’s lead program, MEM-ANT3310, is a next-generation β-lactam/β-lactamase inhibitor (BL/BLI) combination currently in Phase 1 clinical development. Designed to treat severe hospital infections caused by multidrug-resistant Gram-negative bacteria, MEM-ANT3310 represents a major step forward in addressing one of the most urgent public health challenges of our time.

Name: Invivoscribe
Description:
Invivoscribe is a global leader dedicated to Improving Lives with Precision Diagnostics, advancing the quality of healthcare by providing innovative products and clinical services for oncology. Our Streamlined CDx (companion diagnostic) model accelerates the development of novel therapeutics, enabling personalized approaches to patient care.
With products manufactured in our state-of-the-art cGMP facility, we provide a comprehensive range of platform agnostic assays, reagents, controls and software for clonal gene rearrangements, translocations, gene mutation testing, and measurable residual disease (MRD). Invivoscribe’s products consistently surpass industry and regulatory standards and play a crucial role in identifying, stratifying and monitoring hematologic cancers, enabling scientific advancements and empowering clinicians to make informed treatment decisions.
Our subsidiary, the Laboratory for Personalized Molecular Medicine (LabPMM), offers extensive clinical diagnostic and biopharma services for the detection and monitoring of myelo- and lymphoproliferative disorders. The LabPMM network performs globally standardized flow cytometry and molecular testing services for pharmaceutical and healthcare organizations, providing results that are critically important for patient care in the U.S., Europe, and Asia.
Join us in our mission to revolutionize oncology diagnostics and improve patient outcomes worldwide. Visit our website to discover how Invivoscribe’s ecosystem is driving advancements in precision medicine.

Name: Innovative Diagnostics
Description:
Since 2004, Innovative Diagnostics (ID) develops, produces and sells ELISA, PCR and rapid tests to diagnose infectious zoonotic and veterinary diseases. 

Over 130 employees work in our 4000 m2 headquarters at the heart of the “MED Valley” of Montpellier, France.
ID has shown continuous growth over the years and offers a wide range of veterinary tests sold in over 100 countries under the brand name IDvet. 

ID is an actor of the One Health approach, which recognizes that human and animal health are interdependent. We contribute to securing the global health and food supply, thanks to the control of zoonotic and veterinary diseases. Further to the emergence of COVID-19, we quickly developed COVID-19 ELISA tests detecting IgG, IgA and IgM in sera, and an immunochromatographic test for nasopharyngeal swabs.

“With you at every step” is our motto. To improve global supply and assistance, we have a training center in Jordan, offices in Brazil, India, China, and a production facility in the USA.

In 2016, we contributed to creating ID Solutions (www.id-solutions.fr) to provide tools to detect oncogenic mutations in human circulating DNA by dPCR.
When COVID-19 emerged, ID made its know-how, industrial infrastructures, staff and financial resources available to ID Solutions in order to develop and produce COVID-19 PCR kits for use in humans, allowing ID Solutions to become a major COVID PCR kit manufacturer in France. ID left ID Solutions presidency in December 2021 and sold all its shares in May 2022. ID Solutions is now fully independent and heading for their new own projects.

In 2021, ID contributed to the creation of DI4diag: “Deep Intelligence for diagnostics”. This company gathers talents from Montpellier University and the industry. It aims to provide easy-to-use and affordable diagnostics for syndromic infectious diseases, thanks to technologies that combine molecular technics and artificial intelligence. These testing tools will be particularly useful for LMIC.

Name: BMG LABTECH
Description:
BMG LABTECH is a leading developer and manufacturer of microplate reader instrumentation with a wide range of measurement methods. Microplate readers are used in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries, as well as in academic research establishments, for both basic research analysis and high-throughput screening. We focus solely on microplate readers and offers the most diverse selection of optical detection systems in conjunction with integrated liquid handling equipment.

Our exceptional worldwide sales and support network is committed to bringing you innovative microplate reader technology with the reliability and quality that you expect from BMG LABTECH.

The highest priority at BMG LABTECH is to have satisfied microplate reader customers! We succeed at this goal by not only offering excellent microplate readers but also providing personal customer support that not found at larger companies. Our support centers have teams of microplate reader development specialists ready to work with you and your applications to get the most out of your microplate reader. This close working relationship allows BMG LABTECH to completely understand your needs and to help develop our instruments to meet the changing needs of the microplate reader market.

Imprint: https://www.bmglabtech.com/legal-notice/
Privacy Policy: https://www.bmglabtech.com/privacy-statement-linkedin/

Name: Mnemo Therapeutics
Description: Mnemo Therapeutics is a Paris-based biotechnology company driven to create powerful immunotherapies by improving the body’s ability to detect and eradicate cancer. The paucity of actionable cancer-specific targets creates significant challenges in the field of immuno-oncology. To address this, Mnemo has developed a combination of in-silico and wet-lab pipelines to uncover new tumour-specific targets (called E-antigens) derived from the unexploited dark genome, and to develop multiple therapeutic modalities (i.e. cell therapy, TCE, ADC, vaccine) targeting these E-antigens. Mnemo is currently pursuing several discovery campaigns for E-antigens, with a plan to develop its proprietary tumour-specific targets and therapeutics portfolio together with its historic founding partners.

Name: Smart Immune
Description: Smart Immune is a clinical-stage French biotechnology company developing ProTcell, a thymus-empowered T cell progenitor platform to fully and rapidly re-arm the immune system against cancer and infection, enabling next-generation allogeneic T cell therapies. The company aims to radically improve outcomes for patients in hematology and immune-oncology. Smart Immune has ongoing collaborations with leading institutions in the US and Europe. SMART101 is in Phase I/II clinical trials in cancer patients with AML and ALL, in SCID in the EU and the US. Smart Immune is also developing therapies using gene-modified T cell progenitors through its ProTcell platform to provide targeted treatments like off-the-shelf CAR T. The Company is headquartered in Paris, France, at Paris Biotech Santé.

Name: Coave Therapeutics
Description:
Coave Therapeutics is a clinical stage biotechnology company focused on developing life changing gene therapies in rare Ocular and CNS (Central Nervous System) diseases. 
We are pushing the boundaries of gene therapy through application of our AAV-Ligand Conjugates platform (ALIGATER) that enables targeted delivery, enhanced gene transduction and tissue distribution to improve the effectiveness of advanced gene therapies for rare diseases.
Our strategy is to advance a pipeline of novel therapies targeting rare ocular and CNS diseases where targeted gene therapy has the potential to be most effective, where there is a clear unmet need and where success will provide rapid validation of our ALIGATER platform.

Name: XENOTHERA
Description: XENOTHERA is a biotechnology company based 21 rue La Nouë Bras de Fer, 44000 Nantes, France.
Location: Nantes, Pays de la Loire, France

Name: Ferments du Futur
Description:
Ferments du Futur is a public–private partnership designed to accelerate research and innovation in cultures, fermented foods, and biopreservation, thereby promoting sustainable and healthy food systems. 

Supported with €48.3 million over ten years under the France 2030 plan, this funding provides unique and interconnected capabilities that combine the best of research and innovation in the field of fermentation.

The Ferments du Futur ecosystem is built around an innovation center located at the heart of the Paris-Saclay cluster, featuring state-of-the-art screening and fermentation facilities, and a distributed technological platform spanning seven INRAE research units specializing in microbiology, process engineering, microbiomes, artificial intelligence, and modeling.

Ferments du Futur is also a vibrant community of 39 members, including startups, companies, higher education and research institutions, interprofessional organizations, technical institutes, trade unions, and competitiveness clusters.

Name: THX Pharma
Description:
THX Pharma (Theranexus) is a pharmaceutical company specializing in treatments for rare neurological diseases. Its first drug, TX01, will soon be commercialized—particularly in Europe by Exeltis, but also in the United States, Canada, and Australia—for Niemann-Pick type C disease and Gaucher disease. Its second drug, Batten-1, targets the juvenile form of Batten disease and could become the first approved therapy for this condition. THX Pharma also has an innovative antisense oligonucleotide platform, co-developed with leading research laboratories, dedicated to rare neurological diseases.
THX Pharma, a trade name of Theranexus, is listed on Euronext Growth Paris (FR0013286259 – ALTHX).

Name: BioLabs France
Description:
BioLabs are the premier co-working spaces for life science startups- unique places where you can test, develop and grow your game-changing ideas. 

As entrepreneurs and investors ourselves, we have first-hand experience with the pain-points biotech start-ups face. Our goal is to change how scientific entrepreneurs do business by building an ecosystem that empowers bioinnovators to grow quickly, while maximizing capital efficiency.

Name: Protera
Description:
By 2050, the world's population will surpass 10 billion people. To feed the current population and future generations we need to address global food challenges, today. How can we solve this problem without overwhelming the planet? And how can we deliver higher quality, more nutritious food for everyone?

With Protera’s Natural IntelligenceTM technology, we believe the future is already here. Protera’s technology uses predictive algorithms that calculate millions of amino acid combinations and simulate protein patterns in a matter of seconds. Our technology is based in Deep Learning and allows us to shine a light on a previously untapped universe of proteins.

We craft protein-based ingredients faster and more affordably than ever before, unlocking a revolution in human health, reducing damage to the environment, and preventing food waste. Our first products already exceed the performance, scalability, and functionality of existing alternative ingredients.

Please visit proterabio.com, contact us at (415)-256-7667, or email us at info@proterabio.com

Name: Phodé
Description:
Born in 1996 from a passion for science and the conviction that scents have the power to improve well-being, Phodé is an independent French group based in the south of France.
Pioneer of the link between olfaction and behaviour, we design sensory formulations and plant-based active ingredients that combine well-being, pleasure and performance — across animal nutrition, food & nutraceuticals, and the olfactory environment.
Innovation is our heartbeat. Working hand in hand with international research institutes and universities, our teams use cutting-edge tools — brain imaging, microbiology, behavioural science — to validate the efficacy of our solutions. Our work is regularly published in scientific journals.
Three sectors, one mission: Wellness ("Mieux-Être").
 Animal Care — Sensory & functional feed solutions for pigs, ruminants, poultry, fish and shrimp. We help feed manufacturers and premixers tackle palatability, stress, digestion and vitality.
 Human Care —Custom flavour creation, bad-taste masking and olfactory actives for food, sports nutrition and nutraceuticals — where efficacy meets pleasure.
 Air Care —  With Norasystem, our patented technology, we don't mask odours — we destroy them. Solutions for industry, livestock and polymers.

Name: Faircraft
Description: Faircraft develops a highly sustainable, lab-grown alternative to animal leather, based on advanced tissue engineering and material science techniques.

Name: Starlab
Description:
We believe in progress through science. Our solutions enable bright minds to change the world.

We are “Passionate for Science”. Since 1998. Our product portfolio specializes in the field of Liquid Handling Technology and laboratory products. Our product portfolio includes laboratory consumables such as pipette tips, single and multi-channel pipettes, cell culture, tubes, PCR consumables, nitrile and latex gloves, and benchtop equipment for general laboratory use.

Our products and services are in daily use at research institutions in biological and medical institutes, universities and hospitals, as well as in companies in the life sciences. We have earned an excellent reputation within the research community as a consultative company who takes a structured approach to Liquid Handling products and support. We work very closely with our customer network to continuously improve the products we offer, and to seek out new opportunities both from a product and support perspective. We have become a significant market player in all the product and service areas where we focus our efforts. Our success is due to our highly-trained and motivated staff and a portfolio of high quality products and services.

STARLAB are liquid handling experts, with many years’ experience in automated injection moulding processes for the manufacture and sale of high quality laboratory consumables for research and development. With TipOne we have developed one of the world's leading pipette tip systems. Quality, price and service are STARLAB’s core principles

STARLAB is based in Germany, the United Kingdom, France and Italy, for the direct sales of our extensive product range. In addition, regional partners in many countries allow the purchase of STARLAB products throughout the world.

Name: AlgoSolis R&D Facility
Description:
AlgoSolis is an academic platform dedicated to the development of a sustainable microalgae industry. Inaugurated in 2015, managed by the GEPEA, the University of Nantes and the CNRS, AlgoSolis is developing breakthrough technologies for the culture and biorefinery of microalgae. Thanks to a TRL (Technological Readiness Level) ranging from 4 to 7, it offers the infrastructure for investigations in the representative conditions of the final industrial application.

AlgoSolis is a research tool opens to all partners involved in microalage industry, through collaborative R&D projects or specific demands (expertise / access to equipment / biomass / bio-products / access to training...).

Leveraging over 25 years of research in bio-process and microalgae culture optimization at the GEPEA laboratory,  AlgoSolis now offers a range of technological solutions and scientific expertise to the development of a new industry, competitive and sustainable.

Visit us on http://algosolis.com/en/ and feel free to contact us for more details.
Location: Saint-Nazaire, Pays de la Loire, France

Name: EURAXI
Description:
Since 1986, Euraxi has been supporting healthcare industry clients in the design and delivery of their clinical research projects.

As an independent full-service CRO, we have managed over 1,000 clinical trials, covering the full development cycle: Phase I-IV clinical trials, non-interventional studies, early access & compassionate use programs, Home Trial Services (national nurse network), medical devices and Market Access.

Our specialised multidisciplinary teams adapt 100% to your needs, in France and across Europe.

 Contact us: www.euraxi.fr

Name: Plant Advanced Technologies PAT
Description: Founded in 2005, Plant Advanced Technologies PAT is specialized in the discovery and the eco-friendly production of hard-to-source biomolecules inspired by the plant kingdom richness. PAT targets its active molecules in the field of specialty chemicals such as cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, nutraceuticals, and plant protection in agriculture. PAT has set up an optimal organization and patented know-how that allow access to the chemical diversity of plants, a huge source of highly active molecules that remains largely unexplored. The company also offers tailor-made solutions for traceable and responsible biomolecules and active ingredients while respecting biodiversity

Name: Generare
Description:
Life has been writing for 3 billion years, 97% has never been read.
Generare unhearts, decodes, compounds what life wrote.
Our platform and team generate high-quality molecular data on unread chemistry, creating the dataset that will define a new paradigm for drug discovery.

Name: Tebubio
Description:
We facilitate Life Sciences Research every day, contributing to advance Science for a brighter future. Through our local offices located across Europe, we support Life Sciences and Biotechnology Researchers with a unique, holistic range of solutions to advance their projects faster:

- We enable researchers to be at the forefront in their Research with access to cutting-edge biological solutions sourced from reputed global Life Sciences suppliers, carefully selected by our Scientific Team for their relevance and evaluated for their ethical and legal compliance. 

- We accelerate their Research thanks to our Contract Research Services’ strong expertise in mRNA production & delivery, cell line engineering & protein production, cellular studies and biomarkers analysis when they lack time, routine practice or expertise.

- We streamline their ordering process thanks to our e-procurement solutions, enable them to benefit from our many years of supply chain experience in handling biological solutions, save significant time and avoid administrative complexity as they can rely on the permits and certifications we hold.

With Tebubio, concentrate your efforts and accelerate what’s most important to you: Your Research.

Name: 4Dcell
Description:
Experts in cell microenvironment control.

At the forefront of the new challenges in biology, 4Dcell offers more reliable innovative study models, which are closer to the natural environment of the cell. 

4Dcell technologies provide solutions for a myriad of applications. Among them, we highlight models for cancer, immune system, organs such as heart or gut, circulating cells, wound healing, neuronal network, stem cells and genetic disorders such as laminopathy.

Years of research have led 4Dcell to develop an innovative 3D cell culture technology that enables the acquisition of more physiologically relevant readouts.
We propose cell culture systems that mimic in vivo conditions and ultimately organ functioning through sophisticated control of the cell microenvironment.

Name: Cherry Biotech
Description:
Cherry Biotech is a biomedical technology (Organ on Chip) company that develops instruments for drug discovery and personalised medicine. Its mission is to replace animal testing by reconstructing human tissue (Organoids) in vitro for drug testing. 

Cherry Biotech's CUBIX platform enables pharmaceutical, biotech companies and healthcare providers to recreate immunocompetent human vascularized organ models and tumor microenvironments for better evaluation of their drug candidates. 

By enabling the reconstruction of human 3D models that mimic human physiology and pathophysiology over several weeks, Cherry Biotech's proprietary CUBIX technology is the only solution that can convert a standard 2D multi-well plate into a 3D cell culture (Organ on Well). 

This innovative patented technology allows for the implementation of the current regulatory change on the ethics of animal experimentation while remaining compatible with the current industry workflow.

Cherry Biotech is among the innovative projects selected and supported by the Paris Saclay Cancer Cluster (PSCC), whose mission is to accelerate the development of innovation in oncology.

We are sharing every two weeks the newsletter "Organoid Digest" with the recent news in the field : https://organoid.substack.com/

Name: Texcell
Description:
About Texcell

We are a specialized CRO supporting biologics, vaccines, medical devices, cell and gene therapies, and other complex biological products. Our core expertise includes viral safety, viral clearance, biosafety testing, custom cell culture, cell banking support, and bioassays.

For more than 30 years, clients have trusted Texcell for scientific rigor, responsive partnership, and practical support when programs need clarity. We design studies, solve technical questions, assess product safety, and move development programs forward with confidence.

Our services include:

Viral safety and biosafety testing for biological products, cell banks, raw materials, and cell-derived products.

Viral clearance studies for biologics, gene therapies, and other biopharmaceutical products, including investigational and regulatory-supporting study designs.

Custom cell culture and cell banking support, including cell line expansion, research cell banking, conditioned medium production, virus production, and purification.

Bioassays and analytical support, including in vitro and in vivo bioassays, immune response evaluation, qPCR-based detection, and related testing for preclinical and clinical programs.

Clients come to Texcell for the science. They stay because of the partnership.

Name: Dionymer
Description: Peut-on se passer du pétrole en s'inspirant du vivant ? Dionymer fait le pari de l'économie circulaire en développant une technologie permettant de transformer les biodéchets en matériaux polymères PHA (polyhydroxyalcanoates) biodégradables à l'aide de microorganismes. Une réponse couplée à deux besoins : Réduire le coût de gestion pour les producteurs de biodéchets (agriculteurs, collectivités, agro-alimentaire), et réduire l'impact environnemental des industriels en remplaçant des polymères issus de la pétrochimie pour leur produits (cosmétiques, packaging, textiles...).

Name: ProteoGenix
Description:
ProteoGenix is a leading life sciences organization which provides services in molecular biology and immunology and in particular polyclonal and monoclonal antibody development, recombinant protein expression and purification, peptide synthesis as well as gene synthesis. ProteoGenix’s commitment to its clients is to ensure the access to comprehensive and integrated solutions to help our customers develop the tools they need to efficiently conduct their biology and research projects in a time effective manner.

Beginning with the synthesis of the gene ProteoGenix develops all the materials required for immunoassay services. Proteogenix’s exceptional and functional expertise combined with our extensive scientific knowledge and experience ensures ProteoGenix to be a reliable partner for your antibodies, proteins, genes (cDNA) and peptides.
Our custom services ensure a unique and tailored process to our clients revolving around four areas :

    Protein expression and purification in E. Coli, Yeast, Insect cells (baculovirus) and Mammalian Cells
    Monoclonal antibody production and Polyclonal antibody production
    Gene synthesis, sub-cloning and mutagenesis
    Peptide synthesis, purification and conjugation

ProteoGenix also provides the research and academic communities with a wide range of commercial products available on our website such as antibodies, proteins, ELISA kits, tissue microarrays, chimera RNAi, molecular biology products as well as many more.

Name: Cell-Easy
Description:
Cell-Easy is a CDMO specialized in Cell Therapy.
We support biotech, pharma, and public institutions with GMP development and manufacturing.

Our mission: accelerate your Cell Therapy’s path to market, with patient access as our priority.

ATMPs are not conventional biologics — they are living drugs. Our team brings hands-on expertise in cell culture across all cell types, engineered or not, addressing challenges in development, GMP manufacturing, and QC.

Beyond core CDMO services — process diagnostics, development, GMP production, cell banking, cryostorage, and delivery — we also support sourcing of human biological materials and clinical trial setup, helping you move efficiently from concept to clinic.

We’ve supported 10 clinical trials to date, including projects with top 30 pharma, and helped clients shift from autologous to allogeneic approaches.

More at: www.cell-easy.com

Name: ALLIS-NA | Alliance Innovation Santé Nouvelle-Aquitaine
Description:
ALLIS-NA (Alliance Innovation Santé Nouvelle-Aquitaine) est le cluster régional d'innovation Santé au service de tous les acteurs de la filière. Il s'engage à catalyser les synergies au sein de son écosystème pour transformer les projets de ses adhérents en solutions concrètes, utiles et durables. 

Nos missions ? 
- ACCOMPAGNER & SOUTENIR les projets et leurs porteurs.
- FÉDÉRER & ANIMER l’écosystème et les filières.
- REPRÉSENTER & VALORISER les acteurs et leurs activités.

En connectant les expertises et en soutenant activement le développement économique territorial, ALLIS-NA s’impose comme le référent des acteurs de l’innovation en Santé en Nouvelle-Aquitaine, contribuant ainsi au rayonnement de son écosystème.

Rejoignez l'Alliance !

Name: AELIS FARMA
Description:
Founded in Bordeaux in 2013, Aelis Farma is a biopharmaceutical company that is developing a new class of drugs, the Signaling Specific inhibitors of the CB1 receptor of the endocannabinoid system (CB1-SSi). CB1-SSi have been developed by Aelis Farma based on the discovery of a natural regulatory mechanism of CB1 hyperactivity made by the team led by Dr Pier Vincenzo Piazza, the Company’s CEO, when he was the director of the Neurocentre Magendie of INSERM in Bordeaux. By mimicking this natural mechanism, CB1-SSi appear to selectively inhibit the disease-related activity of the CB1 receptor without disrupting its normal physiological activity. CB1-SSi have consequently the potential to provide new safe treatments for several brain and peripheral organ diseases.
Aelis Farma currently has two first-in-class clinical-stage drug candidates. AEF0117 for the treatment of cannabis use disorders (CUD), that has shown to be able to decrease cannabis use across two studies. AEF0217 for cognitive disorders, which has shown in a Phase 1/2 to be safe and able to improve adaptive behavior in young adults with Down syndrome (Trisomy 21) and has started a Phase 2b in Europe aiming to confirm its efficacy and safety in people with Down syndrome. The clinical results obtained with these 2 compounds have confirmed the safety and therapeutic activity of CB1-SSi in humans. The Company also develops a portfolio of new innovative CB1-SSi for the treatment of other disorders associated with a dysregulation of the activity of the CB1 receptor, including diseases involving peripheral organs, such as obesity and related metabolic conditions. The new drugs developed by the Company belong to the same general pharmacological class, the CB1-SSi, but have distinct functional effects allowing to target different types of dysregulations of the CB1 receptor and guaranteeing that the different compounds are not substitutable one with the others.

Name: Inside Therapeutics (InsideTx)
Description:
InsideTx streamlines RNA-LNP formulation from screening to manufacturing.

Founded at the intersection of microfluidics and biotechnology, we build formulation platforms that cover the full RNA-LNP & nanomedicine development pipeline  — so researchers can focus on the science, not the process.

TAMARA is our all-in-one R&D platform for nanoparticle formulation. It handles everything from early screening to preclinical in-vivo studies in a single instrument (0.2–30 mL), with zero formulation losses, reusable microfluidic chips, and two mixing geometries on one reversible chip. As one of our users put it: "I'm absolutely blown away by how user-friendly, efficient, and straightforward this system is!"

NanoPulse addresses what comes next: scale-up. Built on a proprietary mixing technology, it is the only platform that ensures identical nanoparticles at every scale — from microliters to tens of liters. Same mixing, same particle characteristics, from bench to GMP production. No re-optimization between scales saving precious time and improves chances of success.

We also offer formulation services (CRO) and hands-on RNA-LNP training, giving teams without in-house expertise a direct path into LNP development.

TAMARA and NanoPulse are compatible with mRNA-LNP, siRNA-LNP, saRNA-LNP, CRISPR, liposomes, PLGA, SLNs, polymer and peptide nanoparticles, and more.

Name: Neuroservices-Alliance
Description:
Neuroservices-Alliance: The CNS Electrophysiology CRO.

. Our mission
Neuroservices-Alliance is a Global CNS Contract Research Organization (CRO) for translational data. We are committed to providing the Pharmaceutical Industry with state-of-the-art neuro-pharmacological functional endpoints, helping them accelerate their CNS and Pain drug discovery programs.

. Our expertise
Empowered by a strong college of experts, our integrated functional data from Rodent, Dog, Cyno, and Human tissues accelerate CNS and Pain research programs thanks to fast and robust lead selection & optimization, investigation of MOA, and validation of target engagement.
Data are generated from complementary CNS platforms: in vitro & in vivo CNS electrophysiology and behavioral tests.

. Our core values
We are the alliance of Human and Science.
We value direct and efficient interactions and act as our clients’ remote laboratory: you remain in constant contact with our scientific team all along the study, while having the support of our business & operations team for all contractual and project management matters. Our study plans remain flexible to be quickly adapted to the ongoing project's needs.

Name: Ozyme
Description:
Spécialiste depuis 1984 de la fourniture de produits de laboratoire pour la Recherche, OZYME sélectionne et propose des produits provenant des plus grands noms de la Biologie Cellulaire, de l’Immunologie et de la Biologie Moléculaire.
OZYME se concentre sur ce qui fait plus que jamais sa force : l'engagement et la compétence des femmes et des hommes qui l’animent. L’équipe d’Ozyme est composée d’une quarantaine de collaborateurs passionnés dont plus de la moitié sont des scientifiques issus des 3èmes cycles universitaires ou d’école d’ingénieurs.

Name: Clarrio.ai
Description:
Clarrio.ai is building the world’s largest real-world evidence (RWE) platform for chronic diseases, turning data from 300+ connected devices, electronic health records (EHRs), and daily life into precision insights.

Our mission is to bring clarity to chronic care — predicting risks, personalizing treatments, and guiding decisions that improve quality of life for patients while reducing costs for hospitals, payers, and pharma.

 What We Do:

Aggregate Data: Connect wearables, EHRs, and behavioral inputs in one secure, HIPAA-compliant platform

Generate Insights: Correlate lifestyle, drug use, hospital admissions, and QoL improvements to drive better decisions

Enable Action: Deliver dashboards and predictive models for hospitals, pharma, and insurers to act before crises happen

 Our Vision:
We envision a world where chronic care is no longer reactive but predictive, precise, and personalized.
Clarrio.ai is building the largest global RWE dataset — connecting wearables, clinical records, and real-world behaviors — to uncover correlations that transform how hospitals, pharma, and payers deliver care.

Our goal is simple: turn data into clarity so every patient receives the right intervention, at the right time, at population scale.

Name: Vivet Therapeutics
Description: Vivet Therapeutics is dedicated to developing innovative gene therapy treatments for orphan diseases. Vivet Therapeutics is focused on optimizing gene therapy through collaborating with the Fundacion para la Investigacion Medica Aplicada (CIMA, Universidad de Navarra) to develop new AAV vectors specifically targeting the liver and generating new technologies to optimize gene delivery and long term expression.

Name: Eranova
Description: Thanks to an innovative and patented solution, our company provides an answer to these two global problems. Our technology uses green macro algae stranded on beaches, a pollutant, as a resource for the production of bio-based, recyclable, compostable resins. This is called Upcycling.

Name: PDC*line Pharma
Description: PDC*line Pharma is a clinical-stage Biotechnology company that develops a new class of potent, off-the-shelf therapeutic cancer vaccines based on a proprietary cell line of Plasmacytoid Dendritic Cells (PDC*line). Based on a robust preclinical package and a first-in-human phase Ib in melanoma, PDC*line Pharma reported promising Phase I/II results in lung cancer (PDC*lung) in 2024. Preparations are now underway for a randomized Phase II trial in lung cancer, and a Phase Ib trial in colorectal cancer with neoantigens (PDC*neo). The company has raised €61M  in equity and non-dilutive funding and signed a €108M licensing deal in Asia with the Korean pharmaceutical company, LG Chem Life Science.

Name: Primaa
Description: Primaa develops artificial intelligence-based software for automated and accurate histological and cancer diagnoses.

Name: RED Horticulture
Description: Pioneers in smart lighting solutions to boost crop performance and energy efficiency.

Name: endogene.bio
Description:
endogene.bio is building the biological data infrastructure for uterine health.

190 million women worldwide suffer from endometriosis, yet diagnosis still takes years and curative treatments remain unavailable. A fundamental challenge is the lack of high-quality human uterine biological data.

By combining menstrual blood, advanced molecular profiling, and computational modeling, endogene.bio generates high-resolution biological data at scale, unlocking a previously inaccessible layer of human biology.

Our work enables deeper understanding of disease mechanisms, patient stratification, biomarker discovery, and therapeutic development across uterine health.

We collaborate with pharmaceutical companies, hospitals, clinics, and research organizations to accelerate the next generation of diagnostics and therapeutics in women's health.

Name: LabSkin Creations
Description:
LabSkin Creations is a biotechnology company specializing in advanced 3D skin and adipose tissue engineering. 

By combining innovative cell culture techniques as well as proprietary technologies based on scaffolding biomaterials and 3D bioprinting approaches, LabSkin designs and creates unique and versatile 3D reconstructed models for the performance evaluation of skin and personal care products and their ingredients.

Name: Svar Life Science AB
Description:
For customers working in the life sciences and pharma industry, Svar offers a unique combination of scientific expertise, high-quality assay products, strong services, and proprietary technology platforms that provide a flexible, effective, and seamless experience for customers through different development needs in a way that no other single business can.

At Svar, we are dedicated to our customers' development journey. We harness a deep understanding and long-standing experience in immunological areas such as complement system activation and immunogenicity. We utilize this in our expert cell engineering, assay development, and contract research services capabilities. Our specialist knowledge allows us to help you tackle complex problems, safely and efficiently moving your candidates through the drug development phases and to the patient—also when standard solutions fall short.

Name: POXEL
Description: Poxel is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company developing innovative treatments for chronic serious diseases with metabolic pathophysiology, including non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH) and rare disorders. Poxel has clinical and earlier-stage programs from its adenosine monophosphate-activated protein kinase (AMPK) activator and deuterated TZD platforms targeting chronic and rare metabolic diseases. For the treatment of NASH, PXL065 (deuterium-stabilized R-pioglitazone) is in a streamlined Phase 2 trial (DESTINY1). PXL770, a first-in-class direct AMPK activator, has successfully completed a Phase 2a proof-of-concept trial for the treatment of NASH, which met its objectives. For the rare inherited metabolic disorder, adrenoleukodystrophy (ALD), the company intends to initiate Phase 2a proof of concept studies with PXL065 and PXL770 in patients with adrenomyeloneuropathy (AMN). TWYMEEG (Imeglimin), Poxel’s first-in-class lead product that targets mitochondrial dysfunction, has been approved and launched for the treatment of type 2 diabetes in Japan. Poxel expects to receive sales-based payments and royalties from Sumitomo Dainippon Pharma. Poxel has a strategic partnership with Sumitomo Dainippon Pharma for Imeglimin in Japan, China, South Korea, Taiwan and nine other Southeast Asian countries. The Company intends to generate further growth through strategic partnerships and pipeline development. Listed on Euronext Paris, Poxel is headquartered in Lyon, France, and has subsidiaries in Boston, MA, and Tokyo, Japan.

Name: BforCure
Description: To be more responsive, more efficient and make better decisions, BforCure allows public and industrial stakeholders to access biological information in real time, thanks to an innovative technology of rapid biodetection.

Name: BIOTECHFINANCES
Description:
PRESENTATION
La lettre hebdomadaire Biotech Finances approche sur un angle économique et financier toutes les questions liées au développement du secteur des biotechnologies et plus largement des sciences de la vie. Notre lectorat cible est composé en majeure partie d'entreprises de biotechnologies orientées sur la santé et le développement de nouvelles thérapies et de nouveaux traitement de maladies, d'entreprises pharmaceutiques (big pharma et autres laboratoires) , d'investisseurs, business angel , fonds d'investissements, capital risque, spécialisés dans le secteur des biotech, d'institutionnels, de conseils juridiques, d'experts en développement, et de fournisseurs de services et fournisseurs de matériels. Nos articles traitent de recherche et développement, de nouveaux produits, médicaments, molécules, essai clinique et préclinique avec leur différentes phases, de financements et pratiques financières, de levées de fonds, augmentation de capital, prise de participations, d'IPO (introductions en bourse) de propriété industrielle, brevets, agréements en Europe (EMEA) et aux Etats-Unis (FDA), de partenariats, co-développement, licensing (in licensing /out licensing) qui permettent l'épanouissement et la croissance des sociétés de biotech.

Name: JANVIER LABS
Description: The culture of excellence to support research and to improve tomorrow's health.
Location: Le Genest-Saint-Isle, Pays de la Loire, France

Name: Ennolys by Lesaffre
Description:
Bringing bioprocess innovations to full-scale industrial production requires agility, scientific expertise, and operational robustness. For over 30 years, Ennolys by Lesaffre has delivered all three. At Ennolys, our experts, our know-how, and our industrial assets are fully dedicated to your success, from biotech startups to global enterprises.

Our teams provide tailor-made, end-to-end fermentation and DSP services for the scale-up and production of a broad spectrum of microorganisms and their metabolites, serving a wide range of industries such as food, nutraceuticals, cosmetics, agriculture, feed, health, and more.

Working closely with you in a spirit of transparency and collaboration, we contribute to accelerate and de-risk the industrial-scale production of your ingredients.

Together, we turn your needs into industrial success stories.

Name: BIOLIE by Sensient
Description:
Founded in 2012, BIOLIE is specialized in White Biotechnology and has developed a clean solvant-free enzyme-assisted aqueous extraction technology of oils and vegetal actives. This technology is protected by an international patent and can be applied to all types of vegetals.
This concept of biorefinery leads to the valorization of all products issued from the process (oil, active ingredients, protein-rich flour, aqueous extracts, concentrates...).

BIOLIE is offering high standing oils, active ingredients and vegetal extracts for cosmetics, nutraceutics and health-food markets.

Green Chemistry, innovation, valorization of by-products, respect of the environment are the values that are heart-sealed in the team of BIOLIE.

Name: Ambiotis
Description:
Ambiotis is a pre-clinical CRO specialized in the study of inflammatory processes and the active end of inflammation, called resolution. Resolution is now recognized as the necessary biological process to stop inflammation and restore homeostasis in tissues. This recent approach makes possible to study the inflammation process in a completely innovative and differentiating way.

Ambiotis proposes services adapted to pharmaceutical, dermo-cosmetic, agro- food/nutraceutical industries to evaluate the potential of their molecules at preclinical or clinical stages of development. Ambiotis thus helps them to put faster on the market more efficient and innovative compounds on immuno-inflammatory processes.

With more than 10 years of experience, Ambiotis has acquired a solid expertise in understanding the molecular mechanisms controlling these phenomenons . Ambiotis has built a strong expertise in both cell/animal models and analytical measurement. This combination is the key to ensure a full understanding and provide proof of efficacy or proof of concept for the development of new innovative products.

Name: Inoviem Scientific
Description:
Inoviem Scientific is a private Bioanalytical company which delivers enabling information to secure drug discovery programs and to take informed decision by closing the gap between preclinical and clinical development.  We reconcile translational pharmacology and human physiology by using fresh patient material from the target cohort, embracing the complexity of human diseases.
Inoviem's enabling technologies are working in pathological conditions to get the treatment in development to the right patient.

Our indication-agnostic access to patients combined with innovative label-free platforms deliver Target identification and validation, targets & Mode of Action deconvolution, patient stratification, predictive biomarkers and companion test to unlock the potential of any program in development. 

We believe science is truly meaningful when it directly or indirectly serves living beings. Our mission is to improve patients' lives by accelerating the development of more effective, precise and safer medicines through our scientific endeavors.

Name: 3S ORTHO
Description:
Since its creation in November 1999, 3S ORTHO designs, manufactures and commercializes orthopedic medical devices. Our company is specialized in upper limb and extremities and is based in Lyon France.
3S ORTHO keeps on improving its products and creating new ones. This enables the company to ensure a technology development focused on the patient's need and comfort.
3S ORTHO distributed its implants worldwide.

EC Certification 

Conception, Development and Commercialization of Prosthesis:
Shoulder prosthesis "ARAMIS" 
Trapezio Metacarpal prosthesis "RUBIS Modulaire" 
Proximal Inter Phalangeal  prosthesis"IPP2"

Name: OmiCure
Description:
OmiCure is writing the next chapter in human health and precision medicine in the fight against Cancer, taking our industry beyond big data and leading the way to a new category of products based on AI models. In this pursuit, we are using omics data to solve the most acute problems standing in the way of payers, physicians, and patients. Through our new generation of DNA, RNA microbiota-based tools, we will ensure the right patient is being provided with the right therapy at the right time.

There are many personalized medicine companies that perform tumor profiling (such as DNA sequencing) of a patient’s tumor or blood, and generate a report that identifies tumor mutations and drugs that can be used to target individual mutations.

OmiCure takes this to the next level:
- We analyze the genetic sequencing performed on more than 22,000 genes while the other companies only analyze a panel of 70 to 500 genes.

 - Our Artificial Intelligence creates a score and ranks the top drug  (out of more than 5 million options) that are customized for the patient.

- We integrate multiple types of tumor profiling results (DNA/RNA sequencing, etc.) to get a more complete picture, when available.

- We consider all of the latest advances in cancer care, including immunotherapy, targeted therapy, and newly approved cancer drugs, in addition to standard drug therapies.

- We consider “off-label” cancer drugs in our analysis (i.e., drugs that have been approved for a different type of cancer, but that may be relevant to the patient’s specific tumor mutations based on data from prior clinical studies).

Name: ENgreen Technologies
Description: ENgreen develops Extracellular Vesicles (EVs) to more effectively deliver new solutions to targeted cells and tissues in order to protect plants and animals from diseases.

Name: INNOVHEM
Description: To adress the unmet need to dispose of relevant tools to value the efficacy of treatments for red blood cell disorders, INNOVHEM has developed two important and unique innovations :a simple and accurate method to quantify fetal hemoglobin in each red blood cell and a specific new method to measure intravascular hemolysis. Together with several generic biological assays, INNOVHEM offers a comprehensive and innovative platform that supports the development of new treatments for red blod cell pathologies, from preclinical to phase IV evaluation.

Name: AberActives SAS
Description:
AberActives est une entreprise de biotechnologie marine

Notre laboratoire est situé sur le site du Laber dans les locaux de la station marine de Roscoff, pôle d’excellence mondiale dans la recherche fondamentale sur les algues.

La start-up propose l’utilisation d’enzymes bactériennes pour transformer les sucres algaux dans la perspective de fabriquer des ingrédients en cosmétique et/ou en nutrition santé.

Name: Op2Lysis
Description: Op2Lysis develops new treatments for patients suffering from thrombosis at the cerebrovascular level, with an initial focus on the hemorrhagic form of stroke. Indeed, there is no currently approved and available therapeutic solution for these patients. The company develops its game-changing NANOp2Lysis platform, associating a breakthrough vectorisation technology, industrial know-how enabling clinical quality production, and preclinical expertise to propose predictive and translational models, a first in this field. O2L-001, the first product resulting from this technology, will soon enter regulatory toxicology with the aim of applying for clinical trial authorisation in patients in North America and Europe.

Name: PredictCan Biotechnologies
Description: PredictCan is the first individual-centric preclinical platform to reproduce human biological diversity in vitro, enabling a true population-level "trial-in-a-dish" approach to predict drug efficacy, identify toxicity, and understand interindividual variability before clinical trials begin.

Name: SYSNAV Healthcare
Description:
Sysnav Healthcare is a leading business unit of Sysnav, a fast-growing French tech company. Our mission is to deliver meaningful real-world data to improve clinical trials and accelerate medical progress.
 
Traditional clinic-based assessments capture patients only during scheduled visits in controlled settings, leaving much of their real-life function unseen. They often miss subtle changes in motor function and lack the sensitivity needed to determine whether a treatment is truly working within a short timeframe.

 Through Syde, our end-to-end digital endpoint platform, we capture precise measurements of patient mobility and motor function in real-life conditions, enabling clinical trial sponsors and researchers to make confident, regulatory-ready decisions. Our teams support clinical studies from design to data reporting.

Sysnav Healthcare developed and obtained qualification from the European Medicines Agency for SV95C, the first regulatory-qualified digital endpoint.

Our technology has been deployed across more than 100 clinical studies, covering over 20 indications, including neuromuscular diseases, neurological disorders, joint diseases, and skeletal dysplasias.

 We work with leading pharmaceutical companies, biotech companies and research institutions, supporting Phase 1 to Phase 3 trials.

 Get in touch to learn how real-world mobility data can strengthen your clinical trials.

Name: ReACT Therapeutics
Description:
ReACT Therapeutics est une biotech française qui œuvre à rétablir l’efficacité des traitements anticancéreux et à améliorer la qualité des soins dispensés aux patients. 

Créée en janvier 2023 à Grenoble, ReACT Therapeutics a pour but de développer une nouvelle classe de molécules capable de bloquer les phénomènes de multirésistance responsables des échecs thérapeutiques.

 Notre mission : Travailler pour et avec les patients afin de rétablir l’efficacité de leurs traitements anticancéreux et améliorer la qualité de leurs soins. 

 Notre but : Développer une nouvelle classe de molécules capable de bloquer les phénomènes de multirésistance en oncologie.

Fruit de 15 années de recherche à l’Université Grenoble-Alpes, notre technologie permet de cibler sélectivement une protéine clé impliquée dans l’efflux des traitements anticancéreux : la Breast Cancer Resistance Protein (BCRP).  
Notre molécule leader, ValOMé, est un inhibiteur de BCRP efficace, sélectif et non toxique. 

 En combinant l’action de ValOMé à l’action d’un anticancéreux, nous rétablissons l’efficacité de ce dernier chez les patients en échec thérapeutique.

 Envie d’en savoir plus : https://react-therapeutics.com/

Name: Coral Biome PHARMA
Description:
CORAL BIOME PHARMA
Live cultured corals for Drug discovery

Coral Biome is a research and development company dedicated to the discovery of marine natural products of interest for major public health issues such as cancer, inflammation and multi-drug resistant infectious diseases.

Our multidisciplinary team of research and worldwide network of collaborators gathers a unique set of competitive expertise including, aquaculture, marine biology, chemistry, cell biology and cancerology to successfully isolate marine natural products and test their biological activity.
We maintain a large-scale untapped reservoir of coral species to preserve endangered species, sell corals for aquarium trade (http://www.coralbiome.com/aquaculture/) and provide research and development’s needs. We already patented a promising anti-cancer drug, actually under pre-clinical trial and identified numerous new candidates.

Name: Chaire AgroMétha - Plateforme Méthanisation de l'ENSAIA
Description:
La chaire AgroMétha, créée en 2020, s'appuie sur les 5 laboratoires entourant l'#ENSAIA ainsi que le #CTBM afin d'étudier l'ensemble de la chaîne de valorisation de la méthanisation. Ses activités de recherche se déclinent en 3 axes principaux : 
- Agronomie : ITK, bouclage cycles N,P,K et C.
- Procédés : méthanisation voie sèche, méthanation et valorisation CO2 biogénique.
- Application Sanitaire : Dégradation polluants organiques et valorisation de plantes invasives.
Elle s'appuie sur la Plateforme Méthanisation de l'ENSAIA qui possède les outils nécessaires pour les essais, de l'échelle laboratoire à l'échelle 1 pour la méthanisation mais aussi aux parcelles de la Ferme Expérimentale de la Bouzule de l'ENSAIA.

La plateforme Méthanisation est un pôle R&D autour des questions de la méthanisation où se déroulent divers projets de recherches.
Un accompagnement, par prestation ou projet de recherche, est également proposé aux entreprises en questionnement autour des sujets autour de la production de biogaz.
Elle est aussi un lieu de formation utilisé dans le cadre de diverses formations, de bac +3 à bac +5.

Name: iGEM INSA-UT Toulouse
Description:
We are the iGEM Toulouse! Every year a team of motivated students is assembled among the universities of INSA Toulouse and Université Paul Sabatier, to participate in the biggest worldwide synthetic biology competition: iGEM! 


Throughout the years we have won several prizes including receiving the Grand Prize in 2021 by placing first among the undergraduate projects!

Name: BioINSouth
Description:
Harnessing the Bioeconomy for Regional Development in Europe 

In Europe, the bioeconomy sector is a significant economic driver, employing up to 16.9% of the labor force and contributing 8.6% to the GDP. With over 2,300 bio-based plants and biorefineries generating a turnover of €600 billion, the potential for creating 400,000 new green jobs by 2035, especially in rural and coastal areas, is immense. The bioeconomy presents a unique opportunity for regional development, particularly in rural and remote areas where traditional livelihoods are scarce. By leveraging widely distributed bioresources, these regions can foster economic growth and sustainability. However, this growth must be managed carefully to protect natural ecosystems and ensure sustainable practices.

 Continuous assessment of environmental impacts is crucial to minimize negative effects and maintain ecological balance.  Adoption of policies that promote environmental sustainability and adaptive governance is essential for the bioeconomy to thrive.  Addressing regional differences is vital. While some regions excel in bioeconomy, others, like Southern Europe, face challenges such as resource scarcity, climate change, and demographic trends that hinder growth.

Designed to tackle these challenges, BioINSouth aims to bridge the gap, fostering regional development through a sustainable and circular bio-based economy. By aligning with the EU Biodiversity Strategy and European Green Deal objectives, BioINSouth supports the green and fair transition needed for a resilient future.

Let's work together to unlock the full potential of the bioeconomy, driving regional development and ensuring a sustainable future for all! 

#Bioeconomy #RegionalDevelopment #Sustainability #GreenJobs #EU #BioINSouth

Name: PalmElit
Description: Leader mondial de la sélection, production et vente de semences de palmiers à huile.

Name: Lightcore Technologies
Description: Lightcore Technologies provides photonics-based multimodal imaging and analytical solutions for research, life science and clinical care. The developed technologies encompass multiphoton microscopes and flexible endoscopes for fluorescence and label free imaging such as 2-photon fluorescence, second harmonic generation (SHG) and coherent Raman processes (CARS and SRS).

Name: Cairn Biosciences
Description:
Cairn Biosciences discovers new medicines by mapping multiscale cell dynamics. Our proprietary COMPASSTM discovery platform unlocks exclusive routes to novel targets and drugs by navigating uncharted, complex and dynamic disease biology. Using COMPASS, our diverse, multidisciplinary team of experts in drug discovery, disease biology, engineering and computation is pioneering a new drug discovery paradigm that utilizes our innovative simulations of living biology to deliver better therapeutics. We are initially orienting COMPASS to the exciting challenge of discovering new drugs that overcome acquired resistance to targeted cancer therapies.

Cairn \'kern\ a stone beacon marking the direction of a trail.

Name: Ikonisys
Description:
Ikonisys is transforming diagnostic medicine by enabling early, accurate and non-invasive disease detection. Through a unique combination of technology and science, Ikonisys is dedicated to helping physicians and researchers realize the promise of rare cell detection to give patients the best chance of managing their disease.
Through  its  breakthrough  fluorescence  microscopy  platform,  Ikonisys continues to develop a stream of oncology tests for a variety of cancers. At the center of the platform  is  the  Ikoniscope20,  a  robotic,  high-throughput,  microscopy  system  that  provides  a true “walk away” automated solution. In addition  to  providing  high  quality  cell  images,  the platform analyzes the cells of interest, offering an interpretation of the analysis, to facilitate the  quick,  accurate  reporting  of  the  test  result. 
 In  addition  to  automating  traditional  FISH-based  tests, the  rare  cell detection  and  analysis  capabilities  of  the  platform,  that  facilitates  the  examination  of  large complex  samples  for  the  clinically  relevant  cells,  make  it  particularly  suitable  for  circulating tumor cell-based testing.

Name: Luxia Scientific
Description:
Luxia Scientific is a french start-up company, leading the next wave of breakthrough personalized diagnostics. The company was started by Alessandra Cervino, former research director at Enterome.

Description: our disruptive bioreactors will allow you to cultivate the most demanding cells (induced pluripotent stem cells, stem cells, lymphocytes, etc.) from small (L) to large scale (m3). Name: Adjuvatis
Description:
Adjuvatis, a French startup in biotechnology, develops innovative safe-by-design delivery systems to help laboratories and pharmaceutical companies in vaccine formulation as adjuvants and in drug delivery as vectors for oncology, dermatology, infections, etc.

Description:
Theradis Pharma, an independent service company, with Pharmaceutical Establishment license, offers its international expertise for your clinical trials.
With a vast experience in the field of clinical trials, we can offer you a professional, effective logistics management to optimise your costs and timelines. Our capabilities embrace not only the pharmaceutical and nutrition industry, but also medical device fields.

Description: VirHealth, an independent laboratory specializing in virology, offers a large panel of standardized or bespoke tests for evaluating the virucidal activities of biocides, equipment and disinfection technologies. VirHealth performs virucidal activity tests taking into account the real use conditions of the products as well as clients' specifications and expectations of regulatory bodies.

Name: Mitologics
Description:
Mitologics is an innovative biotechnology company based in Paris area (France) focusing on detection of mitochondrial injury, a key regulator of cell death. Mitologics proposes screening services to detect the toxicity and efficacy of compounds by predictive assays  (Seahorse analysis, ROS, mtDNA...) on isolated healthy or pathological mitochondrial and cellular models. Three proprietary screening platforms:
•	MiToxView: predictive toxicity assays
•	MitoPathway: efficacy assays on tumor mitochondria
•	MitoXpert: mitochondrial targeting/protection.

Name: Sirona Biochem Corp.
Description:

EDENAE Phytoconsulting, une jeune entreprise innovante, spin-off de BotaniCert.
 
EDENAE s'engage à promouvoir l'innovation dans le domaine des ingrédients actifs naturels, respectueux de l’environnement, tout en mettant l'accent sur la santé humaine, le bien-être et la beauté.

Name: AmyPore
Description: AmyPore is a biotechnology company based around the leading science of Pr. Nouara Yahi (University of Aix-Marseillle) and Pr. Jacques Fantini (University of Aix-Marseille and Institut Universitaire de France). Their expertise in molecular neurosciences has led to the discovery of AmyP53, a first-in-class patented nontoxic molecule which tackles a common mechanism of neurotoxicity shared by Alzheimer and Parkinson diseases. The company applies its pioneering computational discovery platform coupled with high performance lipid-protein and protein-protein binding technology and ultrasensitive Ca2+ amyloid pore reporting assay to identify and neutralize novel targets that control pathologic protein misfolding. Created in 2018,  AmyPore owns exclusive patent rights for the therapeutic use of AmyP53, including the development of a nasal spray for treating patients with Alzheimer or Parkinson diseases. Beyond AmyP53, AmyPore is developing a pipeline of therapeutic peptides able to prevent the formation of oligomers implicated in the development and progression of degenerative proteinopathies, including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and type 2 diabetes.

Name: QUIDDITAS
Description:

Name: MATRICELAB INNOVE
Description:
Grâce à son premier test immunologique de l’endomètre, issu de 20 ans de recherche, MatriceLab accompagne les femmes dans leurs parcours de PMA ou après plusieurs fausses couches inexpliquées, pour faciliter l’implantation embryonnaire.

Name: URBIOFIN Project

Name: HELIOSCIENCE
Description:
(With 20-year experience, our laboratory Helioscience is qualified for assessing the quality, safety and efficacy of sun protection products. 

We propose all standardized in vitro and in vivo tests to accelerate your development. Our expertise lies in the field of in vitro testing with our methods specially developed for products containing water-soluble UV filters and zinc oxide in order to obtain a good correlation between in vitro and in vivo results. Name: ImmuPharma PLC
Description: ImmuPharma PLC (LSE AIM: IMM) is a specialty biopharmaceutical company that discovers and develops peptide-based therapeutics. The Company’s portfolio includes novel peptide therapeutics for autoimmune diseases and anti-infectives. Name: Ksilink
