Description: VETOPHAGE is a french biotech company specializing in phage technology and its applications in animal health.

Name: BIKY Pharma
Description: Nous développons une nouvelle forme d'administration de principes actifs par vaporisation. Nous opérons dans la santé respiratoire autour du sevrage tabagique principalement et des maladies connexes telles que la BPCO/Asthme ainsi que la gestion de la douleur. Notre développement s'axe sur un dispositif médical par vaporisation couplé à des formulations liquides médicamenteuses.

Name: Theralan
Description:
Theralan développe des anticorps thérapeutiques de nouvelle génération pour le traitement des cancers et autres maladies.

Notre 1er candidat-médicament est développé pour l'indication des glioblastomes, un sous-type de cancer du cerveau au pronostic très sombre.

Name: BrightSens Diagnostics
Description:
The current limitations of molecular diagnostics, such as PCR, do not allow for rapid screening and personalized follow-up of cancers and viral diseases. Healthcare professionals and institutions are therefore looking for simple, rapid and cost-effective tests for screening and monitoring patients.
BrightSens Diagnostics will provide the solution to these needs by offering highly sensitive Point of Care tests. Our patented technology, with unique properties, is the result of 10 years of research supported by 2 ERC contracts with over 2M Euros.
Our ultra-bright and ultra-sensitive fluorescent NanoAntennas amplify a detection signal. They allow direct measurement of very low concentrations of RNA - disease biomarkers - without enzymes, by simple fluorescence measurement. Our Point of Care tests will revolutionize molecular diagnostics.

Name: Gentaur Genprice Group
Description:
We are located in:
USA, UK, BE, FR, GE, IT, NL, PL, BG
•  We offer 100 of different brochures for your projects.
•  You can discuss your custom projects.
•  Show us your results for technical support.
•  We will help you choose your products - You can take them to your lab the same day!
•  We have a lot of free samples available to test.
•  If you have ideas for new products we are interested in discussing distribution condition

Name: Hadamard
Description:
Hadamard bridges quantum states of light and matter with nonlinear spectroscopy to replace multi-assay blood panels with a single analytical platform. 

We deliver lab-grade quantitative results designed to scale natively across parameters.

Name: In-Cell-Art
Description:
In-Cell-Art, is a biopharmaceutical company specializing in the preclinical and pharmaceutical development of solutions (DNA/RNA based vaccines or therapeutics) treating acquired or inherited diseases using patented bioinspired synthetic delivery systems (named Nanotaxi) consisting of different chemical families (lipids, polymers). Its founder and research team, which includes a Nobel Laureate, have developed this unique intellectual property expertise and know-how based on 20 years of research in the field of supramolecular nucleic acids transfection agents.
The vaccines and therapeutics developed by In-Cell-Art have been validated by numerous studies using infectious disease models (HIV, Flu, Dengue, dust mite, mycobacterium abscessus), therapeutic cancer models (melanoma, liver, breast and cervical cancers) and therapeutic models (muscular dystrophy, anemia in kidney failure)
In-Cell-Art has recently advanced vaccines into regulatory preclinical studies for human trials and shown promising safety and immunogenicity profiles.
In-Cell-Art’s people have international qualifications, experience and expertise in the fields of supramolecular chemistry, physico-chemical characterization and preclinical pharmaceutical development. It includes a highly experienced Scientific Advisory Board of recognized experts comprising Jean Marie Lehn (Nobel Laureate), Bruno Pitard, CSO of In-Cell-Art, Didier Roux, VP R&D of Saint Gobain, Luc Aujame former Senior Director in External R&D at Sanofi Pasteur and Georges-Bernard  Guillou, MD, former director of Pharmaceutical R&D and Scientific Affairs & Licensing at Laboratoires Expanscience.
In-Cell-Art is based in Nantes (France) and member of Atlanpole Biotherapies cluster of biotechnology companies focusing in the development of biotherapeutics.
Location: Nantes, Pays de la Loire, France

Name: Hifas da Terra France
Description: Nous sommes la première société de biotechnologie en Europe à développer des produits à base de champignons pour la santé humaine.

Name: ABCELY
Description: Abcely's mission is to revolutionize the treatment of mucosal cancers, endometriosis, and inflammatory bowel diseases by pioneering innovative medical and pharmaceutical technologies. With a focus on providing new hope for patients facing therapeutic dead ends, Abcely introduces a groundbreaking concept in immunotherapy. At the heart of this innovation is the use of a novel class of orally active therapeutic molecules: class A immunoglobulins (sIgA). Abcely is committed to advancing these treatments through every stage of development—from identifying active compounds to proving their efficacy in human clinical trials—ensuring a transformative impact on patient care.
Location: Nantes, Pays de la Loire, France

Name: Neomerys
Description:
Néomerys est un laboratoire de recherche appliquée qui développe de nouvelles biotechnologies à base de microalgues pour diverses applications :

Ecologiques (biocarburants écopositifs), 
Pharmacologiques (outils d’aide au diagnostic et nouveaux principes actifs pour l’oncologie et les maladies neurodégénératives) 
et d’autres technologies environnementales (reforestation, dessalement de l’eau de mer etc...).
 

Fondée en 2014, l’entreprise est le fruit d’une préoccupation de longue date pour les enjeux écologiques.

 Néomerys est la traduction de notre volonté de proposer une solution industrielle et concrète au plus grand enjeu de notre temps :
Le Défi Climat-Energie

Name: Accinov
Description:
A BIOMANUFACTURING CENTER FOR BIOTECH, MEDTECH & BIOPHARMA COMPANIES

Accinov is a biomanufacturing center and provides biotech, pharma and medtech companies with state of the art R&D laboratories (BSL2), cleanrooms (ISO 8-7), GMP manufacturing pilot units & tailored solutions for quality assurance & pharmaceutical support to boost their projects, keep internally their know-how and their IP & manage their facilities in the most flexible way.

Accinov’s customers have just to plug their projects & play in a full ISO/GMP compliant environment.

Accinov has the pharmaceutical establishment status since September 2014 and hosts more than 15 companies and projects, including experimental new drugs production projects.

Accinov is part of the infrastructures of Lyonbiopôle, the biocluster of the Rhône-Alpes region and is located in Lyon in the heart of the Lyon Gerland Biodistrict.

http://www.lyonbiopole.com/

http://www.onlylyon.com/

Name: Emerge France
Description:
Emerge est une organisation étudiante qui a pour but d’accompagner gratuitement les jeunes entrepreneurs dans le domaine des Biotech et Medtech à l’aide de formations fournies par des experts, afin de valoriser des nouvelles solutions scientifiques en santé ! Il existe aujourd'hui un intérêt croissant chez les étudiants en sciences, commerce et ingénierie pour la création d’entreprise dans le monde de la santé.
Emerge s'insère dans la complémentarité de l’écosystème existant, en amont des acteurs actuels comme les incubateurs, afin d’apporter une formation sur mesure, basée sur un projet concret de start-up.
Emerge se lance en France grâce à Novaxia et l'Hôtel-Dieu dans le but de devenir le principal pré-incubateur au niveau national dans le domaine de start-ups en biotech et medtech.
Notre mission : Encadrer, former et accompagner les jeunes entrepreneurs en leur donnant les outils personnalisés pour devenir des leaders de demain.
Nos partenaires : BPI France, iPEPS-ICM, la French Healthcare Association, SATT Paris Saclay, la French American Foundation et beaucoup d'autres...

Name: AFFICHEM
Description:
Affichem est une société de chimie médicinale qui développe des molécules innovantes à visée thérapeutique contre le Cancer et la Perte auditive, ainsi que des principes actifs innovants dans le domaine de la dermo-cosmétique.

Affichem is a medicinal chemistry company which develops innovative therapeutic molecules against Cancer and Hearing Loss, as well as innovative active ingredients in the field of dermo-cosmetics.

Name: PRINTUP INSTITUTE
Description:
PRINTUP INSTITUTE est spécialisé dans la formulation d’encres spécifiques et dans les process d’impression. Le développement de l’institut est focalisé sur les applications santé. C’est un nouveau modèle technologique qui a pour objectif de développer une chaîne de valeur ELECTRONIQUE IMPRIMEE POUR LA SANTE, de la conception biomoléculaire à la fourniture de dispositifs médicaux destinés aux professionnels de la santé.
 
Au sein de PRINTUP INSTITUTE :
. La recherche et le développement biomoléculaires et la conception de capteurs imprimés sont assurés au laboratoire ITODYS de 110 personnes de l’Université Paris Cité reconnu dans ce secteur de la bioélectronique.
. Une plateforme technologique PRINTEC avec mise à disposition de personnels, enseignants chercheurs pluridisciplinaires (chimie, physique, biotechnologies) et d’équipements notamment en formulation micro et nano-moléculaire, impression et caractérisation et démonstrateurs petite échelle. Cette plateforme est ouverte à tout type de collaboration ou de prestation de service, aux académiques comme aux entreprises.
. L ‘animation de l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur : workshops Recherche – Industriels – Professionnels Santé, fourniture d’une veille marché internationale et d’une veille scientifique, stands sur les salons professionnels.
. Un organisme de formation continue sur l’électronique imprimée : les formulations existantes et la conception de formulations biomoléculaires, les différents substrats utilisables sur ce secteur, les méthodes d’impression d’électronique selon le dispositif attendu.
. Le développement de dispositifs médicaux avec la réalisation de démonstrateurs grande échelle chez les industriels de la filière électronique imprimée.
. La production de masse de dispositifs médicaux, de capteurs connectés.
 
L’institut a pour rôle de dynamiser cette chaîne de valeur afin d’accélérer la fourniture des produits attendus par les professionnels de santé notamment sur la région parisienne.

Name: KaLy-Cell
Description:
KaLy-Cell is a specialized Contract Research Organization (CRO) committed to being a true partner in the field of hepatotoxicity and endocrine disruptor research using New Approach Methodologies (NAMs). We support both private industry and academia in optimizing the discovery, development, and regulatory approval of drugs, food additives, agrochemicals, and nutraceuticals.
Our services include a wide range of in vitro contract studies for drug candidate safety evaluation, with a strong focus on hepatocyte and thyroid testing across all species. In addition to our research services, KaLy-Cell offers an extensive selection of high-quality products for drug metabolism and safety assessment.
Guided by values of adaptability, collaboration, and a tailored approach, KaLy-Cell is recognized as a leader in hepatocyte and thyroid testing, helping clients advance innovative, non-animal testing strategies in toxicology.

Name: Nuclear receptors, metabolic and cardiovascular diseases (Pr Bart Staels)
Description:
Welcome to the Linkedin page of UMR1011, headed by Prof. Bart Staels. UMR1011 studies the biological mechanisms controlling the development and progression of type 2 diabetes, metabolic dysfunction-associated liver disease (MASLD) and their cardiovascular complications, with the aim of developing preventive and therapeutic strategies. 
UMR1011 is supervised by the University of Lille, INSERM, the Lille University Hospital and the Pasteur Institute of Lille.

Name: DLAB SCIENTIFIC EUROPE
Description:
DLAB Scientific Europe is the European branch of DLAB Scientific Co. Ltd. Our group is based in Beijing (China). We produce bench top equipments and liquid handling solutions for laboratories.

We have around 120 products in our catalogue, covering 4 core businesses : liquid handling, mixing and stirring, centrifugation and Thermo Control.

We constantly search the best balance price/quality. We follow our motto "your accessible solution" and hardly work every day to be defend our philosophy.

Name: JC Discovery
Description:
JC Discovery is a science-driven partner offering a unique combination of know-how from its founding company CIPHE (Center of ImmunoPHEnomics), located in France. With a unique platform and BSL3 laboratory, JC Discovery helps pharma and biotech companies validate their drug candidates with efficient and innovative solutions, early. 
With decades of experience leading successful translational projects of new mouse model creation and humanization together with high content immunoprofiling, JC Discovery offers strategic custom services to elucidate the mechanisms of action and interactions; identify, validate and prioritize new therapeutic targets in the field of immuno-oncology, inflammatory, autoimmune and infectious diseases. Using a multiomics state-of-the-art technology platform, JC Discovery has also developed innovative approaches of primary T cells editing aiming to optimize drug candidates at an early stage of development with 3Rs in vitro and in vivo dedicated services.

Name: DareWin Evolution
Description:
Blue biotechnologies are booming: the rapidly growing market contributes to a sustainable economy. For this purpose, the development of microalgae is an essential and promising sector. It is therefore crucial to select the most high-performing microorganisms. DareWin Evolution offers, through a new and innovative approach to Darwinian dynamic selection, to boost the productivity of microalgae for the production of molecules of interest.

In partnership with the National Institue for Research in Digital Science and Technology (INRIA), the National Center for Scientific Research (CNRS), and Sorbonne University, we have been optimizing our selection methods for over 10 years and obtained very promising results. Through our proof of concept, we have shown that is it possible to achieve a twofold increase in pigment content and a threefold increase in Omega-3 (DHA) content with several different microalgae - autotrophic as well as heterotrophic.

Our ambition is to be to the microalgae what seed growers are to modern agriculture. Through natural strain selection, DareWin Evolution aims to be the key that helps unlock the full potential of microalgae.

Name: INVIVOLIM
Description:
Invivolim est le réseau des entreprises des sciences de la vie et des biotechnologie du Limousin. 

Ce réseau regroupe des entreprises, chercheurs et collectivités intervenant dans le domaine des sciences de la vie et des biotechnologies sur le territoire Limousin. 
Invivolim intervient pour accompagner les entreprises du territoire dans leur volonté d’innover, mobiliser et promouvoir les compétences des chercheurs et des industriels pour proposer des solutions originales, innovantes, et favoriser le développement économique des entreprises et l’attractivité du territoire Limousin et de la Nouvelle-Aquitaine. 

Les biotechnologies représentent un domaine d’activité assez large : nos entreprises s’occupent de santé, de génétique, de biotechnologies animales et végétales, de cosmétique, de chimie verte ou encore d’environnement. L’université est également présente, des centres de transfert ainsi que certaines collectivités ou structures institutionnelles (technopole, agence de valorisation universitaire, incubateur...), participent à ce cluster.

Name: Alzohis
Description: In vitro diagnostic medical device

Name: Ecrins Therapeutics
Description:
Ecrins Therapeutics is a biotechnology company which focuses on the discovery and development of novel anti-cancer compounds from the preclinical phase to phase II clinical proof of concept.

In addition to the drug discovery, Ecrins Therapeutics provides a range of products and services for the benefit of our customers in biotechnology companies, universities, public research institutions and in the pharmaceutical industry. The mission of the commercial division of Ecrins Therapeutics is to help medical chemists and drug hunters to discover, characterize and advance their lead compounds through the drug development process. Visit http://ecrins-therapeutics-services.com/ for more information.

Our research and production teams have extensive experience in drug discovery, medicinal chemistry, cell biology and experimental oncology.

Name: aKen Medical
Description: aKen Medical is a biotechnology company that encapsulates highly potent radioactive materials within stable nanoparticles serving as "guided missiles" that deliver targeted radiation straight to tumors while protecting healthy tissue. Our universal nanoparticle platform is designed to address a wide range of cancers, enabling real-time monitoring and advancing a theranostic approach that paves the way for precision medicine.

Name: ER Ocean Recherche
Description:
Introducing ER Ocean Recherche – The result of Eugène Riconneaus’ latest journey. No longer content of transforming ocean into art, he dived into biotech, and landed on next-gen materials ready to disrupt the industry. Born as an artist with a mission, evolved into a scientist surrounded by stills, and is ready to unveil his latest creations: fibers, alternative leather, and more.

The launch of ER Ocean Recherche follows a long period of research in biotechnology and material science. Growing up in La Rochelle, a vein of concern for the health of the ocean was always part of Eugène. He started to experiment with seaweed and seafood waste from Nouvelle Aquitaine to craft his artworks and creations, giving new life to these elements. Now, a further step: high-performance materials, suited for several applications.

Eugène Riconneaus’ work explores biofabrication, biomimicry and nanostructured marine materials, and extends beyond traditional technical development.

ER Ocean Recherche shows how challenging conventional creation methods goes beyond art and fashion, and leads to a more sustainable future, shaped by cutting-edge materials that heals, rather than harm, the planet and its oceans.

Once again, Eugène Riconneaus is demonstrating how art, science and culture can be successfully unified: aligning beauty and performance with nature’s well-being is crucial to achieve a better tomorrow.

Name: FloBiotech
Description: FloBiotech is an early stage biotech company using advanced human brain cell models to develop disease-modifying therapeutic and diagnostic candidates to cure Alzheimer’s disease (AD). Our proprietary cell models (FloCellsTM) will accelerate the search for and creation of effective treatments to transform Alzheimer's drug discovery and development (and other Tauopathies). The powerhouse team brought together at FloBiotech has the expertise, the vision, and the revolutionary technology to deliver transformative results and save the lives of the people we love.

Name: iPSirius
Description:
iPSirius SAS, [pronounced ip-Sirius], is a French headquartered immuno-oncology firm, seeking to obtain a clinical trial authorization from the U.K.’s Medicines and Healthcare Regulatory Products Agency, to enable it to move its novel therapeutic cancer vaccine into a first-in-human trial in patients with non-small-cell lung cancer.

iPSirius: Illuminating the Path to Cancer Immunity

Name: HealthPhase - Microalgae & Health
Description: Initié début 2022 au sein du laboratoire GEPEA-UMR CNRS 6144 avec le soutien de la Région des Pays de la Loire, le projet HealthPhase vise à développer, à travers un démonstrateur, des procédés dédiés aux microalgues qui permettront à terme de répondre aux exigences industrielles de production pour un usage en santé humaine. L’ensemble de la chaîne d’exploitation est concerné, de la culture de microalgues en photobioréacteurs à l’extraction-purification de principes actifs.
Location: Saint-Nazaire, Pays de la Loire, France

Name: IFSBM
Description:
VOUS SOUHAITEZ DÉCOUVRIR OU INTÉGRER LE MONDE DE LA SANTÉ EN DEVENANT BIO-INGÉNIEUR ? 
L’IFSBM propose un double parcours au sein du Campus Paris-Saclay, comprenant - stages d’immersion en milieu hospitalier - laboratoires de recherche – formation théorique d’excellence

Name: Kiji Therapeutics
Description: Kiji Therapeutic, Incorporated in France and Spain in 2023, develops transformative off-the-shelf engineered cell therapies for life-threatening diseases. Kiji-TX has a platform to gene engineer iPSC derived MSC cells for a targeted and optimized therapeutic benefit. The first asset is engineered with IL10/CXCR4 and targets several autoimmune diseases.

Name: SciLicium
Description: We provide Bioinformatics as a Service, combining robust pipelines, scientific expertise, and accessible tools to help R&D teams turn genomic data into actionable insights — with applications in cosmetic science, dermatology, and biomedical research.

Name: Planktovie
Description:
Planktovie’s vision is to develop planktonic nutritional solutions meeting the highest standards for the maintenance of your aquatic animal models, and helping to fulfill the 3Rs (Reduce, Refine, Replace the use of animals for scientific purposes) concept (http://www.nc3rs.org.uk/).

Aquatic animal models are gaining in importance as alternatives to more conventional models such as rodents. The use of zebrafish is rapidly expanding in both basic and applied research in areas such as clinical research, pharmacology, and drug discovery. 

The husbandry requirements of zebrafish, and especially their nutritional needs, have a massive impact on both the number of fish required per experiment and their welfare. If experimental animals are not in good health, experiments cannot produce good data!

Name: Innov Biotech
Description: Innov Biotech commercialise des tests de dépistages innovants pour la détection des maladies non transmissibles (MNT), créé des campagnes de dépistages en entreprises et auprès du grand public et développe des solutions de téléconsultations. C’est une entreprise en plein essor qui collabore avec des centres de recherche et des Biotechs françaises.

Name: Karla Therapeutics
Description:
Karla Therapeutics SAS is a biotech company developing precision therapeutics to alleviate mental health.
Our unique immunological (T cell-) centric approach (i) relies on proof-of-concept data / abundant literature pointing out the role of the immune system in various neuropsychiatric diseases, (ii) supports a precision medicine strategy and (iii) opens to therapeutic applications across various mental disorders as well as autoimmune diseases with psychiatric symptoms.
We aim to pioneer immuno-psychiatry to develop better medicines for the treatment of mental disorders.

Name: ENEAPHARM
Description:
Eneapharm est une société biopharmaceutique, ayant pour vocation le développement de médicaments dédiés aux traitements des pathologies du pancréas notamment l’insuffisance pancréatique exocrine. 

Eneapharm développe un nouveau mode de formulation qui apporte une solution au manque d’efficacité des formes thérapeutiques existantes et permet la restauration de la fonction d’assimilation digestive.

Name: BrainVectis
Description: BrainVectis' aim is to develop gene therapy treatments for neurodegenerative diseases by targeting the cholesterol pathway in the brain. Based on work carried out by Nathalie Cartier-Lacave and her team at the UMR1169 unit (INSERM/CEA) and by her collaborators (INSERM/UMR-S 1130, UMR 8246-CNRS), BrainVectis is hosted at MIRCen (CEA, Fontenay aux Roses).

Name: Anova-Plus
Description:
Anova-Plus est une entreprise innovante labellisée GENOPOLE, créée en 2012.
Nous améliorons la santé des plantes pour un meilleur bien-être animal et humain et développons des outils de diagnostic précoce  pour mieux connaitre les ennemis des cultures et ainsi mieux les combattre. 
L’innovation en faveur d’une agriculture durable, responsable et respectueuse de l’environnement est un point fondamental dans les démarches et les projets de notre société.

Nos kits Flashdiag et MULTIgene permettent une caractérisation précise des pathogènes et d’aventices afin d’optimiser les itinéraires techniques des productions agricoles.

Name: Latoxan
Description:
Laboratory specializing in venom production, venom peptides and plant molecules.

LATOXAN produces and sells Natural active Ingredients aimed at Pharmaceutics, Animal Health, Cosmetics, Food and Feed Supplements and Life Science Research.

Venoms and venom peptides are sourced from our own venomous animals breeding facilities. Plant extracts and small molecules come from an exclusive partnership with a foreign academic Institution specialized in Plant Biochemistry and Pharmacology.

Collaboration with several Research Organizations have enabled LATOXAN to expand its catalog to unique molecules and screening libraries. LATOXAN is also involved in Drug Discovery Research projects on antimicrobials, pain-killing, haematology, cancerology, dermatology. Opportunities exist for investing as equity holders in these promising ventures. Information can be supplied to potential investors under confidentiality agreement.

As early as 1982 LATOXAN pioneered in the production of venoms within its facilities based in France and progressively developped a unique know-how for sourcing, farming, breeding and milking over 300 species of snakes, scorpions and batrachians from all over the world.
Animals come from breeding or capture missions and are kept several years active and productive.

For each production batch LATOXAN is able to provide upon demand certificate of analysis and traceability, certificate of origin, health veterinary certificate and a Venom Production Master File (for pharmaceutical industry).

Our venom peptides and plant molecules have a purity ≥95%.

Name: GLYcoDiag
Description: GLYcoDiag is a French research company (SME) specialized in glycosciences and microbiote services and product. Our business area covers the domains of human and animal health (biomarkers, therapeutic recombinant glycoproteins, vaccines), cosmetics (active ingredients, design and mechanisms of “glyco-actives”) and environment (biofilms, waste water).

Name: IRSD Institut de Recherche en Santé Digestive
Description:
Plusieurs équipes de recherche en France sont très actives et visibles dans des domaines spécifiques de la physiopathologie de l'appareil digestif : les maladies inflammatoires de l'intestin, la maladie coeliaque, les troubles de la motilité intestinale, ou de l'absorption du fer et ces pathologies hépatiques associés par exemple. Ces expertises se sont structurées et regroupées au sein d'une structure de recherche unique.
En effet, unifier des expertises sur la fonction de la barrière intestinale, le microbiote, l'immunologie des muqueuses, la neurogastroentérologie et le métabolisme du fer offre une occasion unique d'aborder les pathologies digestives et métaboliques.
Cette structuration existe maintenant sur Toulouse au sein de l'INSTITUT de RECHERCHE en SANTE DIGESTIVE (IRSD) créé en Janvier 2016 et  dont les membres partagent une vision commune de la promotion de la santé digestive.

Name: Biochemistry and Biophysics (B&B) Facility of IPNP
Description: The B&B core facility specializes in producing proteins (both native and recombinant) and nucleic acids (including DNA vectors and mRNA), reconstituting proteins into membranes, and characterizing molecular interactions (specifically protein-protein and protein-lipid). Its equipment is available for booking. B&B also provides support in the design and follow-up of your scientific projects.

Name: AFYIA Diagnostics
Description:
Important announcement: Molecular Diagnostic Kits for MPOX
go to our website for more information 

OUR MISSION : Make reliable and sensitive tools accessible to all.
Overcoming the main barriers to access to diagnosis : price, shipping and adaptation to constraints.

OUR APPROACH : Combines artificial intelligence, molecular biology and a demanding industrial process, to produce kits that are easy to use and highly reliable.

Name: Plasticentropy
Description:
** Plasticentropy has ceased operations permanently **

At Plasticentropy we discovered that enzymes produced by the wax worm are the responsible for plastic degradation.

These enzymes work fast, at room temperature and produce oxidation and depolymerization of polyethylene.

This discovery lays the based for biotechnological and industrial implementation in view of solving the plastic waste environmental threat, one of the challenges of 21st century.

Name: CUTISS Innovation
Description:
CUTISS Innovation, a wholly owned subsidiary of CUTISS AG, supports and extends the company’s R&D activities. It focusses on the development of innovative breakthroughs and products in skin pigmentation restoration, wound healing, and ageing. The company works in close collaboration with dermatology stakeholders, clinics, and specialists. 

CUTISS Innovation won the Innovation Award 2022, a jury-led competition organized by Team Côte d’Azur.

Name: ADNucleis
Description:
ADNucleis is a biotechnology company specialized in the conception, production and marketing of rapid diagnostic kits, for quantitative and qualitative analyses, for the food industry (food hygiene and species identification) and with regards to animal health, genotyping and human health. 
ADNucleis is certified ISO 13485.

Main areas of expertise and technologies mastered by the company:

Nutrient Stocks
Nucleic Acid Extraction and Extraction Kits, robotized or manually
Primer design, gene amplification and reel time PCR amplification kits.
Gene sequencing
Robotics : Setup PCR, extraction-purification, mastermix reconstitution...
Main targets for identification:

Bacteria
Viruses
Allergens
GMO
Antibiotic resistance genes
Microsatellites
Species identifiers
Hygiene standards

ADNucleis est une entreprise de biotechnologies spécialisée dans la conception, la fabrication et la commercialisation de kits de diagnostic rapide par PCR temps réel destinés au marché agroalimentaire, à la santé animale, au typage génétique et à la santé humaine. 
               identification et quantification des bactéries, levures, virus, parasites, gènes d’antibiorésistance et résistance aux antiviraux  
               Robotisation de l’analyse  permettant de réduire le temps personnel à moins d’une mn par échantillon. 
               diagnostic en 1 à 3h à partir de l’échantillon primaire
              un laboratoire de diagnostic pour le compte de cliniques vétérinaires et des entreprises agroalimentaires. 

ADNucléis est certifiée ISO 13485.

Name: Oncosema
Description:
OncosemaTM is a purpose-driven company. Our mission is to dramatically improve the management of cancer patients by providing simple and non-invasive tools, to assist oncologists in making the best informed decisions for each patient. 
OncosemaTM is a deeptech start-up. We operate an exclusive technology targeting cancer-specific biomarkers, allowing the quantification and the isolation of Circulating Tumor Cells (CTC) from most types of cancer. 
OncosemaTM is focused on providing impactful tests for Oncology. Non-invasive Sensitive and specific Easy-to-use 
OncosemaTM is a registred trade mark of Oncocellex.

Name: Lipofabrik
Description:
Lipofabrik produces and markets biological and biodegradable molecules produced through bioprocesses based on renewable resources.

LIPOFABRIK presently produces 6 different types of lipopeptides: Fengycin, Plipastatin, Iturin, Lichenysin, Mycosubtilin, Surfactin.

Name: Laboratoire Méditerranéen de Microbiologie
Description:
Notre laboratoire à échelle humaine nous permet de contrôler l'entière traçabilité de nos prestations en assurant à nos clients une personnalisation de leur projet. 
Le LMM accompagne les équipes de R&D spécialisées en chimie, en pharmaceutique et en cosmétique dans leurs projets de mise sur le marché de leurs produits grâce à notre savoir faire en microbiologie. 

Nous proposons de nombreuses normes européennes pour vérifier l'efficacité des désinfectants ou des produits cosmétiques. 

Notre champs de compétences en microbiologie couvre de nombreux types de microorganismes : bactéries, champignons, virus,...

Nous assurons une fiabilité des résultats et un gage de qualité technique en respectant les exigences de la norme ISO 17025. Ainsi nous créons un lien de confiance durable avec nos clients.

Name: CarboZym
Description:
Update September 2025 : we had to close the company due to the lack of cash.

At CarboZym, we aimed at revolutionizing the fight against climate change by transforming CO2 from a problem into a solution. Our groundbreaking technology was designed to convert carbon emissions into valuable chemical compounds, paving the way for a circular carbon economy.

Through international, multidisciplinary, and inter-sectorial training in experimental and computational biology, EpiSeedLink will not only contribute to excellence in research but also timely address societal and agricultural needs. This original research program combines the unique know-how of academic experts with that of two seed companies to synergize research and knowledge transfer between a plant model (Arabidopsis) and a crop of enormous agroeconomic importance (oilseed rape). 
EpiSeedLink will exploit the epigenetic regulation of seed priming mechanisms to improve crop performance under threats caused by climate change (drought, heat, high light) through non-GMO practices. 
As a summary the Main Research Objectives are: 
•	to provide a “gene-to-field” applicability of new markers to produce or select varieties with an enhanced capacity for stress tolerance that, in the long term, will serve as a framework for knowledge transfer to other Brassica crops, to which various leafy vegetables, cauliflower/broccoli, mustard, and turnip belong.
 Oilseed rape is ideally suited to undertake the EpiSeedLink research program. On one hand, oilseed rape is Europe’s most important oils crop (for cereal and biofuel production) and is closely related to the model plant Arabidopsis. On the other hand, it is affected by environmental threats during the critical phases of germination and field emergence, such that the drought in 2018/19 caused up to 44% losses in the EU. The expertise of the BioAtlantis and DSV companies will beneficite as to achieve our objective.
•	 Provide excellent know-how, and improve research and complementary skills of 11 early-stage scientists

Description:

CALIXAR, is a biotech company specialized in the functional and native isolation of complex membrane therapeutic targets and antigens.
We develop and implement chemistry and biochemistry tools to isolate in solution - with the highest purity levels - full-length membrane proteins, while keeping their structural and functional integrity. Our approach represents the opportunity for pharmaceutical companies to start and work with high quality targets or antigens before developing antibodies, formulating vaccines and/or discovering a primary lead through Structure Based Drug Design or High Throughput Screening assays.
As membrane proteins represent more than 60% of pharmaceutical drug targets, to keep their native conformation during the extraction from membrane cells and solubilization is crucial.
Our technological platform preserves the original structure of membrane proteins  such as GPCRs, Ion channels, Transporters, Viral targets,  etc.) or others native receptors acting as drug targets or antigens. As a result, this most accurate targeting helps biotechs, academic teams, pharmaceutical industries to develop highly potential drugs, bio drugs and vaccines and consequently saves significant time and money in further clinical stages.
By using original chemistry and specific approaches designed on demand, we develop new tools and protocols for the identification, expression, extraction, purification and crystallization of these membrane proteins/antigens from cells or from endogenous materials (virus, bacteria, primary cells, organs, etc.).
For SBDD/FBDD approaches, we carry out crystallization tests and structure determination of these native targets starting from their full-length and functional version without any point mutations or deletions.
CALIXAR sets up specific R&D programs with its customers using classical and flexible business model: Fee for service, Risk sharing, Exclusivity option and Licensing out.

Name: Pherecydes Pharma
Description:
Pherecydes Pharma develops antibacterial treatments based on the use of bacteriophage viruses, or phages, to fight bacterial infections in humans, particularly those resistant to antibiotics. Phages are natural predators of bacteria and have no demonstrated effect on eukaryotic cells, including human cells.
Antimicrobial resistant bacteria or AMR are responsible for over 700,000 death a year in 2014 according to the WHO. This number might reach over 10,000,000 by 2050 if nothing is done, and no new class of antibiotics has been discovered in the last 30 years.
Phages represent one of the most promising approach to fight these AMR infections.
Pherecydes Pharma has introduced the concept of precision phagotherapy, which consists in treating each patient according to the activity of the phages on the bacterial strain responsible for the infection. Treatments are therefore individualized and adapted to each case.
Pherecydes Pharma has selected as priority bacterial targets Staphylococcus aureus, Pseudomonas aeruguinosa and Escherichia coli, that have been identified by the WHO among the most dangerous infections. These three bacteria alone account for the vast majority of nosocomial infections in industrialized countries, and as much as over 2/3rd of hospital resistant infections in France according to a recent study.
Some of the patented phages developed by Pherecydes Pharma have already been administered as part of compassionate treatments in France under the supervision of French Health authorities (ANSM).

Name: Discngine
Description:
Discngine is a leading developer and provider of scientific software for Life Science Research organizations. Founded in 2004 and based in Paris, Discngine is dedicated to enhancing the discovery of new molecules.

 Its in-house developed SaaS applications and tailored IT solutions support R&D divisions across the pharmaceutical, cosmetics, and agro-sciences industries worldwide.

Discngine’s expertise spans cheminformatics, structural bioinformatics, lab informatics, and data science. Coupled with in-depth knowledge of molecular modeling and simulation, as well as experimental data acquisition and management, Discngine delivers cloud-based applications that comply with ISO-27001 information security management standards.

Discngine has over 75 employees worldwide and recently shifted to a distributed model. Thanks to its strong company culture and innovative management, Discngine offers a friendly and exciting working environment to everyone who wants to join the company!

Name: ALCEDIAG
Description:
Biomarker-based diagnostics for Mental Health

ALCEDIAG is a personalized medicine company specializing in the development of biological signatures aimed to serve as the basis of diagnostics tools, with a primary focus on mental health.
These biomarkers are based on the analysis of RNA editing, an epigenetic mechanism altering the nature and conformation of RNA. RNA editing may lead to the production of altered forms of proteins or modify the regulation of gene expression. RNA editing can be modified in the case of certain diseases, or as a consequence of a medical treatment.
ALCEDIAG blood biomarkers already have been proven to be related to mental health conditions such as depression and suicidal tendencies.

ALCEDIAG develops EDITDIAG, a blood test to diagnose mental disorders. EDITDIAG has already been clinically tested on hundreds of patients and for several pathologies including depression, suicidal tendencies and bipolar disorders, showing outstanding sensitivity and specificity.

With its expertise and experience, ALCEDIAG has also developed a platform to discover new biomarkers based on RNA editing. The company uses this platform for the needs of its own tests and research and collaborates with other entities to discover biomarkers for other pathologies. 

ALCEDIAG commercializes EDITOX, a predictive test to assess neuropsychiatric adverse side effects. EDITOX assesses the risk of drugs inducing severe psychiatric side effects, 

ALCEDIAG is a subsidiary of ALCEN, an industrial group active in the domains of Medical & Healthcare, Defense & Security, Aeronautics & Space, Energy and large Scientific Instrumentation.

Name: Biospace Lab
Description:
Molecular Imaging in Real Time
Biospace Lab - originally Biospace Mesures - was founded in 1989 by Nobel Prize winner Georges Charpak to provide fellow researchers in biology with innovative imaging tools based on his discoveries in high-energy physics and particle detection. 
Since then, Biospace Lab has pursued and created strong links with medical, pharmaceutical and scientific communities to bring relevant and creative solutions to biomedical imaging needs. Today, Biospace Lab range of instruments, developed with patented technologies, is dedicated to high-performance imaging for pre-clinical research in drug discovery and biology. Biospace Lab instruments and software are used by almost every major pharmaceutical company and many prestigious academic centres worldwide.

Description:
Expert in immunotechnology, BIOTEM is a contract Research Organisation which complies with ISO 9001:2008 quality standards.

Description:
Viral Vector Services from Vector Engineering and Manufacturing to Cell and Gene Therapy Development

Revvity Gene Delivery (formerly SIRION Biotech) supports your cell and gene therapy development process  ̶  offering solutions for early R&D all the way to clinical applications, with easy transfer of processes and assays into GMP production.

Whether you need small scale viral production or full scale viral vector optimization and manufacture, our expert team has you covered.

Name: Genomic Vision
Description:
GENOMIC VISION develops novel diagnostic and drug discovery solutions based on its world-leading nanotechnology for DNA analysis in the areas of cancer and acute diseases. These diagnostic tests and drug discovery tools operate where genome dynamics and human disease intersect. GENOMIC VISION uses a powerful technique, Molecular Combing Technology, for the direct visualization of single DNA molecules to detect quantitative and qualitative changes in the genome landscape and establish their contribution to pathology.	

GENOMIC VISION initial focus is towards early cancer detection and drug therapy monitoring. The company possesses an unrivalled capability for discovering genomic biomarkers implicated in the predisposition and development of many forms of cancer and in following and analyzing DNA replication during cell division. This provides a unique approach for evaluating the efficacy of new drugs on the cell cycle.

Name: IntegraGen
Description: IntegraGen is an OncoDNA group company specializing in the genomics of cancer and rare genetic diseases. Backed by highly competent and qualified teams, IntegraGen is a leading player in DNA sequencing services and genomic data interpretation software. The company runs one of the largest NGS labs in France and operates for research institutes of excellence. As part of OncoDNA group, IntegraGen leverages the power of next generation sequencing with the mission of delivering the promise of precision medicine to patients. IntegraGen has about 50 employees and generated €9 million of revenue in 2020. Based in France, IntegraGen is also present in the United States and is part of the OncoDNA group which works with an international network of 35 distributors. The Group also provides biomarker testing and clinical interpretation tools to guide treatment and monitoring of late stage solid tumors and accelerate the development of new cancer drugs. IntegraGen is listed on Euronext Growth in Paris (ISIN: FR0010908723 - Mnemo: ALINT - Eligible PEA-PME).

Name: Microfluidics Innovation Center
Description: The Microfluidics Innovation Center is a French SME born in 2011 as a part of the Elvesys group. Relying on our well-known expertise in flow control, we develop numerous engineering setups & instruments for high-impact applications. Our mission is to accelerate European research projects and to create startups to boost the impact of European scientific achievements. Since its inception, the MIC has been involved in more than 50 European grants, and we have created ten startups in the domain of microfluidics, mainly in the biomedical field.  In 2023, we decided to become independent ourselves to exploit our innovative and entrepreneurial potential fully.

Name: European Synthetic Biology Society (EUSynBioS)
Description:
The European Synthetic Biology Society (EUSynBioS) connects and strengthens the European synthetic biology community.  Our mission is to unite researchers, industry professionals, and policymakers to promote collaboration and drive innovation in this rapidly evolving field. Whether you’re a student, early-career researcher, or seasoned expert, we offer opportunities for everyone to contribute and engage. 

Through our events and online resources, we aim to build a professional network that fosters collaboration, career development, and knowledge sharing across Europe. 

We also work closely with national associations to ensure synthetic biology is well-represented at the European level.  Additionally, we support the creation of new associations in underrepresented regions, fostering a more inclusive and diverse community capable of tackling both scientific and societal challenges. 

As part of our outreach efforts, we actively share insights and developments in synthetic biology with a broader audience through events, social media, and digital platforms.  Curious about the European synthetic biology landscape? Explore our interactive map showcasing labs and companies across Europe: https://www.eusynbios.org/synbiomap 

Looking to join us? Check out our open positions here: https://www.eusynbios.org/open-positions

Name: Statice
Description:
Prestataire de services en microtechniques et en biomatériaux, STATICE réalise des produits innovants sur mesure et peut accompagner ses clients de la phase d’étude jusqu’ à la phase de production. STATICE est une référence pour la conception, le développement et la production d’implants, d’instruments et d’équipements de laboratoires. Les dispositifs médicaux conçus avec STATICE sont utilisés dans tous les domaines exigeant des technologies de pointe comme le cardiovasculaire, la neurologie, l’urologie, l’orthopédie, l’oncologie, l’ophtalmologie, les procédures invasives minimales, etc.

Fort d’une équipe de 30 docteurs, ingénieurs et techniciens en bureau d’études et d’un atelier mécanique, STATICE mène à bien une cinquantaine de projets industriels par an. Parallèlement, son label SRC (Société privée de recherche sous contrat) attribué par l’organisme BPIFRANCE/OSEO lui permet de s’impliquer dans des travaux de recherche sur le moyen et long terme. L’entreprise est régulièrement partenaire industriel dans des projets de recherche français et européens nous permettant d’être toujours à la pointe des technologies de demain. STATICE est ainsi reconnu en Europe pour sa capacité d’innovation.
L’équipe de production de 70 personnes travaille en environnement contrôlé, en ISO7 et ISO5. Le passage d’un projet du bureau d’études en production est assuré par une équipe de 4 personnes qui développe l’outillage adapté, et vérifie la capabilité du process par des préséries (DMR et VMP).
La production est pilotée par un ERP qui permet l’identification des matières, composants et sous-ensembles. La gestion de la traçabilité est garantie par code à barres.
Aujourd’hui les deux activités sont indissociables et s’enrichissent mutuellement sur le plan technologique. 

At Statice, we bring your idea to life! Specialized in mechatronics and biomaterials, STATICE develops and manufactures customized  implants, bioresorbables, catheters and specific machines.

Name: Axoltis Pharma
Description:
Axoltis Pharma is developing NX210c, a groundbreaking treatment for Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS, also known as maladie de Charcot in French), the most frequent of the rare diseases and one of the most devastating. ALS progressively destroys motor neurons, leading to muscle weakness, paralysis, and ultimately death, with very limited treatment options today.

NX210c is the first targeted - and most advanced - treatment addressing this high unmet medical need. This peptide restores the blood-brain barrier (BBB), a key factor in ALS, Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, and other neurodegenerative diseases. With 7 patents and orphan drug designation in the USA and EU for ALS, NX210c has shown an excellent tolerability profile and is currently being evaluated in a Phase 2 clinical trial on 80 patients, with topline results expected in April 2026. 

Axoltis, nominated for the prestigious Prix Galien, is a pioneer in BBB restoration and is accelerating the development of NX210c, bringing new hope to millions of patients facing neurodegenerative diseases.

Name: NEURO-SYS
Description:
Neuro-Sys is a research-intensive and innovative organisation specialising in pharmacology and in advanced in vitro and in vivo models of neurodegenerative diseases, mode of action research, and drug development in the CNS and PNS fields.
 
We provide pharmacological profiles of lead compounds and explore their underlying mechanism of action and studies to determine the neuroprotective activity. 
 
We’re dedicated to providing high-level technical expertise in a collaborative relationship with our clients and accompany you along the drug development stages, from preclinical to clinical. 

Our expertise:

 › Alzheimer’s disease (AD)
 › Parkinson’s disease (PD) 
› Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS or Lou Gehrig’s disease)
 › Multiple Sclerosis (MS)
 › Peripheral Neuropathies

DRUG DEVELOPMENT SERVICES

Name: Lys Therapeutics
Description:
Lys Therapeutics is a biotechnology company developing first-in-class monoclonal antibodies to treat patients suffering from neurodegenerative and neurovascular diseases with high unmet medical needs. Its lead candidate, LYS241, is a vascular-targeting immunotherapy with a unique mode of action counteracting neuroinflammation & BBB disruption by blocking the pathological interaction between tPA and NMDA receptors. This mechanism is central to the pathogenesis of several major neurological disorders, including Parkinson’s disease, multiple system atrophy, ischemic stroke, and other neuro-inflammatory conditions.

With operations in Lyon and Caen (France), and strategic collaborations with international research institutions, Lys Therapeutics is advancing a robust and versatile pipeline, supported by prestigious funding partners including The Michael J. Fox Foundation, Bpifrance, and private investors.

Lys Therapeutics' approach of targeting neuroinflammation to combat neurodegeneration represents a promising avenue in the search for effective treatments for these debilitating disorders.

More information on lystherapeutics.com

Name: SMEY
Description:

Produced without farmland, using minimal water, and with zero deforestation impact, SMEY’s cultivated oils empower global brands to meet clean-label and EUDR requirements while building transparent, future-proof supply chains.

Name: TransCure bioServices
Description:
TransCure bioServices, a Taconic Biosciences company

Rethinking preclinical research with your goals in mind.

TransCure bioServices accelerates drug development by delivering the right humanized models, the right data, and the right partnership mindset.

As part of Taconic Biosciences, a global leader in genetically engineered and humanized mouse models, we offer a fully integrated translational research platform, combining world-class models with advanced in vivo preclinical services.

Our humanized mouse platforms generate robust, translatable in vivo data to support critical decision-making in:
- Oncology (Human CDX, Human PDX, Syngeneic Models)
- Inflammatory diseases (IBD, MASH, GvHD, Lung Inflammation)
- Infectious diseases & toxicity (HIV, HBV, Immunotoxicity, Hepatotoxicity)

Every study is co-designed with your team to align with your scientific strategy, timelines, and regulatory requirements - keeping you in control, while we manage the complexity.

Name: Fluicell
Description: Fluicell is transforming how we treat disease with one-of-a-kind tissue solutions for regenerative medicine and drug screening. Our transplantable tissues have the potential to help patients living with uncurable tissue damage related to cardiac, pulmonary, metabolic, kidney and other diseases. Nexocyte-generated tissues also enable our world-leading partners to advance their drug-screening capabilities for the development of game-changing medicines.

Name: Stem Genomics
Description: Stem Genomics provides dedicated services to assess the genetic integrity of human stem cells. We help research scientists with specific assays and recommended workflows for the cell type they work with. Our flagship testing solution, iCS-digitalTM PSC, has revolutionized in-process genomic stability testing in hPSCs thanks to its high precision, ease and speed. It is particularly interesting for regularly monitoring stem cell lines in culture as well as for screening large numbers of clones, e.g., CRISPR-edited clones or human iPSC clones after reprogramming.
