Name: SMALTIS
Description:
Smaltis — More than a laboratory, your partner for innovating & mastering microbiology.

We are a private laboratory specializing in microbiology, delivering advanced and tailor-made solutions to support your research projects and ensure the performance of your microbiological products and processes, whether they relate to health, agri-environmental sectors, or industry.

With our two complementary divisions —  Research Microbiology and  Precision Microbiology — we cover every stage of your projects, from design to application, delivering controlled, traceable, and actionable data.

Our expertise spans the fields of antimicrobials, microbiota, genetic engineering, and genomics.

This unique, comprehensive approach guarantees you technical support and scientific advice that is always accurate and trustworthy.

More than just a service provider, we are a reliable and committed partner you can count on — with full transparency and mutual trust.

Our team is here for you!
 contact@smaltis.com
 www.smaltis.com

Name: bYoRNA
Description: ByoRNA uses eucaryotic cells as natural biofactories to make high-quality messenger RNA (mRNAs). Our bioproduction technology will help mass produce mRNA and enhance productivity at a fraction of the current cost. By perfecting an overlooked mRNA production method, we are helping build a more sustainable planet, save cancer patients and give their grand-children a future.

Name: THERAVECTYS
Description:
Based in Paris and in the USA, TheraVectys is an immunotherapy company spun off from the Institut Pasteur created in 2005 by Dr. Pierre Charneau.

TheraVectys is pioneering the application of novel lentiviral vector technology to address most of unmet and critical medical needs.

By creating the only Joint-Laboratory between a private company and the Institut Pasteur in Paris, TheraVectys develops an extensive pipeline of vaccine candidates to drive the widespread treatment and prevention of cancer and infectious diseases.

Leveraging our proprietary technology platform, and the extensive virology expertise of the Institut Pasteur, TheraVectys provides a robust and highly effective transfection mechanism to elicit a potent and targeted immune response previously unseen.

Name: Womed
Description:
Womed is pioneering innovative, safe and effective treatments to free women from challenging uterine pathologies: infertility, uterine bleeding, endometriosis.

Join the Womed Movement to support medical innovation in women's health and participate in transofmring uterine health. 

Check out our equity crowdfunding campaign at https://www.womedtech.com/campaign

Name: CELLforCURE by Seqens
Description:
CELLforCURE by SEQENS, based near Paris, is a leader in the manufacturing of Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products (ATMPs), specialized in both autologous and allogeneic cell and gene therapy solutions. With over a decade of expertise, we provide comprehensive end-to-end services, from Phase I to full-scale commercial production.
 
Our cutting-edge “one-stop-shop” facility spans 10,000 sqm, including 2,200 sqm of GMP-certified production areas and 7 independent manufacturing lines, each equipped with 8 cleanrooms, ensuring maximum safety and compliance for every product.
 
As a trusted comprehensive solution provider, we facilitate seamless project development, leveraging in-house Quality Control for 90% of processes to deliver drug products.
 
With a unique blend of CDMO heritage and proven commercial manufacturing expertise, CELLforCURE is the ideal partner to help bring your innovative therapies to life, transforming groundbreaking ideas into commercial success.

Name: SYNTHELIS
Description: A French biotech company located in Grenoble, at the heart of the French Alps, Synthelis is the leading French expert in Cell-Free systems. Our proprietary cell-free expression technology has established itself as a benchmark across Europe and is now on a path to compete with US leaders in the field. The need to produce every possible type of protein quickly, reliably and economically is a real challenge in research fields today, and it will become increasingly important to industry in the decades to come. Cell-free expression is a field of expertise that is growing constantly. However, the future offers so much more. And Synthelis is both proud of the role it is playing in this industrial revolution and committed to developing its research to bring this fruit to bear in what will be the advent of synthetic biology.

Name: BGene Genetics
Description:
BGene supports companies in developing innovative biotechnological processes for the production of natural, bio-based, low-carbon, and industrially scalable ingredients.

We step in where conventional approaches reach their limits: R&D bottlenecks, technological breakthroughs, and the transition to sustainable ingredients. Our clients, medium and large companies in the flavors, fragrances, and food industries, trust us to co-develop tailored, rigorous, and immediately implementable solutions.

Our approach is based on three pillars:

- Multidisciplinary scientific excellence: molecular biology, biochemistry, bioinformatics, process engineering
- Committed co-development, with risk-sharing from the outset
- Environmental responsibility integrated from the design phase, not added at the end

BGene is a mission-driven company. Every process we develop must outperform its conventional equivalent. This is our standard, not our sales pitch.

Name: ANIMINE
Description: Animine is a global supplier of value-added sources of trace elements for animal nutrition.

Name: AB Biotek
Description:
AB Biotek is a leading global technology-driven business specialising in yeast and fermentation solutions for the food, nutrition, health, alcohol beverage, and bio-ethanol industries. We have a long history of pioneering expertise in advanced micro-organism fermentation, actively developing both proprietary technology and strategically partnering with external institutions to create value-added products. Having a deep understanding of fermentation processes and technology applications within the industries we serve, AB Biotek has a long heritage of being a trusted partner to customers.

As a global business we have commercial, research, development and applications teams in multiple locations. In addition, as AB Biotek is a business division of AB Mauri and part of Associated British Foods (ABF) we benefit from wider access to the resources and infrastructure of a multi-billion global network of technology businesses.

For more information, please visit www.abbiotek.com.

Name: PEACCEL
Description:
WHY: Making the world disease free.

HOW: We find the real drug lead candidate by capturing the synergistic effect of mutations (epistasis).

WHAT: We have developed the Data-Centric innov’SAR AI industrial platform for our partners.

PEACCEL is definitely the ONLY company capable of fully capturing epistasis and predicting outside-the-box, we are ahead of competition especially in terms of "hit rate".
We can solve the "1+1=10" challenge!

The innov'SAR core approach is interpolative, extrapolative and predicts outside-of-the-box, not found in other state-of-the-art ML / DL.
It can screen 1 billion mutants per day.

PEACCEL can produce massive amounts of Synthetic data to train its ML/DL platform.
Other companies have taken the shortcut of relying on existing datasets which are often messy and of low quality.

PEACCEL is built around the 6 pillars - P6 -: 
PLATFORM, PUBLICATIONS, PATENTS, PARTNERSHIPS, PRODUCTS and PEOPLE

	We have developed the innov'SAR PLATFORM, including 4 modules :
1- innov’SAR core: For the optimization of polypeptides (peptides, proteins, enzymes, antibodies, VHHs)
2- RAS module: For evaluating combination of Drugs (FDCs) in various diseases
3- automlSAR: this tool tests in parallel >135 algorithms, is agnostic with respect to the data set and can be combined with innov’SAR core & RAS module
4- GraphMut: Graph-based visualization tool of relations between the mutations of protein sequence variants and activity variations
                   
	15 PUBLICATIONS in the last 2 years

	Strong worldwide PATENTS (on technology using FFT), with more to come

	Robust PARTNERSHIPS with top notch KOLs worldwide

	Focus on high value PRODUCTS

	Highly skilled PEOPLE in high-tech fields.

Name: The Twinkle Factory
Description:
The Twinkle Factory offers exclusive twinkling reagents for life science research: flurogenic ligands for FAST and split FAST, protein fluorescent reporters, and fluorogenic molecular glues for CATCHFIRE, a self reporting protein dimerizer.  Protein-protein interactions, high content analysis, anaerobe metabolic engineering, are our users keywords.
The Twinkle Factory is dedicated to speed-up the dissemination of breakthrough fluorescent technologies across the life sciences community.

Name: Aryballe
Description: Aryballe combines biochemistry, advanced optics and machine learning to mimic the human sense of smell. Aryballe’s unique software and data solutions provide odor display and analysis that helps leaders in the automotive, food & beverage, consumer appliance and flavor & fragrance industries make smarter and more informed business decisions. In addition, Aryballe's digital olfaction solutions help companies improve user experiences with applications in the automotive and consumer appliance markets. The company is headquartered in France and with commercial operations in the USA and Korea.

Name: ORIA Bioscience
Description:
Oria Bioscience is a pioneering French TechBio company expert in generating organelles. 
 
We deliver high-quality, intact living organelles, surrounded by their therapeutic membrane targets. For the first time, organelles are being distributed globally and are fully compatible with high-throughput screening campaigns and drug development efforts.
 
Thanks to our microfluidics technology, we supply pharmaceutical laboratories and CROs with purified organelles (lysosomes, mitochondria, and endoplasmic reticulum). Working directly with organelles improves efficacy results, reduces attrition rates in clinical phases, accelerates Hit-to-Lead and Lead Optimization phases, and minimizes your carbon footprint by reducing resources used. 
 
Oria’s team brings together over 50 years of expertise in organelles and microfluidics, dedicated to delivering organelles worldwide to meet drug discovery needs.
 
We are making organelles as accessible as cells, driving innovation across all health sectors.

Name: Cyllene Therapeutics
Description: Cyllene Therapeutics is the global leader in non-replicating HSV-1 (nrHSV-1) vector technology in neurology. Cyllene Tx is currently executing a Phase 1/2 study in the US with its lead DNA medicine candidate, EG110A, in patients with neurogenic detrusor overactivity (neurogenic bladder)-related incontinence. This is the first human study with nrHSV vectors targeting sensory neuron-based diseases. EG110A is being developed to address multiple severe bladder diseases, including overactive bladder (OAB), and has the potential to be a major improvement over existing therapies, resulting in better care for patients and lower costs for healthcare systems. The company’s unique HERMES platform delivers pinpoint neurotherapeutics to treat prevalent diseases of the peripheral and central nervous system. Its vectors can achieve focal transduction and then selective expression of transgenes in targeted subsets of neurons. With demonstrated clinical safety and possible repeat dosing, the large payload capacity of nrHSV-1 vectors allows for versatile DNA delivery and smarter DNA medicine.

Name: ExAdEx-Innov
Description:
Unique R&D platform of donor-derived real human adipose tissue ex vivo models for pharmaceutical drug development (obesity, chronic metabolic diseases), dermo-cosmetic, nutraceutical, aesthetic and reconstructive surgery research.

ExAdEx-Innov owns exclusive worldwide rights to ExAdEx patented breakthrough technology to develop preclinical models derived from human adipose tissue obtained from patients. These models maintain their native 3D structure, stem cells, functionality, and vascularization over the long term in culture, providing a faithful representation of clinical conditions. They enable the pharmaceutical industry to generate reliable human data in the laboratory, significantly reducing clinical failure rates and allowing for treatments better tailored to target patient profiles. More ethical, faster, and clinically relevant than animal testing, these models de-risk the evaluation of the efficacy and safety of treatments targeting obesity, metabolic diseases, and dermatological conditions.

ExAdEx Technology has been develop in French academic laboratories of excellence (Côte d’Azur University, Institut de Biologie Valrose, CNRS, INSERM, University Hospital of Nice) and is supported by SATT Sud-Est, IdEX Université Côte d'Azur, CNRS Innovation, Provence Côte d'Azur Business Incubator, Métropôle Nice Côte d’Azur and Eurobiomed Healthtech Accelerator.

ExAdEx-Innov is member of Eurobiomed and Cosmetic Valley clusters and of Les DeepTech community by BpiFrance.

Name: Vect-Horus
Description:
VECT-HORUS, Breaking barriers

Vect-Horus designs and develops vectors that facilitate targeting and delivery of therapeutic or imaging agents to organs, including the brain and tumours. Vect-Horus combines these different agents to its vectors that specifically target various receptors, allowing these agents to cross natural barriers (first and foremost the blood-brain-barrier) which limit access of therapeutic or imaging agents to their targets. The proof of concept of the technology has already been established in animal models using different vectorized molecules. 

Vect-Horus endorces a mixed business model, based on its proprietary VECTrans technology, both to make its technology platform available to pharmaceutical and biotechnology company partners and to develop an internal pipeline of products.

Created in 2005, Vect-Horus is a spin-off of the Institute for Neurophysiopathology (INP, UMR7051, CNRS and Aix Marseille University), headed by Dr Michel Khrestchatisky, co-founder. 

Based in Marseille, France, the company has 35 employees, mostly in R&D, and develops academic collaborations with the CNRS, INSERM and CEA as well as industrial partnerships.

Name: Phenocell (Axol Bioscience Ltd.)
Description:
Axol Bioscience is a leading provider of human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) technologies, specializing in the manufacture of high-performance iPSC-derived cells and the delivery of industry-leading laboratory services. With over a decade of expertise, Axol partners with global pharmaceutical companies, contract research organizations (CROs), biotechnology firms, start-ups, and academic institutions to advance the use of iPSC-based models in drug discovery and disease research.

We operate across five key areas, neuroscience (including ALS, Alzheimer’s, Huntington’s, Parkinson’s, neuroinflammation), pain & sensation, ophthalmology (Dry-AMD, ophthal-inflammation), dermatology, and cardiovascular.

Axol offers scalable solutions including iPSC banking, reprogramming, gene editing, cell manufacturing, and quality control. The company is committed to closing the translational gap, developing physiologically relevant in vitro systems that improve consistency and relevance in human disease modeling and compound testing.

Axol is recognized for its scientific excellence, transparent collaboration, and rigorous quality standards, with manufacturing operations certified to ISO 9001:2015.

Name: baCta
Description:
AI-powered bioproduction of industrial ingredients.

We're hiring! See all openings on our job board: https://bacta.notion.site/job-board

With the help of our genome-to-factory model and autonomous biofoundry, we develop and manufacture industrial ingredients.

Name: Orius
Description:
Orius offers botanical ingredients boosted in active compounds for the cosmetics and health industries. Our cutting-edge environmental control technologies are designed around the physiological needs of target plants, ensuring a reliable supply of plant-based raw materials.

Our mission is to make the best out of nature's potential. Not only can we replicate a plant’s ideal biome to grow it locally, but we can also create new biological conditions to optimize its chemical composition and unlock its full potential. This unique approach enables us to create exclusive, optimized, standardized ingredients, grown without pesticides, and available year-round.

Our ambition is to use our technology to empower biological science and the understanding of plant physiological mechanisms, and drive the creation of today’s and tomorrow’s high-value ingredients.

Name: PEP-Therapy
Description:
PEP-Therapy is a Paris-based biotechnology company developing next-generation therapies using our intracellular drug delivery shuttle.

Our technology platform enables us to address the previously undruggable intracellular space with multiple payloads such as peptides, proteins, antibodies, and nucleic acids.

As a demonstrator, PEP-010, our first drug candidate developed in oncology, is a pro-apoptotic peptide which has shown anti-tumoral activity and a good safety profile. PEP-010 is currently evaluated in a Phase Ia/b clinical trial in patients with recurrent and/or metastatic solid tumors. The trial is conducted in partnership with two leading European cancer centers, Institut Curie and Gustave Roussy.

PEP-Therapy was founded in 2014 and builds on research results from Institut Curie and Sorbonne University. The company is backed by international investors.

Name: Kimialys
Description:
We are a team of chemists and biosensor engineers gathered around a common mission: shaping the future of biodetection for a better world.

Kimialys is the result of 10 years of meticulous academic research in surface chemistry. Controlling what is happening on the surface is a fundamental aspect of biosensing techniques such as rapid tests, point-of-care diagnostics, and real-time sensors. Without the right surface interactions, even the most advanced biosensors can falter, leading to misleading results. Our research efforts have always been to optimize these crucial parameters, ensuring both precision and reliable biodetection.

Founded in 2020, Kimialys is leading the charge in harnessing surface chemistry to revolutionize diagnostics and drug development, all supported by our patented K-One technology. Building on this foundation, our coated gold nanoparticles elevate rapid diagnostic tests in terms of sensitivity, specificity and reproducibility. Additionally, our expertise in sensor chip functionalisation combined with our expertise in Surface Plasmon Resonance analysis empowers us to detect, screen, and select the most suitable biologics for both diagnostic and therapeutic applications.

Reliability, robustness, and adaptability are not just benefits of our technology; they are the cornerstones of the relationships we build.
For every customer we collaborate with, thousands of patients stand to benefit from our work.

Name: FIRALIS S.A.
Description:
Within Basel neighbourhood and at the very heart of Europe (the triple border of France, Germany and Switzerland), Firalis is a pioneering biotechnology company, active in discovery, development and qualification of biomarkers (BM).

1) BIOMARKER PRODUCTS
Firalis develops BM-based diagnostic, prognostic and theranostic tools:
● RUO Kits (Research-Use-Only), based on validated innovative biomarkers
● IVD Tools (In Vitro Diagnostic), based on a combination of clinically qualified biomarkers

2) BIOMARKER R&D
● Development of proprietary BMs 
   - Cardiovascular, Inflammatory, Autoimmune and Neurology
● Drug Safety & Drug Efficacy
● Patient Stratification
● Personalized Medicine

3) BIOMARKER-RELATED CRO SERVICES
BM Discovery for laboratories, biotechs and pharmaceutical industry:
- Proteomics: Soluble biomarker measurements with several immunoassays technologies (ELISA, multiplex and high sensitivity platforms such as Luminex BioPlex 200TM, Meso Scale Discovery, Singulex Erenna, Protein Simple EllaTM, Olink and Siemens Dimension EXLTM 200)
- Genomics/Transcriptomics: Targeted sequencing of miRNA and mRNA (HTG EdgeSeq), lncRNA screening via Firalis proprietary platform, Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) services (RNA-Seq, whole genome and exome sequencing, etc.) and qPCR/microfluidic qPCR (Gene Expression, SNP, CNV, etc.)
- Flow Cytometry: Immunophenotyping of preclinical and clinical samples, monitoring of pharmacodynamics on target cells in response to treatment and biomarker discovery
- Assay development and validation on various platforms, development of critical reagents (antibodies and proteins)
- Biobanking and sample repository services supported by LIMS
- Data analysis using multi-parametric statistics and development of predictive models
- Support of regulatory activities related to biomarker qualification with Health Authorities (FDA/EMA)
- Quality environment (ISO 9001, ISO 13485 (GMP), ISO 17025 (GLP/GCLP))

For more information please visit our website.

Name: dianosic
Description:
Dianosic ambitions to become a leading company in solving challenges in patient’s adherence to medication. We provide an alternative to daily medication by designing a unique sustained intranasal drug delivery solution for respiratory and chronic central nervous system diseases.  
 
Dianosic aims to fight against debilitating chronic diseases that affect millions of people. Our first focus is on chronic allergic rhinitis and chronic rhinosinusitis. Currently, 85% of allergic rhinitis patients are not compliant with their treatment. Furthermore, 20% to 25% of patients do not respond to first-line treatments. These medical challenges significantly impact patient’s quality of life.  
 
We closely collaborate with healthcare professionals, including physicians in otorhinolaryngology (ENT) and neurosurgery. Our multidisciplinary team works hand in hand with them in order to design solutions that change physicians’ experience and offer patients minimally invasive and non-surgical options. 
 
Dianosic develops ARIS, a unique platform that benefits from proprietary drug-eluting, long-term resorbable polymer. Our unique concept is meant to deliver patient centric, “insert and forget” solutions, maximizing patient quality of life and addressing physicians’ needs in terms of efficacy, safety, ease of use and patient adherence to treatment. Click here to learn more about our solutions: https://bit.ly/3Tnagog   
 
 For more information, please contact us via LinkedIn private message, by mail (contact@dianosic.com) or phone (+33 1 44 04 45 80).

Name: Cyrebro Neurosignals
Description:
myBrain Tech devient CYREBRO NEUROSIGNALS
La plateforme de myBrain Tech aide les industries à simplifier l'interprétation de la dynamique du cerveau et à extraire des informations instructives pour mieux comprendre l'impact de leur produit ou service sur le cerveau de leurs utilisateurs.
Notre équipe de neuroscientifiques et de data scientists développe des algorithmes et des tableaux de bord automatisés pour analyser et interpréter les données EEG et comportementales des humains dans un contexte réel, et créer un modèle d'IA stratégique.



myBrain Tech's platform helps industries to simplify the interpretation of brain dynamics and to extract informative insight to better understand the impact of their product or services on their users's brains.
Our team of neuroscientists and data scientists develops algorithms and automated dashboards to analyse and interpret humans EEG and behavioral data in real life context, and create strategic AI Model.

Name: Adcytherix
Description:
Adcytherix is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) for cancer and other serious diseases with high unmet medical need. Its ambition is to become a leading next-generation ADC design company, combining clinically validated targets and innovative payloads derived from approved cancer drugs to deliver differentiated, de-risked therapies driven by patient need.

Founded by Jack Elands, CEO, Adcytherix is led by a seasoned team, guided by leading ADC experts, and backed by a top-tier international syndicate of life science investors.

Adcytherix is based in Marseille, France, with subsidiaries in the US and the Netherlands.

Name: DiaDeep
Description:
Are you familiar with that moment of hesitation when facing a critical decision, knowing that much is at stake and time is of the essence? 
This daily challenge is particularly acute for pathologists and oncologists worldwide, especially when making treatment decisions for cancer patients. A minor error in judgment can have far-reaching consequences on numerous lives. 
To support pathologists and oncologists in these critical decisions, we have developed Ai Copilot applications. 
These tools assist in decision-making, biomarker quantification, and prognosis prediction, utilizing AI technology and histology slides across various cancers such as breast cancer, melanoma, and more. 
With our unique holistic approach, we provide real-time insights that empower pathologists and oncologists, facilitating and securing their decision-making processes.

Name: Epigene Labs
Description: Epigene Labs is creating the intelligence-augmenting solution for precision oncology research and drug development. Designed by cancer scientists for cancer scientists, the company's mCUBE platform accelerates data-driven drug discovery, biomarker identification, and patient selection -- to bring better treatments to patients faster. Based in Paris and Boston, Epigene Labs was initially incubated at the Harvard Innovation Labs and launched in France with the support of prominent European investors. Epigene Labs has partnerships with world-class cancer research institutes and biopharmaceutical companies.

Name: Shimadzu France
Description:
Expert reconnu dans le domaine des solutions analytiques complètes – couvrant la médecine, la chimie, la pharmacie, l’agroalimentaire et l’environnement – Shimadzu figure parmi les leaders mondiaux de l’instrumentation scientifique. Depuis 1875, notre philosophie est claire : mettre notre expertise au service de la science.

Créée en 2002, la filiale française de Shimadzu s’appuie sur l’innovation technologique de Shimadzu Corporation tout en développant localement des solutions adaptées aux besoins des laboratoires. Notre équipe d’ingénieurs d’applications conçoit des solutions analytiques complètes, fiables et éprouvées, permettant aux laboratoires d’optimiser leurs performances.

Shimadzu accompagne vos équipes pour répondre aux exigences réglementaires et aux standards de qualité de la production, tout en relevant les défis analytiques les plus complexes. Notre mission : fournir des outils et un savoir-faire qui facilitent vos analyses, garantissent la précision de vos résultats et stimulent l’innovation dans vos laboratoires.

Name: Regulaxis SAS
Description: REGULAXIS is a French innovative biotechnology company based at BIOCITECH the technology park of life science of Paris North area. The company is engaged in the research, development and licensing of innovative synthetic molecules for use in human therapies. Its mission is to grant licenses of innovative molecules in a pharmaceutical company after the establishment of a phase II clinical record. REGULAXIS leads its R&D on its own premises, particularly in regard to biochemical and biological experiments, and keeps the mastery of the chemical synthesis of its therapeutic molecules. The company develops its molecules alone or in establishing targeted collaborations with academic researchers, or also in partnerships with companies interested in developing its own therapeutic molecules.

Name: Fondation Yves Cotrel pour la recherche en pathologies rachidiennes
Description: La Fondation Yves Cotrel a pour mission de coordonner, soutenir la recherche sur les maladies de la colonne vertébrale en France et à l'étranger et de diffuser l'information auprès des patients.

Name: CERAVER - Les Laboratoires Osteal Medical
Description: CERAVER is an orthopedic products manufacturer company.

Name: Duhn Therapeutics
Description:
Duhn Therapeutics SAS, a clinical-stage company co-founded by Landmark BioVentures AG, and OM Pharma SA, a Swiss based global biopharmaceutical company. We are mission-driven to bring new solutions to cancer patients by reshaping the immunological profile of their tumors.

The lead program, DHN198, is a clinical-stage asset for solid cancers associated with or resulting from chronic non-resolved immunosuppressive inflammation.

Building upon years of collaboration with translational researchers and clinicians from the University of Bourgogne and the Georges François Leclerc Cancer Treatment Center (CGFL), Duhn Therapeutics is strategically located in Dijon, France, where it plans to conduct its in-house R&D operations in partnership with the Laboratory of Immunology and Cancer Immunotherapy (LIIC). 
Duhn Therapeutics is a company of the nexus of Landmark BioVentures (www.landmarkbioventures.com)

Name: NOVACTIVA
Description:
Novactiva: French expertise in Health and Beauty

NOVACTIVA is specialized in the development, production and marketing of natural and functional ingredients, backed by clinical studies, for advanced nutraceutical formulations for the health nutrition industry. 

 Innovation, science, and nature combined to optimize cell regeneration, joint well-being, and the beauty of skin and hair.

 Novactiva, the alliance of performance and French excellence.

More information: contact@novactiva.com

Name: L3 parcours professionnalisant R&D Biotech - Toulouse
Description: Une formation à Bac+3 ouverte à l'alternance qui permet une insertion professionnelle comme technicien de laboratoire (ou assistant ingénieur) dans les domaines de la biosanté, des biotechnologies, des biothérapies, des industries pharmaceutiques et cosmétiques

Description: School of engineering with 4 specialities which one in Biotechnolgy

Name: Institut de Biotechnologies Jacques Boy
Description:
Depuis sa création, l’Institut de Biotechnologies Jacques Boy (IBJB) porte une ambition forte : proposer des solutions de diagnostic in vitro fiables, performantes et accessibles, en réponse aux enjeux croissants des professionnels de santé à travers le monde.

Implantée à Reims, notre entreprise allie excellence scientifique, engagement humain et maîtrise réglementaire, pour faire avancer la santé grâce à l’innovation. Chaque jour, nos équipes mobilisent leur savoir-faire, leur exigence et leur passion pour concevoir et produire des dispositifs de haute qualité, qu’il s’agisse de réactifs à base de globules rouges, de contrôles de qualité interne ou de typage moléculaire.

Notre singularité ?

Une approche sur mesure, guidée par une conviction profonde : l’excellence façonnée à vos besoins. C’est cette promesse qui structure nos développements, nos partenariats et notre vision à long terme. Agile, audacieuse et résolument tournée vers l’avenir, IBJB est une entreprise à taille humaine qui croit à la force des relations durables, à l’impact de l’innovation maîtrisée et à l’importance de rester à l’écoute d’un secteur en perpétuelle transformation.

Name: Phycosource
Description:
Phycosource est une start-up biotechnologique dédiée à la découverte de nouvelles molécules actives (médicaments, cosmétiques, marqueurs, produits d'hygiène) issus de microalgues.

Ses principaux clients sont des grands comptes de la cosmétiques, des entreprises pharmaceutiques et biotechnologiques et des laboratoires de recherche. 

Ses produits et services sont :
_Bibliothèques d'extraits et de molécules issues de microalgues originales
_Fourniture de biomasse, extraits et fractions purifiées de l'échelle laboratoire au pilote industriel
_Gestion de projets R&D liés au criblage biologique et chimique de microalgues : Découverte de nouvelles molécules actives, nouveaux sourcing... de l'identification des souches prometteuses au pilote industriel.

Phycosource appuie ses prestations sur une technologie propriétaire de production à haut débit de microalgues, d'une ligne de fractionnement et purification pilote et d'une unité de production de microalgues à l'échelle pilote industriel.
Société de recherche reconnue par les services fiscaux, Phycosource dispose d'un agrément au titre du crédit d'impôt recherche (CIR)

Principaux matériels :
_Ligne de photobioréacteurs automatisés labscale Phycotron 10L
_Photobioréacteur industriel Pronovalg 600L / Fonctionnalités de contrôle-commande étendues pour optimisation rapide et forçage métabolique
_Pilote de micro et ultrafiltration tangentiel
_Centrifugeuses Robatel RA20 / Heraeus Multifuge 3S
_Lyophilisateur Christ Alpha 1-4
_Extracteur Dionex ASE 150
_Chromatographie de partage centrifuge Kromaton FCPC 200

Name: Everfly
Description:
Spécialisée en biotechnologie, EVERFLY est une startup implantée en région Centre Val de Loire depuis 2021.

Vouée à apporter sa constructive contribution à relever trois défis : l’Alimentation de l’Humanité, la Préservation de l’Environnement et le Changement Climatique, EVERFLY est actrice de l’émergente et novatrice filière industrielle de l’entomoculture.

Experte en physiologie de l'insecte et agile à asservir des systèmes robotiques à des capteurs intelligents, EVERFLY renforce sa maîtrise de la bioconversion entomologique d’un large éventail de matières organiques et optimise encore ses procédés industriels, tant ceux des composants protéinés entrant dans la formulation d’aliments d’élevage que ceux de sains amendements de sol pour le maraîchage.

En produisant des protéines animales et des amendements maraîchers par valorisation de déchets organiques, les savoir-faire et procédés de EVERFLY s’intègrent parfaitement dans le rationnel schéma des circuits courts et de l’économie circulaire.

Contexte :
En 2050, 2,3 milliards de bouches de plus seront à nourrir : la FAO évalue à 70% l’impérative augmentation de la production alimentaire mondiale, incluant celle des élevages ! Or, nourrir ces élevages engendre déjà près de 70% des coûts de production. Principales sources de protéines, les farines de soja et poisson sont les intrants les plus coûteux. De plus, la culture intensive du soja nuit aux forêts, santé publique et biodiversité ; la pêche minotière menace l’équilibre de la vie des océans.

L’utilisation de l’insecte comme source alternative aux protéines conventionnelles est en parfait accord avec les enjeux de développement durable. Cet emploi réduit très notoirement les volumes d’eau en jeu, l’occupation de terres arables, les émissions de GES et l’énergie utile pour produire une masse égale de protéines.

Vers 2030, ces élevages absorberont, par an, plusieurs centaines de millions de tonnes d’insectes.

EVERFLY est déjà présent et actif sur ce marché !

Name: ISTCT     CNRS-Université de Caen     UMR 6030
Description:
L’unité ISTCT « Imagerie et Stratégies Thérapeutiques pour les Cancers et Tissus Cérébraux », UMR6030 est une unité mixte de recherche du CNRS et de l’Université de Caen-Normandie (UNICAEN) hébergée au GIP CYCERON à Caen.

Les activités de recherche d’ISTCT visent à mieux comprendre la physiopathologie des tumeurs hypoxiques (cerveau-poumon) et identifier de nouvelles stratégies thérapeutiques ciblant la tumeur et son microenvironnement mais aussi à protéger le tissu sain environnant des traitements anti-cancéreux tels que la radiothérapie.
A titre d'exemple, outre des stratégies moléculaires et/ou cellulaires visant l'hypoxie, ISTCT étudie l'intérêt des hadrons (ions carbone et protons) en combinaison avec d'autres thérapies (chimiothérapie, thérapies ciblées, radiosensibilisants...) pour traiter les tumeurs radiorésistantes dont les glioblastomes. Ce projet s'inscrit dans le programme scientifique ARCHADE et l'ouverture récente à Caen de CYCLHAD, un Centre Européen de Recherche en Hadronthérapie. Les effets de ces thérapies sur le tissu cérébral sain sont également évalués notamment par des méthodes d'imagerie in vivo (IRM, TEP/CT) et comportementales. Des stratégies de neuroprotection/régénération moléculaires et/ou non médicamenteuses telles que l’activité physique sont également étudiées.

ISTCT cherche également à proposer de nouveaux biomarqueurs permettant d'optimiser les traitements, d'évaluer précocement l'efficacité thérapeutique et de mieux orienter la thérapeutique : parmi ces biomarqueurs, ISTCT développe des approches d'imagerie multimodale en IRM et TEP ainsi que des approches moléculaires.

Name: altona Diagnostics #France
Description:
QUI SOMMES-NOUS ? 
altona Diagnostics est une entreprise spécialisée dans le diagnostic médical qui conçoit et fabrique des tests de diagnostic in-vitro pour la détection par PCR des agents pathogènes tels que les virus, les bactéries et les parasites. Basée dans le district d’altona à Hambourg en Allemagne, altona Diagnostics appartient à des propriétaires privés et emploie plus de 350 personnes dans le monde. QUE FAISONS-NOUS ?

Le catalogue de produits de l’entreprise présente plus de 50 kits marqués CE et sont compatibles avec les plateformes ouvertes de PCR en temps réel. Name: Bioxtal
Description:
Bio-Xtal is historically a provider of structural biology services.
Since twelve years, our know-how in structural biology allowed us to perform projects ranging from domain definition to the structure resolution of protein/ligand or protein/protein interactions by Xray crystallography and NMR.
We put an emphasis on monitoring the activity of our targets to ensure the relevance of the structural data we deliver. Our policy is to systematically develop home designed activity assays during our structural biology projects.
Mastering eukaryotic and prokaryotic expression systems allows us to supply high quality protein for the needs of your compound screening as well as for structural studies of the selected compound’s complexes, guarantying the coherence of the results obtained on both sides
A new key service from of Bio-Xtal is the cytosoluble single chain antibody fragment selection (CytobodyTM). These can be raised against any antigen within a very short delay (4 weeks) and are very well expressed in either mammalian or bacteria cells.

The applications of the Cytobodies ranges from the discovery of new druggable sites in multi-domain proteins to immuno-detection, cell imaging, protein purification, and protein stabilisation.

Name: iGEM Nantes
Description: Nous sommes une équipe de l'Université de Nantes participant au concours international de biologie de synthèse : iGEM. Initiée par Randy Rettberg en 2004, le but est de modifier génétiquement un organisme vivant afin de lui faire acquérir une nouvelle propriété (la capacité d'être fluorescent par exemple) ou de produire une protéine d'intérêt (une protéine manquante à l'origine d'une maladie par exemple). Name: Institut de recherche en hématologie et transplantation
Description:
L’Institut de Recherche en Hématologie et Transplantation (IRHT), fondé en 1987 par le Professeur Philippe Hénon, se concentre à la recherche de nouvelles thérapeutiques contre les leucémies et autres cancers. Les recherches scientifiques conduites par l’IRHT ont permis dans un premier temps de mettre en évidence l’existence dans le sang de cellules souches (présentes chez tout individu vivant) et de les utiliser pour régénérer la moelle osseuse détruite après chimiothérapie. Cette technique, dite de « greffe de cellules souches sanguines », présente beaucoup d’avantages par rapport à la technique de greffe de moelle osseuse classique, et a maintenant totalement et universellement supplanté cette dernière. 

Plus récemment, l'IRHT s'est investit dans le domaine plus vaste de la "médecine régénératrice". 

L'équipe scientifique de l'IRHT, outre son directeur, est composée de trois chercheurs seniors, docteurs es-sciences, et de quatre techniciens de recherche, assistés régulièrement de doctorants et d'étudiants de Master. 

Depuis sa fondation, l'IRHT connaît un réel rayonnement international, avec plus de 170 publications scientifiques et plus de 200 conférences  invitées ou communications dans des congrès internationaux (dont 7 organisés à Mulhouse par l'institut). Cette notoriété scientifique internationale a été reconnue à travers diverses récompenses, comme par exemple un "Award du Millénium" attribué en 2000 à Professeur Philippe Hénon pour son importante contribution dans le domaine de l’hématopoïèse, et remis en mains propres à New York par le prix Nobel de Médecine 1990, le Professeur Don Thomas. Elle est également validée par les collaborations avec plusieurs équipes de recherche à Paris, en Hollande, en Allemagne, en Israël, aux USA, au Canada...

Name: CellMade Laboratories
Description:
CellMade Laboratories | Expert Contaminant Testing

Founded by Ronald Bronsaer, CellMade is an independent French laboratory specializing in high-stakes contaminant detection. We provide the scientific expertise and advanced biotechnological models required to secure global supply chains and ensure regulatory certainty.

Pyrogen Testing: The MAT Authority 
We lead the industry transition to human-relevant pyrogen testing in full compliance with EP 5.1.13 & 2.6.30. Why CellMade? Two decades of excellence. One goal: Ultimate Safety.

Name: see2cure
Description:
See2cure detects the invisible to improve surgery and reduce recurrence of abdominal cancers using a targeted fluorescent guidance technology.
This project addresses a major clinical challenge: the treatment of microscopic abdominal metastases, a frequent consequence of colorectal, gastric, ovarian and pancreatic cancers, which affect more than one million people worldwide every year. The innovative see2cure protein platform has been designed as a fluorescent targeting tracer. It specifically detects these metastases by recognising its molecular target during fluorescence-guided surgery, whether open (laparotomy) or minimally invasive (laparoscopy). The aim of this technology is to improve surgical results and reduce recurrence, which currently affects 75% of patients after first line treatment. It enables early and targeted detection of lesions that are invisible to the naked eye.

Name: ANTI OXIDANT POWER
Description:
AOP is a French biotech specialized in the research, development and marketing of revolutionary solutions and technologies with a high impact on antioxidants.

In addition, through data science, AOP aims to build the world's largest intelligent database of proprietary scientific information on antioxidants, enabling the deployment of predictive tools and providing access to personalized medicine.

"We bring unique scientific knowledge on major health issues of living organisms" - AOP mission

With a constantly expanding portfolio of reliable, robust, standardized, scalable, flexible, economical, automated applications and technologies, AOP supports its customers and industrial partners on their issues related to the objective assessment of the efficacy of compounds and extracts used, especially in the nutrition, cosmetics and health sectors.

The LUCS ("Light-Up Cell System") technology implemented and patented by AOP is a world first. It fills a technological gap on the measurements of antioxidant effects inside living human cells and is the result of 8 years of research carried out within the framework of collaborations between public (LAAS / CNRS, Pharmadev / IRD / UPS) and private laboratories.

CONTACTS

Christophe Furger - cfurger@antioxidant-power.com

Name: Cathinvest
Description:
Cathinvest is developing F1M1-Fc+, a first-in-class anticancer antibody targeting Cathepsin-D. Backed by world-leading oncology expertise, the project is advancing from preclinical validation to first-in-human trials with a clear roadmap and strong partnerships.

The company's approach uniquely combines:
· Dual targeting of tumor cells and stroma to overcome microenvironment barriers.
· Recruitment of NK cells and potent immune modulation for durable anti-tumor activity.
· Enhanced therapeutic penetration by remodeling the tumor stroma.
· Validated efficacy in aggressive, drug-resistant Triple Negative Breast Cancer preclinical models.

Name: RID-AGE unit 1167
Description:
RID-AGE unit 1167: Integrative epidemiological and molecular approaches to improve aging-related chronic disease understanding (headed by J.-Ch. Lambert).
Aging-related diseases are complex, multifactorial diseases resulting from the interaction of genetic, biological and environmental factors, whose consequences on quality of life and life expectancy need to be characterized to develop preventive tools and effective therapies. Until recently, because they were mainly considered as concomitant pathologies, these different aging-related pathologies were studied, evaluated and ultimately treated relatively independently. However, it is becoming increasingly clear that these diseases are interconnected. They may share common pathophysiological mechanisms and/or some may predispose to the development of other diseases. This evolution in our understanding of aging-related diseases therefore implies a strong interdependence which may concern the same organ or involve communication between organs. Understanding aging-related diseases means studying them individually, but also integrating several levels of interaction, at epidemiological, biological and/or molecular level.
To address these complexities and interconnection, our project is based on an interdisciplinary unit that combines basic, translational, and epidemiological research. Our main objective is to improve our understanding of the impact on life expectancy of the main aging-related diseases by characterizing the determinants that can be actionable to treat and prevent the interactions and consequences of these chronic diseases.

TEAM1: Vulnerability Factors of Aging-Related Chronic Diseases (A. Hamroun)
TEAM2: Molecular and cellular pathophysiology of cardiometabolic diseases (J.-S. Annicotte)
TEAM3: Molecular determinants of Alzheimer's disease and related disorders (J.-Ch. Lambert)

UMR1167 is supervised by the University of Lille, INSERM, the Lille University Hospital and the Pasteur Institute of Lille.

Description:

Reconnue au niveau local (label Site Aix-Marseille), national (membre fondateur de l'infrastructure ChemBioFrance) et international (à travers de nombreux projets européens), la transformation de l'AD2P en MaSC, labellisé IBISA depuis 2022, reflète une évolution vers une offre de services élargie pour la découverte de médicaments anticancéreux et antiviraux.
La demande croissante en matière de criblages antiviraux met en évidence un changement de paradigme majeur en matière de santé publique. Grâce à la complémentarité technologique de ses trois plateformes, qui ciblent à la fois les criblages basés sur les protéines et sur les cellules, le MaSC se positionne comme un pôle de criblage unique dans la métropole Aix-Marseille.
Étant donné que les virus sont à l'origine de certains cancers et que des cibles biologiques pertinentes existent dans ces deux domaines thérapeutiques, le MaSC se concentre sur l'identification de molécules chimiques et biologiques afin de stimuler le développement de nouvelles stratégies thérapeutiques.

Enfin, e-Quilibra envisage de collaborer avec des laboratoires académiques marseillais pour éprouver les prototypes. 

Les deux porteurs du projets sont Vincent LOME actuellement doctorant à l'UMR-MD1 et Pierre-Emmanuel CASANOVA Ingénieur d'études en biotechnologie et en formation dans le management d'innovation.

Ce projet est incubé à l'Association Grand luminy

We want circular materials to sit at the center of strong stories, capsule collections, and brands, not just on a sustainability slide.

Right now, we are focused on: 
Researching enzymatic approaches to recycle PET and nylon, 
Exploring how these materials could plug into the fashion value chain, 
Talking with streetwear and fashion brands to understand real use cases and collaborations

Description:
Stemselect was a medical device company developing a rapid, point-of-care solution to isolate pure autologous adipose-derived stem cells for immediate clinical use. Our patented technology was inspired by biological systems and relied on a fully mechanical isolation process, avoiding enzymes or chemical manipulation.

The device was designed to leverage existing, well-characterized medical materials, with the explicit goal of simplifying regulatory pathways—particularly within the complex European medical device landscape.

Stemselect raised close to $1 million in funding, secured three patents, and generated promising preclinical research validating the approach. While the company is no longer active, its work contributed to the broader conversation around safe, compliant, and efficient cell-based therapies.

Name: B&A Biomedical
Description:
B&A Biomedical is a dynamic young startup driven by innovation and a passion for technological and computational advancements in health and biology. 
Our primary goal is to develop cutting-edge, tailor-made solutions for data analysis in these rapidly evolving fields.

As experts in processing and analyzing both structured datasets and complex imaging data (MRI, microscopy, CT scans, etc.), we integrate Artificial Intelligence to enable detection, prediction, simulation, and modeling. Our solutions range from fully automated analytical pipelines to ready-to-use insights.

Founded by Prof. Yehezkel Ben-Ari, a pioneer in the field of Neuro-Archeology, B&A Biomedical also applies its expertise to in-house research projects focused on the physiological and pathological events occurring during in utero and perinatal development.

Name: INTIMAP MEDICAL
Description:
INTIMAP MEDICAL is a MedTech project focused on bringing objective measurement to women’s intimate health.
In many areas of medicine, clinical evaluation relies on measurable parameters that support diagnosis, monitoring and treatment decisions. However, in the field of intimate health, assessment still often depends largely on patient-reported symptoms and subjective clinical evaluation.
INTIMAP aims to explore new technological approaches designed to measure and monitor intimate tissue condition in a more objective and reproducible way.
By combining different measurement technologies and focusing on longitudinal monitoring, the project seeks to contribute to a new generation of tools that could support clinicians in the evaluation and follow-up of intimate tissue health.
The vision behind INTIMAP is to help move from subjective assessment toward measurable parameters, enabling better clinical follow-up and improving the understanding of tissue evolution and treatment outcomes in women’s health.
INTIMAP MEDICAL is currently an early-stage project focused on research, development and technological validation.

Name: Murigenetics
Description:
Murigenetics was a biopharmaceutical start-up company working on the development of treatments for rare diseases and genetic disorders. Murigenetics target mostly the pathologies without any treatment option.
The first product of Murigenetcis was designated as an orphan medicinal product both by EMEA and FDA.

Murigenetics was closed in 2012.

Name: Monatomics Technology
Description:
Monatomics Technology is a development stage company pioneering a novel inhalable gas mixture, consisting of xenon, helium, oxygen, and administered by a respiratory system that reduces neurotoxicity and thereby the risk of disability in acute ischemic stroke (AIS) patients. 
While today's Gold Standard therapies in AIS focus on the primary injury via thrombolysis and thrombectomy (or reperfusion), Monatomics focuses on the secondary injury generated by cerebral hypoxia in the ischemic penumbra via neuroprotection. The xenon acts as a neuroprotective agent by inhibiting the NMDA glutamate receptors and blocking the cascade of excitotoxicity. Monatomics' unique proprietary respiratory system recycles the xenon gas (thus making the solution commercially viable) and is scalable as it can be operated by any medical professional at any care setting - a significant hurdle in today's stroke reperfusion therapies.

Name: GEN2i
Description:
Our job: take the analysis off your plate, without taking the science with it.

We deliver reproducible, fully traceable multi-omics analysis, structured around your biological questions rather than the assays that answer them: NGS, multi-omics integration, 3D genome (Hi-C, capture Hi-C), ChIP-seq and RNA-seq, with single-cell and spatial in active R&D. Whatever the assay, common or rare, you get the same provenance capture and the same reporting, not a one-off reassembled from scratch.

Every result lands in GeneSys, our collaborative platform: you and the analyst work around the same figures, with linked comments, a full analysis history, and a traceability report for every analysis. Each figure traces back to the raw data and the parameters that produced it, so nothing between raw signal and final figure is a black box.

We work with PIs and academic labs in genomics, transcriptomics, epigenomics, and 3D genome research, in collaboration with CNRS and INSERM research units (IGH, CBI, CRCT, RESTORE, i2MC) and KAUST.

Built by researchers, for researchers.

Want to connect? Message us or visit gen2i.net

Name: Theraguix

THERAGUIX est une société de biotechnologie en phase clinique avancée. Notre activité est centrée sur le développement d'AGuIX, une nanoparticule  conçue pour la radiosensibilisation et l'imagerie IRM integrée.
AGuIX fait l'objet de 6 essais cliniques, dont un essai de Phase II randomisé en double aveugle au Dana-Farber Cancer Institute,Harvard (NANOBRAINMETS, metastases cerebrales). Plus de 230 patients ont été traités à ce jour. Le profil de tolérance est favorable, sans toxicité dose-limitante rapportée. La désignation FDA Fast Track a été obtenue pour le glioblastome en mai 2024.
Indications explorées : metastases cerebrales (SRS et WBRT), glioblastome, cancer du col de l'utérus, pancréas, poumon.
THERAGUIX a été créée en 2024 pour reprendre les actifs, la propriété intellectuelle et les données cliniques issus de plus de 15 ans de recherche menée a l'Université Claude Bernard Lyon 1. La société est détenue en grande majorité par ses fondateurs scientifiques, les investigateurs cliniques et l'Université.

Name: CVENT H2020
Description:
CVENT: European Union’s Horizon 2020 programme
Risk assessment of plaque rupture and future cardiovascular events by multi-spectral photoacoustic imaging

Vulnerable atherosclerotic carotid plaques, an age and lifestyle related vascular disease, remain a major cause of death for men and women at middle age and is also a hallmark of generalized cardiovascular diseases (CVD) involving other critical vascular regions like the coronary arteries. Every patient exhibiting symptoms of partial occlusion of the carotid arteries is examined with ultrasound (US) because a matured carotid plaque is potentially vulnerable to rupture. When that happens, the content of the lesion entering the blood stream can cause stroke. In the EU this affects over 1 million people annually. According to the guidelines, the patient is operated on, if a 70-99% occlusion of the artery is found. However, only one out of nine operations is effective (Barnett 1998; Rothwell 2003). Even worse, 19 operations need to be done to prevent a single stroke. Hence, the current method to assess plaque vulnerability is insufficient.

The existence of intra-plaque haemorrhages is the main indicator of rupture-prone atherosclerotic plaques in general. The revolutionary step forward in functional photoacoustic imaging (PA) to be made by the CVENT consortium is providing in-vivo functional imaging of vulnerable plaques in the carotid artery for screening, in-depth diagnosis and monitoring.

CVENT is focused on CVD patients to screen, diagnose and monitor carotid plaque vulnerability, by stratifying patients into higher and lower risk groups, this leads to a reduction in overtreatment, better allocation of healthcare cost, and thus contribute to the sustainability of the health care system in Europe.

Name: RiboLINK
Description: This organisation describes the central role of the human ribosome in health and disease. In health, the ribosome is responsible for life, because it synthesizes all the macromolecules that sustain life in all kingdoms of life. In an infectious disease such as COVID-19, the ribosome is responsible for the synthesis of all the viral proteins and enzymes that are needed by the SARS-CoV-2 virus for infection, for the replication of its RNA genome, and for the multiplication of viral particles. Therefore, an effective anti-COVID drug must transiently block the human ribosome to prevent it from synthesizing the proteins and enzymes that are needed by the virus to spread. All the drugs that can achieve this task are listed in this organization. Similarly, the human ribosome is directly responsible for the hyper-proliferation of cancer cells. The control of the activity of the ribosome by targeting it with anticancer drugs is therefore a very interesting approach. Finally, the mechanism of the ribosome is unknown, and this organisation describes the new insights into its functioning that make it easier to understand the precise role of this ribonucleoprotein particle in health and disease.

Name: AIDaR Workshop at NeurIPS 2026 Paris
Description:
AIDaR: AI Data Readiness for Scientific Discovery
NeurIPS 2026 Workshop, Dec 12, 2026, Paris
Scientific AI systems increasingly interact with experimental data, scientific literature, databases, instruments, and laboratory workflows. Yet the underlying data ecosystems are often not organized for reliable use by foundation models, retrieval systems, or AI agents.
AIDaR focuses on two connected questions:
1. What scientific data infrastructure is needed for AI systems to operate reliably?
 This includes metadata, sample and assay context, instruments, protocols, workflow provenance, uncertainty, relational and graph-structured data, multimodal biomedical data, and analysis-ready outputs.
2. How should scientific AI systems be evaluated on realistic scientific work?
 We are interested in benchmarks and evaluations that test whether systems can select inputs, run analyses, retrieve structured knowledge, interpret uncertainty, check controls, and recognize when results are not reliable enough for follow-up.

Name: IcanC
Description:
This project aims to allow the blind to benefit from a satisfactory substitution of natural sight.

In the 1960s Pr. Bach-y-Rita developed a tactile vision sensory substitution device for the blind (TVSS). The principle of TVSS was to convert a video image into a vibratory or electric image, on the skin of blind subjects. The sensory substitution raised great hopes then, but disappointed the users with the use, more precisely when the filmed object lost stability. IcanC is correcting the main defect of existing devices.

The principal innovation of IcanC is to control the image received by the skin in real time by the movements of the eyes. This feedback will allow a progressive repair of the loss of oculomotor coordination and will create a sensorimotor action loop, analogous to that of normal sight (sight / gaze). The images received by the brain will therefore be those that the eyes would have seen, if they could do so.
The project will include other improvements:
• The device will be double, one per eye, to reproduce binocularity.
• The stimulation on the skin will be done through a vibrating screen in high resolution, reproducing the images of the two visual fields.
• We can superimpose other information (horizon, compass, GPS, routes, contextual information etc.)
All in all, more data, more exact and more precise, for a full exploitation of the brain plasticity, towards a real visual substitution.

Unmatched precision: CV < 4-5% for all tests delivers reliable and precise actionable information.

Name: BioMire
Description:
BioMire was founded to empower industries with a smarter, knowledge-driven approach to preventing microbial contamination.   

Microorganisms adapt to the most hostile environments including those designed to eliminate them. Despite advances in analytical technology, increased investments, and stricter regulations, contamination challenges persist.

We believe that insight, not just information, is the real game-changer. Controlling microbial risks lies not in conducting more tests or investing in costly analyses, but in collecting relevant, high-quality data and making it accessible where and when it matters most.

However, accessing and leveraging meaningful microbial data isn’t always straightforward. Technical barriers, confidentiality concerns and financial constraints often stand in the way—especially in environments where labs or microbiologists aren’t readily available. 
Those are the problems we set out to solve with new technologies.
 
We have developed a largely digital and open solution called nomad which capitalizes on human expertise to train AI systems, integrates user-friendly test devices, to address the need for relevant, site and process specific data, enabling the access to actionable insights.

The nomad Microbial Risk Management System (MRMS) combines and automates the best practices from process management, applied microbiology and quality assurance, from sampling through data trending and plant mapping to provide smarter microbiology information where it is most needed.

Following successful reduction to practice and being embraced by early adopters, the nomad system was integrated in 2025 by Alimpex, a company dedicated to hygiene and risk management ...and the adventure continues.

Les activités du LBAE concernent l'étude de systèmes microbiens complexes (SMC) d’intérêt biotechnologique dans le domaine environnemental, en particulier pour l’optimisation de processus d’épuration biologiques et pour la valorisation du carbone résiduaire (eau, déchets).

En effet, dans un contexte de développement durable et de changement global, les effluents et déchets organiques peuvent être épurés et / ou valorisés dans des filières comprenant généralement un traitement biologique, aérobie (boues activées, granules aérobies, compostage, etc) ou anaérobie (méthanisation). Ces traitements biologiques sont rendus possibles grâce à la présence de systèmes microbiens complexes, c'est-à-dire des agrégats principalement constitués de cellules et de substances exo-polymériques (SEP) telles que les protéines, les sucres ou les acides nucléiques.

Différentes approches (biochimiques, microbiologiques et de biologie moléculaire) sont mises en œuvre à différentes échelles - de la bactérie planctonique à la matrice biologique active (agrégats, biofilms) - afin de caractériser, comprendre, maîtriser et valoriser les activités métaboliques de ces systèmes.
Grâce à cette approche intégrée, le laboratoire se focalise notamment sur les activités responsables de la production de biopolymères extracellulaires.

Name: RareUnyk
Description:
RareUnyk is a European biotech start-up aiming to become the accelerated game-changer developer in rare metabolic diseases.
Its first asset, PIPG-4, is a patented, orally available small-molecule chaperone that stabilizes acid α-glucosidase (GAA), the defective enzyme responsible for Pompe Disease (Glycogenosis type II).

Pompe Disease affects ≈ 10 000 patients worldwide (1 / 40 000 births).
Despite three marketed enzyme replacement therapies (Sanofi Myozyme, Nexviazyme, Amicus Pombiliti + Opfolda), efficacy remains partial, administration highly burdensome (4–7 hours infusion every 2 weeks), and cost excessive (USD 250–650 k / year / patient). No competitor currently develops a Pharmacological Chaperone Therapy (PCT) with similar specificity and safety.
Unlike Amicus’ miglustat (Opfolda, a repurposed drug not specific of GAA), PIPG-4 displays high selectivity for GAA, avoiding off-target glycosidase inhibition and related adverse effects.

Investment Highlights:

 Validated science & derisked chemistry – proven mechanism, patented, scalable synthesis.
 Clear regulatory acceleration path – SME, PRIME, ODD (ready at launch).
 € 1.6 Bn growing market – potential add-on and stand-alone revenue streams.
 Unique competitive edge – first selective PCT for Pompe, no direct competitors.
 Capital-efficient model (€ 4 M seed) – achievable milestones to clinical stage and exit in ≤ 3-5 years.
 High-value exit potential (≥ € 500 M deal or 15–25× ROI or > € 1 B exit).

RareUnyk represents a rare confluence of scientific validation, regulatory maturity, and high-margin market potential.
With PIPG-4 poised to redefine Pompe Disease treatment and a 3-year fast-track to value creation, the project offers a de-risked, high-return opportunity for early biotech investors seeking tangible impact and rapid exit.

Actuellement, les disparités énergétiques dans le monde grandissent, et plus d’un milliard de personnes ne sont toujours pas reliées à un réseau électrique. EverLux est basé sur le développement d’un produit utile et nécessaire pour ces populations humaines isolées. L’objectif réside en la création d’une pile biologique (bio-pile) dont l’énergie fournie servirait à l’utilisation de LEDs. 
Cette bio-pile fonctionne sur la base d’une activité métabolique microbienne capable de dégrader un produit de l’urine. Cette dégradation conduit à la production d’électrons, créant une différence de potentiel au sein du système. Ce gradient d’électrons permet ainsi la génération d’un courant électrique.
Ce projet s’inscrit au sein du concept d’économie circulaire, car il participe à la valorisation d’un déchet métabolique humain pour la production d’une énergie verte, écologique, et recyclable en engrais naturel. De plus, la bactérie utilisée est non pathogène et ubiquitaire. Ainsi la production de cette énergie est écologique et sans dangers pour l’homme. 
Notre objectif est d’optimiser la preuve de concept grâce à la complémentarité de nos compétences. En ce sens et dans le but d’implanter notre produit en Afrique, nous avons établi un partenariat avec l’école d’ingénieur 2iE au Burkina-Faso, où une équipe sera prochainement formée pour nous aider dans cette tâche.

The conception of the device reveals 3 main complex aspects : 
-	Precise identification of parameters involved in intrauterine disbalance and detectable by the device. 
-	The form under which the device will be presented 
-	Materials that are used for the conception of the device. Detailed studies are necessary to analyse and define properties and characteristics of the system for the creation of this new medical device (resistance, physicochemical properties, adherence, parameters analysis, lifetime). 

The scientific approach of Endome’tech resides in the observation of interactions between microorganisms of the uterine microbiome to highlight the disbalances that are responsible for the symptoms of the disease. Name: Helomnix
Description:
DIGITAL TWIN INFRASTRUCTURE FOR HEMATOLOGIC ONCOLOGY

Helomnix provides structured disease architecture infrastructure that transforms multi-omics heterogeneity into reusable functional disease state topologies for oncology program decision-making.

We develop structured molecular digital twin maps for hematologic cancers, beginning with acute myeloid leukemia (AML) and multiple myeloma.

Rather than training outcome-driven prediction models, Helomnix defines reproducible functional disease states that organize complex molecular heterogeneity into stable, interpretable version-locked reference topologies.

Digital twin maps integrate:

◆ Genomics
◆ Transcriptomics
◆ Proteomics
◆ Flow cytometry
◆ Microenvironment features
◆ Curated validation layers
◆ In-vitro differentiation systems

The objective is not prediction.
It is structured disease representation.

By establishing reusable disease-state architecture, Helomnix enables translational teams to:

◆ Contextualize cohorts within biologically coherent disease states
◆ Develop mechanistic biomarker strategies grounded in state-specific biology
◆ Prioritize targets within structured disease architecture
◆ Assess compound–state alignment across discovery and translational programs
◆ Model longitudinal state dynamics under progression and therapy pressure

Helomnix operates as biological structure infrastructure — establishing stable disease architecture before outcome mapping, trial stratification, or clinical deployment decisions.

Currently building reusable AML and multiple myeloma digital twin maps designed for cross-program translational deployment.

Open to structured discussions with pharmaceutical and translational research leaders exploring infrastructure-grade disease modeling in hematologic oncology.

Description:

As its acronym indicates (Cellular Communication and Tumor Microenvironment), the laboratory studies the established interactions between cancer cells and their tumor microenvironment as well as their implications in tumor progression.

More specifically, the research activity of the CoMeT laboratory is based on the expertise of its members in terms of intercellular communication by diffusible factors (neurotrophins and their TRK receptors), vesicular transport (extracellular vesicles, exosomes) and direct communication (gap/ communicating). A particular interest is focused on the ability of these communication systems to interact synergistically and increase the invasive potential of tumor cells through the formation of exosomes and/or invasive structures such as invadopodia.

The laboratory's research activity benefits from the variety of skills of its members (biochemists, cell biologists, physiologists) covering all the aspects essential to a study ranging from the molecule to the organism and carried out at different complementary levels, from exploitation of bioinformatics databases (in silico analysis), in vitro and in vivo tests and even patient samples, studied by spatial biology approaches.

Nous travaillons en étroite collaboration avec les instances publiques (notamment les autorités de santé), les professionnels de santé, les chercheurs et les communautés de patients.

Name: Demetis
Description:
Viruses account for nearly half of all emerging plant disease epidemics worldwide, representing over $30 billion in annual economic losses. While chemical pesticides are still widely used to protect crops, regulations like the EU Ecophyto 2030 are rapidly forcing a 50% reduction. In this tightening environment, farmers face a critical deadlock: they have less and less effective solutions targeting plant viruses.

At Demetis, we are pioneering a new era of crop protection. We develop a non-GMO, safe and highly effective RNAi-based platform that eliminates plant diseases precisely at their source. Instead of relying on broad chemical sprays targeting insects, our technology targets the virus itself.

Our first breakthrough targets Yellows disease in sugar beets: a viral threat responsible for an average of 40% annual yield losses across European fields. Our sprayable solution works from the inside: it penetrates the leaf and neutralises the virus directly, with zero side effects on human health or biodiversity.

We are building a safe, effective and sustainable biotech platform adaptable to any crop viral disease worldwide.

Name: Tangramed Biotech
Description:
Tangramed Biotech is a French biotechnology company developing a new way to design therapies for complex diseases.

Many severe diseases, including neurodegenerative diseases and cancer, are driven by multiple biological mechanisms that vary across patients, tissues and disease stages. This complexity is one reason why single-target therapies often fail to deliver robust clinical benefit.

Tangramed addresses this challenge through Integral Therapy Design (ITD), a development framework for designing and benchmarking rational multimodal therapies (MMTs). The approach combines PleoBotTM, Tangramed’s proprietary AI-assisted network-pharmacology platform, with Patient Avatar Cohort (PAC), a patient-derived robustness-testing capability designed to assess therapeutic concepts across biological diversity.

Tangramed supports biopharma partners with target and pathway prioritization, asset positioning, target-combination discovery, Multimodal Therapy design, and scientific or investment diligence. Selected concepts may progress into partner-funded ITD programs using both PleoBotTM and PAC.

The company’s first flagship ITD application is focused on Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), a fatal and highly heterogeneous neurodegenerative disease with major unmet medical need.

From complex disease biology to actionable therapeutic decisions.

Name: BIOSOFT
Description:
Biosoft is a joint laboratory between LAAS-CNRS and Innopsys Company. 
The focus of our lab is the development of automated soft lithography processes for the fabrication of cell microarrays.

Mastering the adhesion landscape of living cells on a surface is a tool for investigating fundamental mechanisms of cell biology such as shape control, differentiation, division, polarity or motility. 
The production of cell microarrays (CMA) of various shapes and dimensions allows the biologists to design specific scenarii and record how various living cells respond (neural, epithelial, tumoral and stem cells). 
Because technology allows reproducing identical precise patterns along well arranged periodical arrays, these observations can be made systematically over large population of cells thus reaching a high level of representativeness. 

The micro-contact printing of proteins of the Extra Cellular Matrix (ECM) on conventional glass slides, coverslips, or other subtrates, turned out to be an efficient method for fabricating these micro-patterned cell culture substrates.

Biosoft has developed an instrument (Innostamp40) and a dedicated protocol enabling the automated production of highly reproducible functional micro-patterns in order to bring this process to a level where it could become a standard in cell biology.

Name: ANR GRADIENT
Description:
Shape classification is one of the most important tasks in computer vision as demonstrated by the large body of work dealing with 3D shape analysis. Recent advances in 3D data acquisition as well as the availability of large 3D repositories have been instrumental in the design of new and more efficient algorithms for shape classification. 3D shapes may be represented by graphs and consequently, graph techniques may be strongly useful for their classification. In the GRADIENT project, we address the problem of 3D protein deformable shapes classification. Proteins are macromolecules characterized by deformable and complex shapes which are linked to their function making their classification an important task namely for drug discovery and disease characterization. Protein shapes can be standardly and robustly generated from their high-resolution 3D structures available in the Protein Data Bank. Their conformational space can be sampled using molecular dynamics simulations. In the GRADIENT project, proteins are assimilated to 3D dynamic deformable objects and their surfaces are represented by graphs, such as triangular tessellations or meshes. Since molecular dynamics can be used to efficiently sample the trajectories of molecular 3D objects, they constitute a perfect case of study for dynamic graph matching.

The goal of the GRADIENT project is to develop a platform containing robust techniques and algorithms based on graphs, algorithms and machine learning able to classify and analyze 3D deformable (dynamic) shapes of proteins.

Name: Inserm UMR 1011 – Hemostasis & Cardiovascular Flow
Description:
The Inserm UMR 1011 – Hemostasis & Cardiovascular Flow team investigates the molecular and vascular mechanisms underlying rare bleeding disorders and hemostatic alterations under pathological cardiovascular flow.
Our research focuses on inherited and acquired hemorrhagic diseases, including von Willebrand disease and hemophilia, and explores their molecular signatures and impact on vascular integrity. We study how these conditions influence the occurrence and progression of severe bleeding events, including cerebral hemorrhage.
A central axis of our work examines how cardiovascular diseases and circulatory support devices (ECMO, blood pumps, and valve bioprostheses) modify hemostasis through altered flow dynamics and endothelial stress. We investigate the causes and consequences of flow abnormalities on vascular endothelium, thrombotic and hemorrhagic balance, and structural degeneration of valves.
Our approach integrates mechanistic vascular biology, advanced in vitro flow systems, animal models of extracorporeal circulation, multi-omics profiling, and translational clinical research.

The team is led by Professor Sophie Susen, Head of the French Reference Center for von Willebrand Disease and Coordinator of the French National Network for Rare Hemostasis Disorders, ensuring strong integration between fundamental research, clinical expertise, and national rare disease infrastructures.

Embedded within the broader Inserm UMR 1011 research unit, our team benefits from a multidisciplinary environment spanning vascular biology, metabolism, and molecular regulation.
We actively engage in national and European collaborations and welcome academic, clinical, and industrial partnerships.

Name: Engicoll
Description:
ENGICOLL is a deep-tech startup co-founded by two experts in food ingredients and recombinant collagen. Our goal is to revolutionize the global B2B collagen peptide market for dietary supplement and functional food manufacturers, a fast-growing market expected to reach $800M by 2030.

Today, collagen peptides are extracted from animal tissues, raising ethical, animal welfare, environmental, public health, and food safety concerns. Conventional collagen peptides have limited efficacy due to their low content of bioactive di- and tripeptides such as GPO (generally <1%), which are naturally present only in small amounts in animal collagens. Daily doses of up to 10-20g are typically required, creating formulation constraints for manufacturers and compromising consumer experience.

TrueColl One addresses these three challenges simultaneously. Produced through precision fermentation, this patented collagen peptide is animal-free, composed exclusively of highly active di- and tripeptides (>50% GPO), and is effective at a very low daily dose from 100mg to support active living, healthy ageing and longevity. It provides manufacturers with ease of formulation and strong innovation and product differentiation potential, while delivering a premium consumer experience, unlocking previously inaccessible markets.

A proof of concept has been validated, and strong market interest confirmed. A patent covering food, cosmetic, and medical applications has been filed. One of the global leaders in food ingredients has signed a letter of intent for co-development and commercialization support in Food. We have also entered into an agreement with a leading international cosmetics company for an exclusive license to exploit our patent in this field. We are preparing a Seed round, already partially secured, to finalize the development of TrueColl One.
We welcome discussions with potential investors and strategic partners interested in reshaping the future of collagen and health & wellness.
